title_en: Disaster early warning emergency broadcasting system
abstract_en: The disaster early warning emergency broadcasting system comprises a wireless host and a plurality of wireless extensions, wherein the wireless host comprises a first switching power supply, a 4G wireless voice module, a first public network intercom module, a first power amplifier and a first loudspeaker; the control output ends of the 4G wireless voice module and the first public network intercom module are respectively and electrically connected with the first relay; the control output end of the 4G wireless voice module is electrically connected with the emission control end of the first public network intercom module at the same time; the audio output end of the 4G wireless voice module is respectively connected with the signal input ends of the first public network intercom module and the first power amplifier, and the audio output end of the first public network intercom module is connected with the signal input end of the first power amplifier; the signal output end of the first power amplifier is connected with the first loudspeaker. The system can realize the complete coverage of emergency broadcasting from administrative villages to natural villages, truly solves the bottleneck of the transmission of the early warning information in the last kilometer, realizes one-hundred-call broadcasting, and ensures the timely and rapid broadcasting.

title_en: Safety alcohol lamp
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a chemistry experiment instrument technical field is a safe alcohol burner, and it includes bottle, wick, lamp rope and cap, and the upper end of bottle is equipped with the bottleneck, and the inboard at the bottleneck is installed through threaded connection in the outside of wick, and the lamp rope passes the upper portion that the inside upper end of wick and lamp rope is located the wick of wick, and the lower extreme of wick is located inside the bottle, and the cap can install the side lower part at the wick and can cover the wick and be located the lamp rope of wick upside with tilting. The utility model has reasonable and compact structure and convenient use, the lamp rope made of asbestos can not burn, mixed gas can not be generated, and air pollution is reduced; the asbestos lamp cord does not produce black burnt solid in the combustion process of the alcohol lamp, and the lamp cord does not need to be replaced or trimmed; the asbestos lamp wick can ensure that alcohol is fully contacted with air and fully combusted; when the alcohol lamp is knocked down, alcohol in the bottle body cannot leak, the lamp cap can be automatically buckled on the lamp wick and the lamp rope, the alcohol lamp is extinguished, and fire disasters are prevented.

title_en: Mountain torrent early warning response simulation system and mountain torrent early warning response simulation method based on main body
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent early warning response simulation system and a mountain torrent early warning response simulation method based on a main body, wherein the system comprises the following components: the flood disaster early warning system comprises an early warning module, a social module, a flood module and an casualty rate calculation module, wherein the early warning module is used for issuing mountain torrent disaster early warning information according to an early warning forestation period; the social module is used for simulating psychological and behavioral response processes of the main body after receiving the early warning information and obtaining position space-time dynamic change process data of the main body; the flood module is used for obtaining disaster-causing element space-time dynamic change process data through simulation; the casualty rate calculation module is used for calculating the casualty rate when the main body is transferred according to the two space-time dynamic change process data. The invention can quantitatively describe the early warning response process, compare different mountain torrents prevention measures, thoroughly describe the early warning response psychological process, deconstruct the social and psychological characteristics, and simultaneously couple the flood module and the social module, thereby evaluating the benefits of engineering measures and non-engineering measures in mountain torrents prevention under one frame.

title_en: Data backup method in computer system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data backup method in a computer system, which relates to the technical field of computer systems and comprises the following steps of S1, analyzing data to generate a classification report, S2, generating a backup scheme according to the classification report, S3, conducting encryption processing on the backup data, S4, conducting transmission and storage on the data subjected to safe processing, S5, conducting data recovery performance optimization on the stored data, S6, conducting disaster recovery system design by using a performance recovery strategy, and S7, conducting automatic system monitoring and optimization according to the disaster recovery system. By setting an improved distributed encryption mechanism, combining an adaptive encryption technology and a data slicing strategy, slicing and storing data, triggering encryption calculation and blockchain updating only when necessary, effectively reducing calculation and storage cost of each backup period, and dynamically adjusting encryption strength according to system load by an introduced adaptive encryption algorithm, so that performance bottleneck of a traditional blockchain mechanism under high load is avoided.

title_en: Method for automatically extracting emergency response process model from emergency plan
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for automatically extracting an emergency response flow model from an emergency plan, which belongs to the field of flow mining and adopts an emergency plan text paragraph structure tree construction module, a four-stage response starting condition expression extraction module, a flow model entity element extraction module, a flow model relation element extraction module, an emergency response flow tree generation module and an emergency response flow directed graph model generation module; the method specifically comprises the following steps: constructing an emergency plan text paragraph structure tree; extracting emergency response process model elements; and generating an emergency response flow model. According to the method, firstly, an emergency response flow tree is generated according to extracted flow model elements and a text paragraph structure tree, and then the emergency response flow tree is converted into an emergency response flow directed graph model. The method can assist a modeling expert in completing the construction and analysis of the emergency response flow model, and can also be used for checking and revising the emergency plan text of the emergency.

title_en: A fire safety system that informs step-by-step the recognition of the source and the degree of risk in the event of a fire in a building
title_ko: 건축물의 화재발생시 발원지 인식과 위험도를 단계별로 알려주는 화재안전 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire safety system for recognizing an original ignition place and informing the risk degree in stages in case of occurring a fire in a building, and more particularly, to an improved fire safety system, which solves a problem that a fire becomes a large fire due to difficulty in suppression on an initial stage although a firefighter is dispatched if an original ignition place cannot be accurately specified during fire occurrence, in case of a building having a large space, such as an apartment house, a large retail facility, an airport passenger terminal, a large warehouse, etc., and transmits a broadcast in stages with the time difference when transmitting an emergency broadcast while allowing a firefighter to immediately head to an original ignition place at the same time when the firefighter is dispatched through rapid location specifying and a map service, such that smooth and rapid evacuation is performed while preventing a stampede caused by a bottleneck phenomenon on evacuation stairs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건축물의 화재발생시 발원지 인식과 위험도를 단계별로 알려주는 화재안전 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 아파트는 물론 대형 판매시설이나 공항여객터미널, 대형 창고 등과 같이 대공간을 갖는 건축물의 경우 화재발생시 발원지를 정확하게 특정하지 못하면 소방관이 출동하더라도 초기에 진압하는 것이 어려워 대형화재로 번지는 문제를 해결하고, 신속한 위치특정과 맵 서비스를 통해 소방관 출동과 동시에 즉시로 발원지로 향할 수 있도록 함과 함께 비상방송을 송출할 때 시간차를 두고 단계별로 송출토록 함으로써 피난계단에서의 병목현상에 의한 압사사고를 미연에 방지하면서 원활하고 신속한 피난이 이루어질 수 있도록 개선된 건축물의 화재발생시 발원지 인식과 위험도를 단계별로 알려주는 화재안전 시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: PCM GLOBAL PROFESSIONAL ENG & ARCHITHECT CO LTD

title_en: Cloud edge cooperative data hierarchical processing method of power equipment monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud edge cooperative data hierarchical processing method of a power equipment monitoring system, which belongs to the technical field of power equipment detection data processing, wherein the cloud edge cooperative data hierarchical processing method is based on the power equipment detection system to collect multi-source data on a power equipment line into original data and construct a cloud storage source library, the cloud storage source library comprises a historical library area, an active library area and a different library area, the edge end is responsible for local real-time data acquisition, preprocessing and emergency response, the problem of limited edge equipment resources is solved, the cloud end is responsible for massive historical data storage, global trend analysis and optimization processing, network bandwidth, regional distance and stability bottlenecks are broken through, and the closed loop of edge real-time processing and cloud deep analysis is used for reducing data transmission cost and cloud storage pressure, realizing the upgrading of the power equipment from local state monitoring to global intelligent optimization, and improving the stability and the intelligent level of the whole power equipment monitoring system.
assignees: XINJIANG MEITE INTELLIGENT SECURITY ENG CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus for processing dangers of vehicles based on multi-log analysis
title_ko: 다중 로그 분석을 기반으로 차량 위험을 처리하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Provided are a method and apparatus for handling vehicle risk based on a multi-log analysis. The method includes the steps of: detecting or predicting a surrounding danger situation including a traffic accident and a disaster situation, based on data provided from at least one of a public institution, a detection device, a vehicle-mounted camera, a vehicle sensor, an SNS system, and a nearby vehicle through a network; detecting or predicting the danger to the corresponding vehicle based on log data related to the corresponding vehicle, if a surrounding danger situation is detected or predicted; and performing a response process if the risk to the vehicle itself is detected or predicted in the corresponding vehicle.
abstract_ko: 다중 로그 분석을 기반으로 차량 위험을 처리하는 방법 및 장치가 제공된다. 상기 방법은, 네트워크를 통해 공공 기관, 감지 장치, 차량 탑재 카메라, 차량 센서, SNS 시스템, 인근 차량 중 적어도 하나로부터 제공되는 데이터를 기반으로, 교통 사고 및 재난 상황을 포함하는 주변 위험 상황을 감지하거나 예측하는 단계; 주변 위험 상황이 감지되거나 예측된 경우, 해당 차량에 관련된 로그 데이터를 토대로 해당 차량 자체에 대한 위험을 감지하거나 예측하는 단계; 그리고 상기 해당 차량에 차량 자체에 대한 위험이 감지되거나 예측되는 경우, 대응 처리를 수행하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Vehicle allocation management device and vehicle allocation management method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a vehicle allocation management device that manages vehicle allocation in response to a vehicle allocation request from a user. The device comprises: a vehicle allocation planning unit that, on the basis of the vehicle allocation request, creates a vehicle allocation plan for a vehicle to be allocated to a riding user, and issues vehicle allocation instructions to the vehicle; an access permission request acquisition unit that acquires an access permission request for requesting permission to access, by an information communication terminal device of a monitoring user associated with the riding user, a specific function of the vehicle the riding user is riding; an in-vehicle environment information providing unit that acquires in-vehicle environment information of an in-vehicle space of the vehicle the riding user is riding according to an access right based on the access permission request, and provides the in-vehicle environment information to the information communication terminal device; an emergency notification reception unit that receives an emergency notification based on the access right from the information communication terminal device that has received the in-vehicle environment information; and an emergency response processing unit that performs control to execute predetermined emergency response processing for the vehicle on the basis of the emergency notification.

title_en: Big data private cloud storage security analysis and practical research
abstract_en: Big data private cloud storage is software aiming at providing private cloud storage service, a multiple backup disaster recovery mechanism for data is established by utilizing a currently popular B/S framework, and data processing services such as access, storage, sharing, tracing and the like for a private cloud disk are provided. The bottleneck problem of a user in the aspects of reliable storage and high concurrent access of big data can be effectively solved, the third-party open platform software is third-party open platform software which can be used for customizing cloud storage service, the cost performance advantage is obvious, and the installation and debugging are convenient and fast.
assignees: WEBLINK QINGDAO NETWORK SECURITY RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;NO 30 INST CHINA ELECTRONIC TECH GROUP CORP

title_en: Apparatus and method for reacting threat target immediacy in the war ship
title_ko: 함정에서 위협 표적을 긴급 대응하는 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a method for urgently responding to a threat target in a warship, which can accurately, effectively, and urgently respond to a threat target. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the apparatus for urgently responding to a threat target in a warship comprises a battle management system to automatically perform an emergency response procedure for a threat target if an emergency response for the threat target is requested by a commander or an operator of a warship. The battle management system includes: an identification information changing unit to automatically change identification information for the threat target to an enemy; a battle channel selecting and assigning unit to automatically select a battle channel for the threat target, and automatically assign the selected battle channel; an arm use allowing unit to automatically allow use of at least one arm included in the assigned battle channel to allow the arm to engage in a battle; and a launch approval unit to automatically approve a launch for the allowed arm.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시 예에는 함정에서 위협 표적을 긴급 대응하는 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 함정의 지휘관 또는 운영자에 의해 위협 표적에 대한 긴급 대응이 요청되면, 상기 위협 표적에 대한 긴급 대응 절차를 자동으로 수행하는 전투 관리 시스템을 포함하며, 상기 전투 관리 시스템은, 상기 위협 표적에 대한 식별 정보를 적군으로 자동으로 변경하는 식별 정보 변경부; 상기 위협 표적에 대한 교전 채널을 자동으로 선택하고, 상기 선택된 교전 채널을 자동으로 할당하는 교전 채널 선택 및 할당부; 상기 할당된 교전 채널에 포함된 적어도 하나의 무장이 교전 가능하도록 상기 무장의 사용을 자동으로 허용하는 무장 사용 허용부; 및 상기 허용된 무장에 대한 발사를 자동으로 승인하는 발사 승인부를 포함한다.

title_en: Method for generating marine oil spill emergency response decision
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a method for generating a marine oil spill emergency response decision. The method comprises: obtaining marine oil spill incident information and sea state monitoring information, and storing the information into a database for integration; according to the spill event information, the sea state monitoring information, and an existing oil spill processing model in the database, giving out a clean-up processing method; and according to the obtained clean-up processing method, and existing emergency resource point information and emergency response equipment information in the database, giving out a specific emergency response processing scheme. After the oil spill incident occurs, the reasonable emergency response scheme can be produced according to the method disclosed by the present invention, so as to provide reference support and auxiliary suggestions for related departments to make the emergency response decision to the oil spill incident, thereby ensuring contamination removal effects to meet requirements of a marine environment monitoring department.
assignees: NORTH CHINA SEA ENVIRONMENTAL MONITORING CT OF STATE OCEANIC ADMINISTRATION;UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH;QINGDAO DINGTU SPACE INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle transport equipment of chemical accident responder
title_ko: 화학사고 대응이 가능한 차량이송용 저장장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a storage device for transporting a vehicle capable of responding to a chemical accident, and more specifically, to a storage device for transporting a vehicle capable of responding to a chemical accident, which can prevent an ignition and explosion accident which can be caused when a liquid chemical material is transported in a storage tank which collects the liquid chemical material to load the same on a vehicle for storage and transport. To this end, the storage device for transporting a vehicle capable of responding to a chemical accident according to the present invention comprises: a transport unit (100) on which a main tank (110) storing a liquid chemical material (10) is mounted in order to enable transport by means of a vehicle (120) collecting the liquid chemical material (10); a response processing unit (200) which is connected to the main tank (110) and the vehicle (120) to check the concentration change and the pressure change of a volatile material or a chemical material in the main tank (110) in the vehicle (120) in real time, thereby responding in accordance with the checked information; and a flow control unit (300) which is provided in the main tank (110) to control the flow of the liquid chemical material (10) in the main tank (110).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화학사고 대응이 가능한 차량이송용 저장장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하세는 액상 화학물질을 수거한 후 차량에 탑재하여 저장 이송하는 저장탱크내의 액상 화학물질이 이송중 발생될 수 있는 발화, 폭발 사고를 방지할 수 있는 화학사고 대응이 가능한 차량이송용 저장장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 화학사고 대응이 가능한 차량이송용 저장장치는, 액상화학물(10)이 저장되는 메인탱크(110)를 탑재하여 액상화학물(10)을 수거하는 차량(120)을 통하여 이송가능하도록 하는 이송부(100); 상기 메인탱크(110)와 차량(120)에 연결되어 차량(120) 내에서 메인탱크(110) 내의 휘발물질 또는 화학물질의 농도변화와 압력변화를 실시간 확인한 후, 확인된 정보에 따라 대응 처리 하는 대응처리부(200); 및 상기 메인탱크(110)의 내부에 구비되어 메인탱크(110) 내에서 액상화학물(10)의 유동을 제어하는 유동제어부(300);를 포함한다.

title_en: Cascade machine learning-based hydrate region seabed landslide risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrate region submarine landslide risk assessment method based on cascading machine learning, and belongs to the technical field of marine geological disaster prediction. The landslide risk prediction method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining historical landslide data, hydrate occurrence data and various environmental characteristics of a research area, preprocessing, constructing a hydrate occurrence data set based on local hydrate data and the environmental characteristics, training a neural network model fused with physical constraints, predicting occurrence depth of all-area hydrate and generating a distribution map, finally fusing the predicted depth serving as a key characteristic with the environmental characteristics, constructing an enhanced landslide data set, training an integrated learning model by adopting a dynamic weight integration strategy based on a geological landscape unit, and finishing landslide risk prediction. According to the invention, the prediction bottleneck caused by the scarcity of the hydrate data is effectively solved through the cascade architecture, the rationality and the robustness of the model are improved through physical constraint, and the high-precision and interpretable evaluation of the submarine landslide risk of the hydrate region is realized.

title_en: Sylvosteppe fire extinguishing eruption device
abstract_en: A kind of sylvosteppe fire extinguishing eruption device.Forest fire is one of the Nature disaster of the world eight, is destroyed first of forest reserves natural calamity.A kind of sylvosteppe fire extinguishing eruption device, its composition include：Back seat, back seat（1）Connect control cabinet（2）, control cabinet sidepiece is connected with fuel tank（4）, control upper box part to be connected with combustion head（3）, combustion head front portion is connected with colloidal sol mist jet pipe（16）, burning indoor pipe（15）With combustion chamber outer tube（14）, connecting tube is installed on colloidal sol mist jet pipe（13）, connecting tube one end is connected on colloidal sol mist jet pipe, and the other end is connected to bottleneck connection cup（11）, bottleneck connection cup is for connecting aerosol bottle（10）, support frame is also associated with bottleneck connection bottom of a cup portion（12）, front support leg is utilized respectively on fuel tank top（5）And rear leg（7）Connect inflator（6）, there is inflating bat-handle on inflator（9）.The present utility model application is applied to sylvosteppe fire extinguishing eruption device, and flash evapn reduces scene of a fire amount of heat, rapid to reduce scene of a fire ignition temperature, suppresses scene of a fire heat radiation, the forest fires of burning is extinguished rapidly in the presence of aerosol and water smoke, smog.

title_en: Centralized communication system
abstract_en: The invention provides a centralized communication system, comprising a central exchange module. The exchange module is communicated with different communication systems by using communication protocols corresponding to the different communication systems. Through the communication system provided by the application, a large, bottleneck-free and comprehensive communication network with high network safety and reliability integrating all kinds of voices/multimedia voices is formed by integrating. The interconnection among each communication system is achieved via network integration. The centralized communication system of the invention solves the problems that the communication command information is mutually independent with each other, the resources are dispersed, the base number is not clear, the communication is not smooth, the efficiency is not high and the control capacity is not strong, thereby greatly improving emergency management level of an emergency.

title_en: A kind of rule-based accident picture and emergency preplan method for pushing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of rule-based accident picture and emergency preplan method for pushing:The level logical relation of loading rule object and rule objects simultaneously utilizes the parsing of rule objects resolver；Data point object in listening components decimation rule object is registered by data point object message and message registration is carried out to it；Submission data point object online to rule carries out message registration simultaneously；To the change response processing of data point Obj State, the logical expression rule of rule objects is evaluated using logical expression rules evaluation device；Editor's fault countermeasure resource is had access to using accident picture and prediction scheme resource processing assembly dynamic creation ejection accident picture and fault countermeasure resource and active.The present invention can effectively help dispatcher rapidly to carry out failure emergency command, to organize repairing rapidly according to the content of prediction scheme about repair personnel, so that prevent failure or dangerous situation from further expanding, safeguards system safety and operation security.
assignees: NANJING SAC RAIL TRAFFIC ENG CO LTD

title_en: Large-range extreme drought emergency monitoring and influence evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, which comprises the following steps: carrying out drought monitoring based on the medium-resolution data of the wind cloud satellite; establishing a comprehensive drought monitoring index by cooperating with the multiple remote sensing parameters and the ground historical drought record, and performing drought disaster monitoring and emergency response processing by using the established comprehensive drought monitoring index; and carrying out drought influence evaluation treatment based on multiple remote sensing parameters. In addition, the invention also discloses a large-range extreme drought emergency monitoring and influence evaluation system. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the drought situations can be well monitored to obtain accurate information, and the drought situation service is provided to prevent the drought situations in the future.

title_en: Fill special hexafluoropropane automatic fire extinguishing device of electric pile
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fill special hexafluoropropane automatic fire extinguishing device of electric pile, including the fire-extinguishing bottle, still including setting up the fire detection pipe in filling electric pile, fire detection pipe one end is provided with fire detection pipe end cap, the fire detection pipe other end is worn out and is filled electric pile and be connected with the end of giving vent to anger of container bottle head valve, the inlet end of container bottle head valve is connected with the bottleneck of fire-extinguishing bottle, the end of giving vent to anger of container bottle head valve still is connected with first manometer through first ball valve, the end of giving vent to anger of container bottle head valve still is provided with aerifys the valve inside, the inlet end of container bottle head valve still is connected with the second manometer through the second ball. The utility model discloses can realize automatic fire extinguishing, real-time status monitoring, can in time discover by oneself at the conflagration initial stage of formation, put out a fire and save life or property automatically, reduce the expansion of accident disaster face. Simple structure, low cost and long service life. The cost of maintenance is low after installation.
assignees: CHINA LIGHT IND WUHAN DESIGN & ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Knapsack-type efficient fire extinguishing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a knapsack-type efficient fire extinguishing device which comprises fire extinguishing agent bottles, a bottle body fixing device and straps, wherein the bottle body fixing device is used for fixing the two fire extinguishing agent bottles, the straps are connected with the extinguishing agent bottles and the bottle body fixing device, a bottleneck of each fire extinguishing agent bottle is provided with a relief valve, the relief valve is provided with a pressure gauge and a startup valve, and a pressure-withstanding hose is connected with the fire extinguishing agent bottles and a spray gun through a T-way connecting component, and is movably provided with an extended injection pipe. After the device is carried on the back of a worker to a fire scene, the startup valves of the fire extinguishing agent bottles are started, and then fire extinguishing agents are sprayed out of the spray gun to carry out fire extinguishing, or after one or more extended injection pipes are adopted for being connected with the spray gun, fire extinguishing agents are sprayed out of the tail ends of the extended injection pipes to carry out fire extinguishing, so that on the premise of ensuring the safety of fire extinguishing workers, various indoor and outdoor solid, liquid, gas, electrical fire disasters can be effectively extinguished.

title_en: Method for establishing and analyzing drought index based on gravity satellite
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for establishing and analyzing a drought index based on a gravity satellite. The method for establishing and analyzing the drought index based on the gravity satellite comprises the steps of preprocessing of observation data of the gravity satellite, extraction of the changing process of average total land water of an area, calculation of the spatial distribution of the total land water of the area, standardization processing of the total land water of the area, and calculation and analysis of the time sequence and spatial distribution of total water abnormal indexes of the drought index based on the gravity satellite. According to the method for establishing and analyzing the drought index based on the gravity satellite, the drought index established with the method can effectively reflect the seasonal and interannual changing rule of the total land water and scientifically disclose disaster causing process of a drought; a disaster-inducing mechanism of the duration of the drought is considered, the influence mechanism of the serious drought at the earlier stage on the disastrous situation at the later stage can be reflected effectively, and the problem of the scientific bottleneck of monitoring and evaluation of the drought in an area where data are insufficient or unavailable is solved.

title_en: A kind of dangerous and explosive articles security control plateform system
abstract_en: The invention discloses the quick-fried danger compound product monitor supervision platform of one kind danger, by industrial explosive materials security monitoring, fireworks and firecrackers flows to management and control, hypertoxic harmful influence dynamic management and control, and petrol in bulk sale management and control and formed platform.By effective management and control to aforementioned four plate, can effectively solve the bottleneck problem in present society security administration work, above-mentioned all articles being related to monitor and analyze in real time, exclude potential safety hazard.Farthest improve the efficiency of the work of security administration instantly and reduce or even prevent the generation of particularly serious security incident, while the probability of happening for case of reducing crime.

title_en: Intelligent composite pipeline with real-time monitoring and analysis decision system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent composite pipeline with a real-time monitoring and analysis decision system, which relates to the technical field of intelligent composite pipeline real-time monitoring and analysis decision, and comprises a composite pipeline body, a real-time monitoring and analysis decision system, an intelligent control emergency valve and a valve control device; the real-time monitoring and analysis decision-making system comprises a monitoring system, a data acquisition terminal, a data processing and analysis platform, a monitoring platform, an emergency response processing platform, a data display terminal and a power supply device; the inner lining layer and the outer lining layer monitoring system are respectively embedded into the inner reinforcing layer and the inner lining layer interlayer and the outer reinforcing layer and the outer layer interlayer of the pipeline, so that the running state of the pipeline and the parameters of conveying media are monitored in real time; when monitoring is abnormal, the monitoring system converts abnormal parameters into electric signals, controls the intelligent control emergency valve to block medium transmission, automatically alarms and analyzes fault reasons, provides an emergency decision scheme and informs maintenance personnel, and the management efficiency, the accuracy and the safety of the pipeline are improved.

title_en: Method and device for detecting frost on surface of tea tree leaf
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of agricultural meteorological disaster protection, and relates to a detection method and a detection device for frost on the surface of tea leaves, aiming at the problem that the prior art cannot accurately quantify the thickness of a frost layer and dynamically predict the frost tendency; the method comprises the steps of dividing a frosting area and a ground color area of a microscopic image of a pair autumn leaves, calculating frost coverage rate by adopting red light intensity ratio, wherein the ground color area is specially defined as a blade edge non-frosting area aiming at a class III autumn leaves, solving the technical bottleneck of the traditional method in full white blade coverage rate calculation and thick frost layer quantification, dynamically identifying the initial stage, the middle stage and the final stage of frost based on sensor frequency signal change rate, automatically adjusting defrosting power by fusing frost class and coverage rate data, improving detection accuracy to 92.4%, reducing frost prevention energy consumption to 37.6%, and being particularly suitable for the early warning of frost disasters in tea gardens.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Active perturbation-based online performance supervision method and system for new energy power station
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention are an active perturbation-based online performance supervision method and system for new energy power stations. The method comprises: in a set supervision period, performing active perturbation tests on the performance of a new energy power station, so as to analyze constraint parameters of short-time signals and continuous weak signals; extracting a short-time signal checking data set and a continuous weak signal checking data set; acquiring feedback parameters of a short-time signal injection test and feedback parameters of a continuous weak signal injection test, so as to obtain test feedback performance evaluation indicators of the new energy power station; and performing comprehensive evaluation warning feedback of the performance of the new energy power station. The present invention can timely and effectively capture the dynamic response performances of new energy power stations, thus improving the robustness of performance evaluation for new energy power stations; the present invention can also perform comprehensive evaluation on the performance optimization of new energy power stations, and efficiently identify the potential performance problems and bottlenecks of new energy power stations, thereby greatly improving the reliability of emergency response processing for new energy power stations.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: HSE management system and method for systemic operating and managing wind farms
title_ko: 풍력발전단지의 체계적인 운영관리를 위한 hse 관리 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide an HSE management system capable of systematically managing HSE operation of a wind plant complex and managing safety of a worker and a method thereof. The HSE management system for systematic operation management of the wind plant complex, as the system for managing health, safety, and environment of the wind plant, comprises an operation management part, a work risk assessment part, a work risk degree and condition monitoring part, and a safety management education part. The present invention can minimize negative effects of social and environmental impacts that may occur directly/indirectly in the wind plant complex.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 풍력발전단지의 체계적인 운영관리를 위한 HSE 관리 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 풍력발전단지의 보건, 안전, 환경을 관리하는 시스템으로서, 운영관리부와, 작업위험성평가부와, 작업위험도및상태모니터링부 및 안전관리교육부를 포함하며, 상기 운영관리부는 풍력발전단지의 유지보수 작업에 투입되는 작업자의 작업 전 안전교육, 기 발생한 사고 이력, 사고 발생시 비상대응계획에 대한 정보가 저장, 관리되는 안전관리모듈과, 작업자의 정보, 건강, 교육, 개인 보호 장비에 대한 정보가 저장, 관리되는 보건관리모듈과, 풍력발전단지에 구비된 소방 수단, 화학물질, 폐기물의 운영과 해상 활동에 대한 정보가 저장, 관리되는 환경관리모듈과, 작업자가 사용하는 작업공구 및 장비, 프로젝트, 작업절차, 작업허가에 대한 정보가 저장, 관리되는 작업관리모듈 및 보건안전환경 법규, 터빈에 관한 정보가 저장, 관리되는 일반관리모듈을 포함하고, 상기 작업위험성평가부는 풍력발전기의 유지보수 작업에서 발생할 수 있는 위험요인을 JSA(Job Safety Analysis, 작업안전분석 방법), What-if, BTA(보우타이 방법) 중에서 선택되는 어느 하나 이상의 모델로 분석하고, 그 분석 데이터를 저장하는 동시에 풍력발전단지 운영사 서버로 전송하며, 상기 작업위험도및상태모니터링부는 상기 작업위험성평가부의 평가 결과 데이터를 작업관리자단말과 작업자단말로 제공하고, 작업모니터링장치와 작업자모니터리장치에 의해 작업 현장 상황과 작업자의 신체활동 정보를 수집하여 작업관리자단말로 전송하고, 상기 안전관리교육부는 개인보호장비의 사용 및 점검, 작업 유형별 안전교육, 비상상황 및 사고 유형별 현장 조치 및 비상 대응 절차에 대한 정보를 포함하되, 상기 작업모니터링장치는 작업 현장에 설치되는 CCTV, 작업 설비나 장비에 부착되어 작업자의 움직임 또는 장비의 작동 여부를 감지하는 센서를 포함하고, 상기 작업자모니터링장치는 작업자의 신체나 개인 장비에 휴대 가능하게 구비되는 액션캠이나, 스마트워치, 심박수 측정 밴드, 혈압 측정 밴드를 포함하는 스마트 웨어러블 디바이스, 또는 GPS 중에서 선택되는 어느 하나 이상을 포함하며, 상기 안전관리모듈은 작업자단말로 안전교육 정보를 제공하고, 미리 설정된 시간이 경과한 후 안전교육 이수 여부를 체크리스크 형태로 확인 요청한 다음 작업자단말로부터 안전교육 이수 여부에 대해 회신받지 못한 경우 그 결과 정보를 작업관리자단말과 보건관리모듈로 전송함으로써 풍력발전단지의 HSE를 체계적으로 관리하는 동시에 작업자의 안전을 확보할 수 있다.

title_en: Novel WiFi-VHF WVB
abstract_en: The invention provides a wireless bridge for building WiFi and VHF communication in the wireless communication field, and particularly relates to a novel WiFi-VHF WVB. By means of the novel WiFi-VHF WVB technology and product, the applied range of a radio telephone and a mobile phone can be greatly expanded, the mobile phone service function can be strengthened, particularly in the paroxysmal disaster emergency meeting environment, wireless communication can still be achieved with the WVB and a VHF even though mobile phone signals and mobile phone networks are disconnected, the Wechat function of the mobile phone is kept, and disaster relieving and emergency response processing are normally carried out. Besides the emergency communication function for emergencies, mobile wireless link between the mobile phone WiFi and the VHF wireless network can be further built through the WVB, and a user can directly use the WVB to be connected with the mobile phone to seek for helps even in the environment without mobile phone signal coverage.

title_en: To the instream flow estimate mode of Tunnel Engineering
abstract_en: Prominent (gushing) water geological disaster is one of bottleneck problems of underground engineering constructions such as tunnel construction, and the especially water prediction of constructing tunnel phase aqueous architectonic forward probe has become the important engineering science and technology problem urgently studied and solved；For above-mentioned problem, propose to research and develop the dedicated induced polarization instrument of tunnel water-bearing structure forward probe based on the resolving ideas of the geophysical methods such as induced polarization method；It is proposed the thinking that water-bearing structure positioning problem is addressed from apparent resistivity data and tunnel water-bearing structure forward probe three-D imaging method and its computational efficiency prioritization scheme based on 3 D resistivity inversion method；The basic problem (such as three-dimensional total space point source electric field solution, three-dimensional measurement observed pattern, disturbance ecology and minimizing technology, inverting target area) for answering tunnel forward probe, utilizes the validity of the three-dimensional imaging of geological structure containing water guide such as inverting Example Verification tomography, solution cavity.

title_en: New energy field group emergency treatment method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy field group emergency processing method based on machine learning, which comprises the steps of firstly integrating power generation equipment monitoring data, meteorological observation data and power grid scheduling information to form a real-time data set in a unified format, identifying equipment fault types by adopting an anomaly detection algorithm based on the data set to generate an anomaly event sequence, searching a reference case from an emergency knowledge base through similarity matching for unrecognized anomalies, expanding anomaly event description, extracting bottleneck stages and dependency relations of an emergency response path by adopting a process analysis technology to construct a critical path structure diagram, combining resource allocation data, determining a time node sequence by applying a priority ordering rule, and finally generating a customized emergency management scheme by simulating and verifying optimized personnel configuration. The invention obviously improves the efficiency and accuracy of the abnormal processing of the power generation equipment group, and ensures the running stability of the power grid and the high efficiency of emergency response.
assignees: STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;JILIN ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Multifunctional warning platform device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional warning platform device, which is characterized by comprising a shell, wherein the periphery of the shell is provided with a video acquisition module, a display module and a talkback module, the top of the shell is provided with a communication module for transmitting warning information and a lighting and warning module with warning lamp warning and strong light illumination, the middle part of the shell is provided with a warning key with one-key warning function, and the inside of the shell is provided with a power module; the power module is respectively connected with the communication module, the illumination and alarm module, the video acquisition module, the display module, the talkback module and the main control module, and the main control module is respectively connected with the alarm key, the communication module, the illumination and alarm module, the display module and the talkback module through communication lines. The utility model uses the sound, light and electricity means to quickly respond the scene alarm and frighten crimes effectively; the key areas are distributed to make up for the quick and effective response to the emergency warning situation when the basic level police strength is insufficient; the transmission bottleneck is solved by a 5G communication means.
assignees: SHANGHAI QIHE URBAN FURNITURE DEV CO LTD

title_en: Quick inflation integrated device for subway emergency evacuation air cushion
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of emergency safety, and particularly relates to a rapid inflation integrated device for an emergency evacuation air cushion of a subway, which comprises a high-pressure air cylinder, wherein a bottleneck integrated block is arranged at the bottleneck of the air cylinder, the bottleneck integrated block is connected with an ejector through a pipeline, the ejector sucks a large amount of peripheral air through the drainage effect of compressed air, the ejector rapidly ejects the peripheral air from the front section of the ejector, the air cushion is rapidly filled, and the high-pressure air cylinder, an air inlet valve, a pressure display function, a safety valve, a decompression function and a gas ejection function are integrated into a whole, so that the air cushion is rapidly filled with high-pressure air through the ejection air flow. The device has flexible design, small size and safe and reliable functions. After the control system is matched, the function of timing and quantifying the gas emission can be met, and the system is suitable for working occasions with narrow installation space and large gas demand.
assignees: JIANGSU JUNCHENG SPACE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency response personnel organization method and emergency response processing method and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency response personnel organizing method and an emergency response processing method and system thereof, which mainly aim at establishing relevant information of field on-duty personnel and qualified training certificates to adapt to sudden work safety accidents.

title_en: Running state evaluation method and system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a running state evaluation method and system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: predicting the total business data amount and transaction increment information of future time according to the historical business data amount and business change condition of the system; according to the predicted total business data amount and transaction increment information, combining with the resource information of the current system to obtain the running state index parameter of the system; determining the running state of the system according to the running state index parameter of the system; therefore, the system operation state can be simulated and predicted in advance through calculation of corresponding operation index parameters, early warning is carried out before the system operation pressure appears, and emergency response processing is carried out through modes of dynamic scheduling and expansion of system resources, plan adjustment of database execution and the like, so that stable operation of the system is ensured.

title_en: Power distribution network toughness assessment method based on dynamic disturbance assessment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network toughness assessment method based on dynamic disturbance assessment, which relates to the technical field of power systems and automation and comprises the following steps: and constructing a disturbance model to simulate a response process of the power distribution network when encountering extreme disasters or faults, wherein the disturbance model comprises various disturbance scenes such as natural disasters, power equipment faults and network attacks. According to the method, the accuracy of the toughness evaluation of the power distribution network is improved by introducing the distributed power supply evaluation method based on the dynamic response model, the response characteristics of the photovoltaic power generation and energy storage equipment in an extreme environment can be simulated in real time, and the evaluation result is ensured to be more accurate. By the aid of a flexible resource scheduling and recovery strategy optimization technology, a post-disaster recovery process is optimized based on a multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm, key loads are scheduled preferentially, recovery time is shortened, recovery efficiency of a power grid is improved, and emergency response capability and recovery capability of the power distribution network in the face of extreme disasters are enhanced.

title_en: Intelligent standard operating procedure system based on location and providing method thereof
title_ko: 위치기반 지능형 sop 시스템 및 그 제공방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A location-based intelligent SOP(Standard Operating Procedure) system and a providing method thereof are provided to enable rapid corresponding response for disaster situation and effective utilization of resources on the basis of the location of a responding staff and spatial information of a target space where a specific event occurs. CONSTITUTION: A location based intelligent SOP system includes an SOP DB(130), a communication module(120), a control module(110) and a management module(150). The SOP DB stores SOP(Standard Operating Procedure) which defines standard operating procedure in case of event occurrence. SOP corresponding to an event includes content information for each of a plurality unit SOPs and time information including execution time, execution sequence or execution period of each unit SOP. The communication module communicates with mobile terminals of responding staffs who respond to the event. The control module specifies execution staffs who execute a first unit SOP included in the SOP on the basis of report information and each location of responding staffs, and controls the communication module to transmit task information of a task corresponding to the first unit SOP to a mobile terminal of the specified execution staff. The management module grasps task execution status of the unit SOP corresponding to the task which is executed by the execution staff by receiving the task execution state information. The control module controls the communication module to transmit task information of a task corresponding to a unit SOP which will be executed next to the terminal of the execution staff. [Reference numerals] (110) Control module; (120) Communication module; (140) Space DB; (150) Management module
abstract_ko: 위치기반 지능형 SOP 시스템 및 그 제공방법이 개시된다. 상기의 위치기반 지능형 SOP 시스템은 소정의 이벤트가 발생한 경우의 표준적인 대응절차를 정의한 SOP(Standard Operating Procedure)가 저장된 SOP DB, 상기 이벤트에 대응할 대응 요원들의 모바일 단말기들과 통신하기 위한 통신모듈, 및 상기 통신모듈을 통해 상기 대응요원들 중 신고 요원의 단말기로부터 상기 이벤트의 발생에 대한 신고정보가 수신되는 경우, 상기 신고정보 및 상기 대응요원들의 위치 각각에 기초하여 상기 SOP에 포함되는 소정의 제1단위 SOP를 수행할 수행요원을 특정하고, 특정된 상기 수행요원의 모바일 단말기로 상기 제1단위 SOP에 상응하는 임무의 임무정보를 전송하도록 상기 통신 모듈을 제어하기 위한 제어모듈을 포함한다.
assignees: UNE CO LTD;YEO WOOK HYUN;PARK NAM HEE

title_en: Emergency response setting method for power grid fault system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency response setting method of a power grid fault system, which comprises the following steps: collecting power grid fault information uploaded by a user side, dividing a user fault area based on the power grid fault information, and screening fault problems of a unified area; analyzing the solution of the fault by using a fault strategy analysis method of the decision tree, calculating the expected value of each solution strategy in the database, and selecting the optimal solution strategy; and carrying out emergency response processing on the power supply equipment in the area according to the optimal solution strategy. The invention ensures the continuous power supply of all users on the fault line, and when the regional fault occurs, the fault strategy analysis method of the decision tree is used for analyzing the fault solution, calculating the expected value of each solution strategy in the database, selecting the optimal solution strategy, providing the fault solution for maintenance personnel, and improving the working efficiency of fault maintenance.
assignees: POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CENTER OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY

title_en: Intelligent water conservancy flood prevention water retaining monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent water conservancy flood prevention water retaining monitoring and early warning method and system, which belong to the technical field of water conservancy and comprise the steps of acquiring hydrological data and video image data in real time and preprocessing the data, processing the preprocessed hydrological data and video image data through a water level prediction model constructed based on a long-short-period memory network to obtain water level prediction data representing future water level change trend, performing joint analysis on the water level real-time data and the water level prediction data through a machine learning algorithm to identify water level abnormal fluctuation characteristics, and processing the water level abnormal fluctuation characteristics based on a preset multi-level early warning threshold judgment rule to generate early warning information of corresponding level. The technical scheme of the invention creatively merges technical means such as multisource heterogeneous data, deep learning water level prediction, machine learning anomaly identification, multi-stage early warning and the like, breaks through the technical bottleneck of traditional water conservancy flood prevention monitoring and early warning, and provides powerful technical support for flood disaster prevention.

title_en: Subway earthquake disaster scene construction device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a subway earthquake disaster scene construction device which comprises a model station, a vibrating table and an acquisition system. The model station is a reduced model according to the 1:10 size of the subway station; the vibration table is arranged below the model station and is used for simulating earthquake and applied to the model station; the acquisition system is used for acquiring strain data of the key supporting structure in the model station and pressure-bearing data of the key supporting structure of the model station. The invention can realize the accurate simulation of the earthquake response process under different earthquake intensities, can know the distribution rule of the collapse risk of the subway station structure under the earthquake disasters, and can also provide the subway station evacuation optimization scheme under the earthquake disasters.

title_en: 10KV overhead line induction lightning flashover risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 10kV overhead line induction lightning flashover risk assessment method and system, and belongs to the field of disaster prevention and reduction of power distribution networks. According to the method, a mathematical conversion model of the reference induction Lei Shanlao rate and the target area soil resistivity under the condition of the reference soil resistivity is established, so that rapid risk assessment is realized. The method comprises the steps of determining reference soil resistivity and corresponding reference flashover rate, constructing a flashover rate conversion relation based on an exponential type composite function, representing nonlinear characteristics of the soil resistivity and the flashover rate by limiting a coefficient value range, setting engineering applicable boundaries of wire heights and soil resistivity parameters, and building a reference flashover rate analytic type calculation model by combining lightning day data, line geometric parameters and insulation characteristics. The method replaces repeated electromagnetic field numerical calculation through the parameter mapping relation, and solves the efficiency bottleneck problem that the electromagnetic field needs to be solved repeatedly due to the change of soil parameters in the traditional method.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Air flue clearance device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of medical equipment, and particularly relates to an airway clearance device. The sputum suction device comprises a clearance device body, wherein a sputum suction pipe is connected to one side of the clearance device body, the sputum suction pipe penetrates out of the bottom of the clearance device body, one end, far away from the clearance device body, of the sputum suction pipe is provided with a connector, a respiratory mask is connected to the connector, a negative pressure device and a storage battery are arranged inside the clearance device body, the negative pressure device is connected with a first vent pipe, the first vent pipe penetrates out of the clearance device body and penetrates out of the bottom of the clearance device body, a sputum storage tank is detachably connected to the lower end of the clearance device body, and the sputum suction pipe and the first vent pipe are located in a bottleneck of the sputum storage tank. The utility model provides an air passage clearance device, which aims to facilitate the portability of the air passage clearance device so as to deal with the emergency situation in families or institutions.
assignees: CHENGDU EAST NEW DISTR GIARDIA CENTER HEALTH CENTER CHENGDU EAST NEW DISTR TRADITIONAL CHINESE AND W

title_en: Emergency call positioning system for VoIP users
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency call positioning system for VoIP users, which comprises an identification of positions (IP) device, a VoIP exchanging device, an application server, a positioning server of a service bureau end, a gateway controller, a VoIP gateway, a selective route, a public safety response point and an automatic position identification data base. The IP device is connected with the VoIP exchanging device which is connected with the application server. The application server, the gateway controller, the VoIP gateway, the selective route, the public safety response point and the automatic position identification data base are sequentially connected. The application server is connected with the positioning server of the service bureau end. The positioning server is connected with the automatic position identification data base. Calls from the VoIP device, correct position information of the VoIP device and callback numbers are routed to appropriate public safety response point directly, thereby helping a public safety response processing end to position VoIP user positions accurately and fast.
assignees: JIANGSU LAIKE INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating toughness of power distribution network in typhoon weather, storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-stage evaluation method, a storage medium and equipment for the toughness of a power distribution network in typhoon weather, wherein when no typhoon disaster occurs, the influence of the typhoon disaster on the power distribution network and the response process of the power distribution network to the typhoon disaster are simulated and analyzed, and the pre-disaster toughness index of the power distribution network is counted and calculated; in the typhoon disaster occurrence process, calculating toughness indexes in the power distribution network disaster according to real-time data returned by the power distribution network data acquisition and monitoring control system; acquiring actual data of emergency response and emergency repair of the power distribution network after the typhoon leaves the environment, and calculating a post-disaster toughness index of the power distribution network; the three-stage toughness level of the power distribution network is quantized, and the pre-disaster firmness degree, the in-disaster resisting capability, the post-disaster recovery efficiency and the comprehensive toughness of the power distribution network for coping with typhoon disasters are quantized. The method can be used for guiding reinforcement of the elements of the power distribution network when no typhoon occurs, emergency control in the process of typhoon disaster and emergency repair and power restoration after typhoon disaster, and provides quantitative basis for system planning, operation scheduling and restoration decision.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Transmission line transient response rapid calculation method based on Chebyshev quasi-spectrum-secondary boundary value coupling method
abstract_en: A transmission line transient response fast calculation method based on a Chebyshev quasi-spectrum-secondary boundary value coupling method is used for calculating a numerical value in a transmission line transient response process, firstly, a quasi-spectrum method which takes a Chebyshev polynomial as a basis function is adopted to disperse a telegraph equation in a spatial domain, and a first-order differential equation set in a time domain is obtained; on the basis, dispersing the differential equation on a time domain by adopting a 2-level 2-order or 3-order boundary value method to obtain a system discrete algebraic equation set; in order to avoid dimension disaster, the algebraic equation is solved by adopting a block tri-diagonal matrix pursuit method to obtain time domain numerical value solutions at each space discrete point. The transmission line transient response rapid calculation method based on the Chebyshev quasi-spectrum-secondary boundary value coupling method has the advantages of high calculation efficiency, short CPU time consumption and good numerical stability on the basis of ensuring the precision, can simulate the transient response process of the transmission line for a long time, and has great practical value for engineering application research of the transmission line.

title_en: Fire control unit for electric motor car
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric vehicles, in particular to a fire fighting device for an electric vehicle. The fire fighting device for the electric vehicle comprises a connecting frame, wherein a plurality of mounting holes are symmetrically formed in two ends of the connecting frame; the control processor is embedded in the middle of the connecting frame; the gas bomb is provided with a plurality of gas bomb, and a plurality of gas bomb is installed in the mounting hole one by one respectively, and the gas bomb intussuseption is filled with inert gas, and the control valve is installed to the bottleneck of giving vent to anger of gas bomb, and the end of giving vent to anger of control valve is connected with the bellows, and the one end lateral wall that the control valve was kept away from to the bellows is installed the installing support, and installs the shower nozzle of putting out a fire on the bellows, and the installing support installs the monitoring subassembly that is used for the conflagration early warning, control valve and monitoring subassembly and control treater electric connection, and control treater still electric connection has the early warning subassembly. The fire fighting device for the electric vehicle has the advantages of being capable of comprehensively monitoring the temperature and fire disaster of key parts of the vehicle body and providing early warning and emergency fire extinguishing.
assignees: BEIJING VOCATIONAL COLLEGE OF LABOUR AND SOCIAL SECURITY

title_en: Emergency handling method and system for marine dangerous chemical substance sudden accident
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency treatment method and system for marine dangerous chemical substance sudden accidents, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring reported information of sudden accidents of dangerous chemicals on the sea; determining the accident grade of the sudden accident of the marine dangerous chemicals according to the reported information and the comprehensive database of the marine dangerous chemicals; after the reported information is verified to be correct, inquiring to obtain an emergency scheme required for processing the marine dangerous chemical substance sudden accident according to the accident grade and the reported information; and starting an accident emergency response process according to the emergency scheme. The invention performs overall process visual management and control on marine dangerous chemical substance accidents and provides auxiliary decision support to solve the marine dangerous chemical substance accidents.
assignees: EAST CHINA MINERAL ENV MONITORING CENTER OF STATE OCEANIC ADMINISTRATION;DEQING TIANDAO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Borehole strain gauge in-situ calibration method based on seismic surface wave
abstract_en: The invention discloses a borehole strain gauge in-situ calibration method based on seismic surface waves, which comprises the following steps: step 1, mounting component type borehole strain gauges and three-component seismographs at intervals in the same borehole in a PBO observation table network; step 2, obtaining surface wave records of the three-component seismograph Recording of P-and S-waves from surface waves Calculating the incident seismic surface wave at the borehole R (ii) a Step 3, according to the incident earthquake strain surface wave R And component borehole strain gauge instrument strain I By incident seismic surface waves of strain R Calculating to obtain the incident seismic strain surface wave R Corresponding instrument strain calculationValue of Step 4, calculating the instrument strain actual observation value of the component type borehole strain gauge by using a least square method Calculated from the strain gauge of the instrument The difference of (a) yields a coupling coefficient matrix K. The method utilizes the surface wave record of the three-component seismograph to realize the high-precision in-situ calibration of the component type borehole strain gauge. The bottleneck problem that restricts the development of the drilling strain observation theory and technology is solved.

title_en: Method and device for quantitatively evaluating emergency response of power emergency
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to a method and a device for quantitatively evaluating emergency response of an electric power emergency, which comprises the following steps: determining emergency response levels corresponding to current response subject levels and total emergency carrying capacity corresponding to each emergency response level based on preset rules; acquiring estimated rush-repair working hours of a current power emergency; determining an emergency response strategy based on the total emergency carrying capacity corresponding to each emergency response level and the estimated emergency repair working hours; and scheduling a response subject hierarchy based on the emergency response strategy to perform emergency response processing on the current power emergency. Therefore, the quantitative grading of the emergency response grade is realized by evaluating the emergency bearing capacity of each response main body and assisting the emergency command decision, the current quantitative standard of the grading of the emergency response is enriched, various personnel can quickly and accurately deal with the emergency, the emergency and the loss and influence caused by the emergency are prevented and reduced to the maximum extent, and the standardization and the refinement of emergency treatment are realized.
assignees: STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Full-link monitoring method and system for intelligently measuring complex service scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-link monitoring method and system for intelligently measuring complex service scenes, and relates to the technical field of power grids. Establishing a virtual model of an intelligent measurement system by utilizing a digital twin technology so as to simulate and monitor key business scenes; the data packet grabbing and analyzing technology is utilized to quickly locate service processing faults, and system abnormal conditions are timely found and analyzed; adding buried point codes at key nodes of the system, and collecting service processing indexes to evaluate processing efficiency and analyze system bottlenecks; based on the monitoring result, parameter adjustment, disaster recovery design and algorithm optimization are adopted to continuously improve the accuracy, response speed and reliability of the system. The invention carries out full-link simulation and monitoring based on digital twin thinking, can discover and solve potential problems in advance, and improves the reliability and stability of the system.

title_en: Method for calculating and early warning load capacity of urban drainage pipe network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating and early warning load capacity of a town drainage pipe network, which comprises the following steps of a, analyzing the rainfall characteristics of a region and the current situation of a drainage pipe network system, providing current situation analysis and data support for establishing a drainage pipe network model and making an emergency disposal scheme, b, establishing the drainage pipe network model, providing powerful tools for analyzing the operation condition of the urban drainage pipe network system, identifying the bottleneck of the system, providing support for optimizing decision of an urban drainage emergency treatment plan, c, making the urban drainage emergency treatment plan, and providing support for urban rescue and relief when the rainfall exceeds the standard, thereby minimizing the storm disaster loss.
assignees: HANGZHOU CHENGJI PIPELINE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Water rescue equipment for fire-fighting rescue
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire rescue, in particular to water rescue equipment for fire rescue, which comprises a remote control ship body, a rescue airbag, a gas cylinder, a box body, a waterproof motor, a screw, a cone and a connecting pipe; when drowning people appear in the water area, rescue patrol personnel or hot masses can release the remote control hull into the water area to carry out remote control to the remote control hull through the remote control handle, control the remote control hull and travel to drowning people's next door rapidly, the bottleneck of gas cylinder is opened to rethread remote control handle control bottle opening structure, waterproof motor drive screw rotates, the tip of drive cone pierces the bottleneck of gas cylinder, make the inside of the inside compressed state's of gas cylinder carbon dioxide of storage fill life-saving airbag, make life-saving airbag inflation expansion, drowning people grasp remote control hull or life-saving airbag, make drowning people keep floating the state, provide sufficient time for the rescue, can reduce drowning people effectively and cause the probability of death because of unable timely rescue.
assignees: XINGHUA FANGYUAN FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Oil product moving system and oil product moving cross-region operation control method
abstract_en: The application provides an oil product moving system and a control method for oil product moving cross-region operation, wherein the oil product moving system comprises an OMS plan scheduling service and a plurality of OMS services which are independently deployed, each OMS service corresponds to a tank farm, the OMS service for managing oil movement operations within the tank farm, and the OMS schedule service for coordinating and monitoring oil movement operations across the tank farm. The application solves the problems of performance bottleneck, high safety risk and high disaster recovery processing difficulty of an OMS system in the prior art when the oil product moving operation of a large-scale oil refining chemical plant is executed.

title_en: Power grid cascading failure deduction and elastic recovery collaborative decision method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a collaborative decision method and a collaborative decision system for power grid cascading failure deduction and elastic recovery, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a state model of each power grid element in extreme weather, and acquiring the state transition probability of each power grid element in continuous time according to the state model; the method comprises the steps of constructing a system cascading failure evolution model under extreme weather according to state transition probability, calculating line real-time outage probability under a wind power grid-connected scene according to the system cascading failure evolution model, constructing an optimal power flow model according to the line real-time outage probability with minimized load shedding amount as a target, simulating a derating operation response process after grid failure to obtain a load reduction strategy of a system under each failure state, establishing a post-disaster emergency recovery model based on the load reduction strategy and system topology constraint, and determining a fault repair time sequence and a load recovery sequence. The invention can obviously improve the risk perception capability, decision scientificity and recovery efficiency of the power grid in an extreme event.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NINGBO POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Escape guiding method and system based on firefighting multi-physical-field analysis and AR equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of escape guiding scheme design, in particular to an escape guiding method and system based on firefighting multi-physical-field analysis and AR equipment. Aiming at the defects of path planning, survivor positioning and cutting, dynamic risk response lag and the like in the traditional rescue, vital signs are detected through multi-source sensor fusion, and an optimal rescue path is generated in millisecond-level time by combining real-time coupling simulation of a stress field, a toxic gas diffusion field and a fire disaster thermal flow field of a building structure. The system automatically classifies priorities after detecting the vital body signals, supports the through-wall mode to quickly approach to high-risk survivors, and synchronously optimizes the multi-objective traversal sequence. The guiding path is dynamically projected to a visual field interface of the rescue personnel through the AR equipment, and the heartbeat frequency domain visualization and the risk chromaticity warning are fused. The scheme breaks through the bottleneck of artificial experience decision making, realizes closed loop intelligent response from physical sign perception to path execution, and greatly improves rescue timeliness, target hit rate and action safety in complex disaster environments.
assignees: QINGDAO JUNHAI IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fault positioning system based on power distribution network topology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution network fault positioning, in particular to a fault positioning system based on power distribution network topology. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a deep learning analysis module, a topology analysis module, a fault positioning module and a decision support module. The data acquisition module acquires operation data in real time through a sensor network and extracts waveform images through an image processing technology. The deep learning analysis module learns spatial features in the image using the convolutional neural network and the attention mechanism to focus on the fault-related region. The topology analysis module identifies topology anomalies using a graph neural network. And the fault locating module combines the analysis results and rapidly locates faults through a graph searching algorithm. The decision support module generates a coping strategy and an optimized maintenance plan. The invention not only can improve the speed and accuracy of fault location, but also can optimize maintenance and emergency response processes, and finally realizes high-efficiency, intelligent and safety improvement of power grid operation.
assignees: XIAMEN HERETOP INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of intelligent concrete, which pours, sets template method for managing security
abstract_en: A kind of intelligent concrete, which pours, sets template method for managing security, belongs to technical field of concrete construction.Method is applied to cloud system, cloud system receives the signal for carrying out self-template installation end sensing mould group, it include: to pour the safe sex determination for setting formwork for template installation end sensing module signal progress concrete after concrete pours and sets template installation: obtaining structure change numerical value after algorithm calculates through template installation end sensing module signal；Compared with by structure change numerical value safety value corresponding with cloud data bank, if structure change numerical value is greater than the safety value, determine that concrete pours that set formwork dangerous, and send caution signal；Otherwise determine that concrete pours and set formwork safety, then the safety value of cloud data bank is updated to current structure variation numerical value.The present invention can obtain the sensing signal of template installation end in real time, and progress concrete in side pours the safe sex determination for setting formwork beyond the clouds, can alert in time, make emergency response processing convenient for construction personnel.

title_en: Illegal invasion snapshot recorder
abstract_en: The invention belongs to an illegal intrusion video picture snapshot recorder which is based on the existing electronic information technologies such as an alarm, a camera, an infrared lamp, liquid crystal display and the like and integrates and designs related equipment and equipment into an integrated machine by applying an industrial design concept. The invention breaks through the bottleneck that the prior alarm device frequently generates the technical false alarm and the artificial forgetting false alarm, innovatively provides that the video picture is adopted for collecting the illegal invasion event, increases the functions of invasion behavior detection and video picture snapshot storage and recording, can realize the snapshot and alarm of the illegal invasion alarm condition event, and is convenient for a district duty room or a public security department to take corresponding measures. The invention has the advantages of high snapshot precision, humanized design, diversified fortification modes, high sensitivity and convenient installation and use, is a great innovation for the technical field of image detection, and plays a positive promoting role and profound influence on a social management mechanism combining public safety source treatment, dynamic management and emergency treatment.

title_en: Quota management method and quota management system for distributed file system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a quota management method and a quota management system for a distributed file system. In the application, when the target object quota creation requests, the main quota MDS equipment which is matched with the target object quota creation requests is dynamically selected according to the load balancing strategy, so that the problem that a single OSD equipment becomes a performance bottleneck is avoided. A master quota instance and a slave quota instance are established for the target object in the master quota MDS device and the slave quota MDS device, and the master quota management architecture with multiple slaves enables quota application and deduction operation to be mainly completed on the local slave quota instance, so that communication overhead of a cross node and access pressure to a central node are greatly reduced, and writing incapability caused by performance bottlenecks under a high concurrency scene is avoided. The quota information is stored permanently, so that quota information recovery can be performed by quota management during failure, disaster recovery capacity is improved, and a basis is provided for obtaining accurate residual quota.

title_en: Underground water multi-target calculation method based on ground settlement substitution model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of hydrology and water resources, and discloses a ground subsidence area underground water simulation-optimization calculation solving technology based on an adaptive substitution model, namely an underground water multi-target calculation model (SUB-KELM & SMOMA) based on a ground subsidence substitution model.
