The technology adopts a ground subsidence simulation subprogram SUB-WT in an underground water simulation program MODFLOW-2005 to simulate the ground subsidence process, and adopts an extreme learning machine method KELM to train a ground subsidence substitution model. The optimization model adopts a wide, stable and effective optimization algorithm NSGAII. In order to improve the accuracy of numerical prediction of dominant individuals, a neighborhood search and adaptive KELM method is adopted to train a ground settlement model. The SUB-KELM & SMOMA is the first problem considering the bottleneck of large-scale calculation of the ground subsidence model, and the ground subsidence substitution model is coupled with the optimization solving model based on the evolutionary algorithm, so that a fixed technical method system can be provided for solving two core problems of reasonable development and utilization of underground water resources in a ground subsidence area and ground subsidence prevention, control and disaster reduction.

title_en: Save automatic water intaking device
abstract_en: It the utility model is related to fresh water collecting device field, more particularly to a kind of energy-conservation automatic water intaking device.Save automatic water intaking device, including bottle, the bottle includes bottleneck, bottleneck and bottle tripe, it also includes the pole beacon being arranged in bottle and water pipe and the water pump being arranged on outside bottle, the bottleneck is provided with ventilation bottle stopper, and pole beacon support is fixed with the bottleneck madial wall, and the pole beacon stretches into a bottle tripe bottom through ventilation bottle stopper and pole beacon support；The water side of the water pipe is connected with water pump, and the water inlet end of the water pipe stretches into a bottle tripe bottom.The energy-conservation automatic water intaking device is simple in construction, in emergency situations, fresh water is collected by simply assembling.

title_en: Method and device for calculating reflectivity of earth surface
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for calculating the reflectivity of an earth surface, which are used for HJ-1A/B satellites. The method comprises the following steps of: 1) acquiring the optical thickness of atmospheric aerosol by using middle-infrared bands of an HJ-1B charge coupled device (CCD) and an infrared camera on the basis of a dark target method, and acquiring the optical thickness of the atmospheric aerosol by using an HJ-1A large-width quick revisit characteristic on the basis of an invariant target method; 2) calculating a solar zenith angle and a solar azimuth angle and observing the zenith angle and the azimuth angle on the basis of an HJ-1A/binary extensible markup language (BXML) file and image data; 3) simulating radiance Lm on a star through moderate resolution atmospheric transmission (MODTRAN) on the basis of parameters acquired in the steps 1) and 2); 4) establishing an earth surface reflectivity lookup table through the step 3); and 5) calibrating the atmosphere by using the lookup table according to an atmospheric parameter and an image to be calibrated. By the method and the device, the absorbing and scattering performance of the atmosphere on a remote sensing image can be effectively eliminated, the reflectivity of an earth surface target can be recovered, the bottleneck of industry application is eliminated, and the application range of environment disaster reduction moonlet data is further expanded.

title_en: Photovoltaic power station emergency fault remote quick response processing system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a photovoltaic power station emergency fault remote quick response processing system and method, and relates to the technical field of emergency processing. Photovoltaic power plant emergency fault long-range quick response processing system, including emergent expert storehouse and continuous monitoring, emergent expert storehouse both way junction has high-speed communication module, high-speed communication module both way junction has emergent group in scene and detection switch sensor data, high-speed communication module includes 5G communication chip, memory, radio frequency circuit and positioning system, it is connected with the fault occurrence to last the monitoring, the fault occurrence is connected with the casualties and switches the UPS system. The photovoltaic power station emergency fault remote quick response processing system and method solve the problems that after an emergency situation occurs, an expert is difficult to command on the spot at the first time, so that troubleshooting processing work is difficult to carry out in time and the emergency plan response speed is low, and realize quick response and remote processing of the emergency fault of the photovoltaic power station.
assignees: HAINAN SILAN LOW CARBON INVEST CO LTD;HAINAN SLAND LOW CARBON RES CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Cableway transfer station passenger flow and emergency evacuation simulation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a cableway transfer station passenger flow and emergency evacuation simulation method, which comprises the following steps: creating a passenger flow evacuation model of the cableway transfer station in a simulation software program; creating a passenger flow line graph of pedestrians on the passenger flow evacuation model of the cableway transfer station; setting simulation parameters including pedestrian space, walking speed, cableway parameters and passenger flow parameters; and simulating the situation and distribution of pedestrian flows in the cableway transfer station based on the created passenger flow evacuation model, the set passenger flow line graph and the set simulation parameters in the simulation software program. Adopting simulation methods such as discrete simulation, multi-agent modeling simulation and the like to dynamically simulate passenger flow lines and emergency evacuation of a cableway transfer station, and establishing a passenger flow and emergency evacuation simulation model; the passenger flow density of the cableway transfer station, the emergency evacuation time and the bottleneck are counted and analyzed, and the schemes can be compared through parameter adjustment.
assignees: CHINA ENFI ENG CORP;CHINA NONFERROUS ENG CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for efficiently preprocessing and calling nuclear accident result evaluation data based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nuclear emergency informatization processing, in particular to a method for quickly preprocessing unified structuring and format conversion of multisource monitoring data in a nuclear accident emergency response process, which comprises the steps of S1, multiscale data input, S2, automatic recognition and scheduling, S3, decoding and variable extraction, S4, deletion detection and interpolation restoration, S5, standardized structure conversion, S6, JSON output and interface adaptation. The invention is mainly applied to nuclear accident data acquisition, rapid format conversion, physical quantity extraction, missing data interpolation and structure unification, is suitable for rapid analysis and unification expression of weather observation data, radiation dose monitoring data and GRIB-format global weather forecast products, and belongs to the technical category of data structure standardization and intelligent preprocessing in nuclear emergency scenes.

title_en: System for assessing procedure compliance level of human operators in nuclear power plants and method thereof
title_ko: 원전 운전원의 절차진행 준수성 평가 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for assessing a procedure compliance level in an emergency situation of a nuclear power plant, capable of quantitatively grasping a standard procedure compliance level of an emergency situation procedure of operators in the nuclear power plant. The present invention includes a first recognition unit which is attached to each operator, a second recognition unit which is mounted on each nuclear power equipment and communicates with the first recognition unit, a database which stores information related to a standard procedure which each operator performs with regard to each nuclear power equipment, and a server which communicates with the second recognition unit and assesses the standard procedure stored in the database and the actual procedure of each operator by the second recognition unit. [Reference numerals] (10) Tag; (20,AA) Nuclear power equipment; (21,BB) Reader; (40) Server; (CC) Operator
abstract_ko: 운전원들이 원전의 비상상황 절차서의 표준절차를 얼마나 잘 준수하는지를 정량적으로 파악할 수 있는 원전의 비상상황시 절차진행 준수성 평가 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 운전원에 부착되는 제1 인식부, 각각의 원전장비에 장착되며 상기 제1 인식부와 통신 가능한 제2 인식부, 상기 각각의 원전장비에 대해 개개의 운전원이 수행할 표준절차에 관한 정보가 저장된 데이터베이스, 상기 제2 인식부와 통신 가능하고, 상기 데이터베이스에 저장된 표준절차와 상기 제2 인식부에 따른 개개의 운전원이 수행하는 실제절차를 평가하는 서버를 포함하는 구성을 마련한다.
assignees: KOREA ATOMIC ENERGY RES;KOREA HYDRO & NUCLEAR POWER CO

title_en: Intelligent security method and device for industrial park, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of Internet of things, and provides an intelligent security method, an intelligent security device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for an industrial park. The method comprises the steps of carrying out space-time alignment and feature fusion on sensor data to obtain environment perception data, carrying out face feature recognition and hierarchical authorization processing on the environment perception data to obtain regional personnel data, carrying out disaster prediction coupling on the regional personnel data and the environment perception data to obtain risk evolution data, carrying out evacuation path planning on the risk evolution data and the regional personnel data to obtain evacuation navigation data, and carrying out emergency response processing on the evacuation navigation data and real-time position coordinates of personnel to obtain a device control instruction set. The application realizes refinement, real-time and automation in all links of environment perception, identity management, risk prediction, evacuation navigation and emergency response, and improves the safety protection capability of an industrial park.
assignees: ANKE PREFERRED SHENZHEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for inhibiting spontaneous combustion of coal in goaf under low-oxygen environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for inhibiting spontaneous combustion of coal in a goaf under a low-oxygen environment, which systematically establish hydrogen as an ultra-early core early warning index of spontaneous combustion of coal under the low-oxygen environment for the first time, and greatly advance an early warning window by combining the change rate and the coupling relation with temperature, thereby solving the industrial problem that the sensitivity of the traditional CO index is seriously insufficient under the low-oxygen environment. In the prevention and control stage, the limitation of the traditional plane three-band theory is broken through, and a three-dimensional risk area intelligent positioning and targeting treatment system is established. The engineering bottlenecks such as difficulty in inerting and cooling in a high-level cavity area, difficulty in adhesion of plugging materials of a steeply inclined coal wall and the like are effectively solved through a stepped process of tracking and leakage detection, LCo  2  targeted inerting and cooling and long-acting plugging of functional colloid. The system has self-learning and continuous optimizing capacity based on data feedback, and the mine fire prevention and extinguishing work is basically changed from passive response, experience driving to active early warning, data driving and intelligent decision making, so that the safety guarantee and emergency response efficiency are improved.
assignees: QINGHAI ENERGY DEV GROUP CO LTD

title_en: System and method for emergency rescue using the space web
title_ko: 공간 웹 기반의 구조 요청 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a system for enabling an application installed in a user terminal device carried by a victim or a user to report damage and performing a corresponding procedure in a damage situation such as a crime, a vehicle accident, or a disaster. The present invention suggests the method and the system for immediately delivering the situation to a relevant agency and person when an accident, an injury, and a disaster occur.
abstract_ko: 범죄 피해, 자동차 사고 또는 재난 등의 피해 상황에서 상기 피해자가 소지한 사용자단말장치에 설치된 앱이 스스로, 또는 상기 사용자가 상기 피해를 신고하고, 그에 따른 대응 절차가 진행될 수 있는 방법 및 시스템이다.

title_en: Multi-functional medical table of emergency department nurse
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-functional medical table of emergency department nurse relates to medical equipment technical field, which comprises an outer shell, the top of shell is provided with time display screen, the top of shell is provided with touch operation screen, the top of shell is provided with the emergency response ware, the top of shell is provided with the emergency speaker, the top of shell is provided with the megaphone, the top of shell is provided with audio button, the outward appearance of shell is provided with audio player, the inside of shell is provided with the mainboard, the top of mainboard is provided with orientation module, the spread groove has been seted up to the surface of shell, the internal fixed surface of spread groove is connected with the USB interface. This multi-functional medical table of emergency department nurse, through the structure of shell, limiting plate, standing groove, connecting axle and medical emery wheel, the rotation through medical emery wheel can cut the bottleneck of ampoule, and the medical personnel of being convenient for use ampoule.

title_en: Dynamic evaluation method for embankment dangerous cases
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic evaluation method of a dyke dangerous case, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a dyke basic data base, carrying out data fusion on multi-source heterogeneous dyke basic information, and standardizing various index data of the dyke to form a dyke dangerous case operation data base; constructing a dike disaster-causing risk factor, and evaluating disaster-causing risks of different dike segments by taking the evaluation index system of the weight into consideration; carrying out dynamic security risk assessment on the observed or identified dike dangerous situation sections by adopting a constructed evaluation index system, and starting different dangerous situation response processing mechanisms according to different risk grades of the dike dangerous situation sections; constructing a dangerous case risk visualization system based on a dyke dangerous case operation and maintenance database, and establishing a mobile terminal transmission port of a mobile phone to acquire a dyke history dangerous case processing scheme; the dangerous dike section and the processing scheme are synchronously input into the dike dangerous case operation and maintenance knowledge base to keep real-time dynamic update. The method has the advantages of quick on-site dynamic evaluation response, high index evaluation precision and quick response of the accident handling scheme.
assignees: CHANGJIANG INST SURVEY PLANNING DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Portable sterilization water purifier
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a portable water purifier that disinfects, including soft water storage bag and bottle lid, soft water storage bag inner wall is provided with the water purification material layer that disinfects, the bottle lid activity sets up on the bottleneck of soft water storage bag, be provided with the aperture on the bottle lid, the straw has been inserted in the aperture, still be provided with the fag end on the bottle lid. The utility model discloses a quick, high-efficient, low-priced water purification to long service life, the range of application is extensive, can solve quick, high-efficient safe water purification under the emergency such as after disasters such as earthquake, flood to and the drinking water under outdoor special conditions such as mountain-climbing, exploration.

title_en: Parameter synchronization optimization method and system suitable for distributed machine learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a parameter synchronization optimization method and system suitable for distributed machine learning. A machine learning algorithm achieved in a parameter server distribution mode is used for overcoming bottlenecks, such as a large amount of parallel machine learning training time delay caused by insufficient network and parameter server resources, of an existing algorithm in the parameter synchronization process. The system comprises a resource monitoring and distributing module at the parameter server end, a parameter maintaining module at the parameter server end, server resource request modules of all working nodes, parameter synchronization time interval control modules of the working nodes, non-synchronization time accumulation modules of the working nodes, parameter calculation modules of the working nodes and parameter synchronization modules of the working node. According to the parameter synchronization optimization method and system, different synchronization time intervals are selected for the different working nodes to avoid request emergency situations by monitoring resource occupancy conditions of a parameter server; meanwhile, it is guaranteed that the selected time intervals can meet the requirements for communication frequency reducing and training accurate rate guaranteeing at the same time, and the bottlenecks of an existing distributed machine learning system in the parameter synchronization process are effectively avoided.

title_en: Method suitable for sea air coupling mode ENSO forecasting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method suitable for mode prediction ENSO, which comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining at least 5 initialization parameters by changing the intensity value of an initialization parameter SST-nudging; s2, generating a group of first initial value sets consisting of at least 10 initial values by each initialization parameter, and obtaining five groups of first initial value sets and at least 50 initial values; s3, respectively selecting at least one initial value from each group of first initial value sets to form a second initial value set at least consisting of 10 initial values, and acquiring a forecast result of the second initial value set; and S4, counting the forecast results corresponding to the second initial value set to obtain the final forecast result. The advantages are that: the mode ENSO forecasting technique is improved, the forecasting bottleneck of the traditional scheme is broken through, and the mode forecasting technique is improved; meanwhile, the ENSO forecasting technique of the global sea-gas coupling mode is improved, the forecasting and early warning of climate disasters are facilitated, and the loss of personnel and property is reduced.

title_en: Automatic police enforcement method of illegal-stopping and parking vehicle having cctv for preventing crime using multiple camera and system thereof
title_ko: 다중 카메라를 이용한 방범용 씨씨티브이 기능을 갖는 불법주정차 무인 자동 단속방법 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: A system and a method for cracking down on illegal parking having a CCTV(Closed-Circuit Television) function using multiple cameras are provided to enhance cracking down by obtaining images of dead zones using an auxiliary camera. Plural images at regulation areas set on roads are obtained as analog images through plural fixed cameras(S1). The obtained analog images are converted into analog images through an image mixer(S2). The analog images of the image mixer is converted into digital images to be processed in an image transmission device and then the converted digital images is transmitted to a control module via a hub(S3). By analyzing images transmitted from the control module in a detection module, a vehicle or a human is detected and then corresponding 2-D position coordinates are generated(S4). The 2-D position coordinates are converted into 3-D position coordinates through a position mapping module(S5). PTZ(Pan/Tilt/Zoom) camera control modules are controlled by the control module and a PTZ camera is moved to a detected coordinate. Then an objector is traced(S6).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 다중 카메라를 이용한 방범용 CCTV 기능을 갖는 불법주정차 무인 자동 단속방법 및 그 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 불법주정차 차량 및 방범용 무인 단속시스템에 있어서, 검지용 고정카메라들 시계의 검지 사각지대 없이 도로에 설정된 복수의 감시영역의 영상을 복수의 각 검지용 고정카메라로 입력받아 1개의 디지털 검지 영상으로 출력하는 단속 및 방범 현장영상획득 장치; 단속 및 방범 현장영상획득 장치로부터 디지털 검지 영상을 입력받아 영상분석을 수행하여 차량 혹은 사람 등의 관심객체를 검지하고 추적하며 관심객체의 2D 이동좌표를 출력하는 관심객체 검지모듈; 관심객체의 2D좌표를 입력받아 단속현장 실세계의 3D좌표를 출력하는 좌표매핑모듈; 좌표매핑모듈의 3D좌표를 입력받아 단속 또는 방법용 PTZ카메라를 제어하여 관심객체를 근접 추적, 촬영, 녹화할 수 있도록 지원하는 단속 또는 방범용 PTZ카메라 제어모듈; 단속 및 방범 현장영상획득 장치, 관심객체검지모듈, 좌표매핑모듈, 단속 또는 방범용 PTZ카메라 제어모듈, 이들을 제어하는 현장제어모듈로 구성된 영상객체검지장치; 보조 단속용 카메라의 영상을 디지털화하고 외부장치와의 오디오/비디오/제어 신호를 입출력시키는 영상전송장치, 및 상기 영상객체검지장치와 영상전송장치 및 원격의 센터운영모듈 간에 유무선 데이터신호로 송수신하는 허브를 포함하는 시스템과, 상기 시스템을 이용하여 불법주정차 및 방범현장의 무인 자동 단속방법을 제공함으로써, 복수의 검지용 고정카메라 영상에 대한 영상분석을 위한 계산량을 최소화하여 실시간 관심객체 검지 및 추적을 통한 단속  및 방범이 가능하고, 시스템의 효과대비 구성비용을 절감하여 유지보수가 용이하며, 보조 단속용 카메라로 불법주정차 단속 사각지대를 제거하여 기존 시스템의 단속 불가능에 기인한 인적 시간적인 비용을 줄이고 도로교통의 병목현상을 유발하는 요인을 제거하여 원활한 교통소통을 도모하며, 인명 안전사고를 예방하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Energy storage system state monitoring method, system and related device
abstract_en: A method for monitoring state of energy storage system includes obtaining relevant data of energy storage system monitoring, carrying out prediction residual analysis on relevant data of energy storage system monitoring to obtain average value and standard deviation of relevant data of energy storage system monitoring, calculating residual average value and residual standard deviation according to average value and standard deviation of relevant data of energy storage system monitoring to set up multi-stage warning threshold, carrying out hierarchical warning according to multi-stage warning threshold and completing state monitoring of energy storage system. According to the invention, unified multi-level warning threshold values and response flows are formulated, so that the standardization and standardization of operation and maintenance work of the energy storage system are promoted, the operation and maintenance efficiency and quality are improved, the risk of human errors is reduced, enough resources are ensured to deal with the emergency, meanwhile, the resource waste in the non-emergency situation is avoided, the bottleneck and the low-efficiency link in the energy storage system are identified through residual analysis, the charging and discharging strategies are optimized, and the reliability and the stability of power supply are improved.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;HANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Route marker device for pedestrian guidance and disaster response method using the same
title_ko: 보행자 안내용 경로 마커 장치 및 이를 이용한 재난대응 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a route marker device for pedestrian guidance and a disaster response method using the same, which can provide proper evacuation information for a safety vulnerable group in a disaster situation. The route marker device for pedestrian guidance comprises: a plurality of route markers installed at prescribed intervals along a walking path, and guiding the moving direction of a user by turning on a guidance light; a plurality of sensors installed near the walking path to collect environment information; a disaster situation monitoring unit using the environment information to monitor a disaster situation occurring near the walking path; and a disaster response processing unit controlling lighting operations of the plurality of route markers to guide the evacuation of the user to at least one evacuation facility located near the walking path if an occurrence of the disaster situation is detected.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 보행자 안내용 경로 마커 장치 및 이를 이용한 재난대응 방법에 관한 것으로, 상기 장치는 재난대응을 위한 보행자 안내용 경로 마커 장치는 보행로를 따라 소정의 간격마다 설치되고, 유도등의 점등을 통해 사용자의 이동 방향을 유도하는 복수의 경로 마커들, 상기 보행로의 인근에 설치되어 환경 정보를 수집하는 복수의 센서들, 상기 환경 정보를 이용하여 상기 보행로의 인근에서 발생하는 재난상황을 모니터링하는 재난상황 모니터링부 및 상기 재난상황의 발생이 검출된 경우 상기 복수의 경로 마커들의 점등 동작을 제어하여 상기 보행로의 인근에 위치한 적어도 하나의 대피시설까지 상기 사용자의 대피를 안내하는 재난대응 처리부를 포함한다.

title_en: Cloud disaster backup service quality evaluation method for hope weighting and fuzzy mathematics
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cloud disaster recovery service quality evaluation method for expected weighting and fuzzy mathematics, which comprises the steps of responding to a cloud disaster recovery service quality evaluation request initiated by a user or detecting a preset disaster recovery service evaluation trigger signal by a service system, acquiring service quality scoring data of the service system based on a preset evaluation index, converting the service quality scoring data into a fuzzy relation matrix by adopting a parabolic membership function, and carrying out hierarchical weighted calculation by combining the preset evaluation index weight and the fuzzy relation matrix to generate a quantized cloud disaster recovery service comprehensive evaluation result. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-dimensional hierarchical index system, comprehensively covering the functionality, reliability and user experience of cloud disaster recovery service, objectively determining index weights by using a reverse cloud model, reducing subjective deviation, effectively modeling fuzzy scores of users by using K parabolic membership functions, improving evaluation accuracy, generating traceable comprehensive scores by hierarchical weighted calculation, identifying service bottlenecks and optimizing disaster recovery performance.

title_en: Apparatus and methods for distributing and storing electronic access clients
title_ko: 전자 액세스 클라이언트들을 분배하며 저장하기 위한 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus and a method of efficiently distributing and storing access control clients in a network. In one embodiment, an electronic subscriber identity module (eSIM) distribution network infrastructure in which access clients include eSIMs, and which performs uniqueness and preservation of eSIM, prevents bottleneck congestion by distributing network traffics, and provides suitable disaster recovery capacities is described. In one modification, the eSIMs are safely stored in electronic universal integrated circuit card (eUICC) appliances for securing uniqueness and preservation of eSIM. The accesses to the eUICC appliances are performed through a plurality of eSIM storages, which secures distribution of network loads. A permanent storage for archiving and backup among other activities is also described.
abstract_ko: 네트워크 내에서 액세스 제어 클라이언트들을 효율적으로 분배하며 저장하기 위한 장치 및 방법이 개시된다.  일 실시예에서, 액세스 클라이언트들은 eSIM들(electronic Subscriber Identity Modules)을 포함하고, eSIM 고유성 및 보존을 시행하고, 네트워크 트래픽을 분배하여 "병목" 정체를 방지하며, 타당한 재해 복구 능력들을 제공하는 eSIM 분배 네트워크 인프라스트럭처가 기술된다.  일 변형에서, eSIM들은 eSIM 고유성 및 보존을 보장하는 eUICC(electronic Universal Integrated Circuit Card) 어플라이언스들에 안전하게 저장된다.  eUICC 어플라이언스들에 대한 액세스는 다수의 eSIM 저장소들을 통해 행해지는데, 이는 네트워크 부하가 분배되는 것을 보장한다.  다른 액티비티들 중에서 아카이빙 및 백업을 위해 영속 스토리지가 또한 기술된다.

title_en: Oxygenation hood
abstract_en: The invention relates to an oxygenation hood, which belongs to the technical field of fire and accident prevention rescue devices and equipment. The oxygenation hood consists of a double-layer hood body, a portable oxygen bottle, an oxygen pipe, a hood neck body, a sealing belt buckle, a sealing belt, a hood neck edge, a hood-in air pipe, a hood-inflating air pipe, a nose part, eyes parts, a hood inner-layer wall, a hood wall chamber, a hood outer-layer wall, an oxygen valve and an oxygen bottleneck. The oxygenation hood is provided with the owned portable oxygen bottle; when a person is in distress, the oxygenation hood carried by a vehicle is worn, the oxygen valve is opened, so that oxygen in the portable oxygen bottle can be discharged from the oxygen bottleneck and enters in the double-layer hood body through the oxygen pipe, so as to supply the necessary oxygen required by breathing for the person in distress in a short time, meanwhile, the gas expired by the person is inflated into the hood wall chamber, so as to provide a buoyancy force-increasing device for the person in distress after the vehicle drops into water, thereby prolonging the self-rescue time of the person in distress and achieving the purpose of reducing the personal casualties after disasters. The oxygenation hood is simple to operate, convenient to carry, low in cost and strong in practicability.
assignees: CHANGSHU NANJING NORMAL UNIV DEV RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Counter pressure medical bottle and dosing device and injection device assembly thereof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a counter pressure medical bottle and a dosing device and an injection device assembly thereof. The counter pressure medical bottle comprises a bottle body of which the inner wall is a straight barrel; a first piston is arranged at a position close to a bottleneck in the bottle body; a blind hole is formed in the center of the outer bottom surface of the first piston; the bottleneck is provided with an outer edge and a sealing cover which is fixed to the outer edge and is used for preventing the first piston from falling off. Another counter pressure medical bottle further comprises a second piston arranged on the middle part of the bottle body, wherein a push plate is coated in the second piston; a needle guide hole is formed in the center of the push plate. When the counter pressure medical bottle is used together with the dosing device and the injection device assembly thereof, the problem of secondary pollution in a dosing process and an injecting process can be solved systematically; the counter pressure medical bottle is suitable for urban hospitals, areas with poor sanitation conditions such as mountain areas and rural areas, and fields, naval ships, battlegrounds and disaster areas.

title_en: Fire -suppression bottle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fire -suppression bottle, which comprises a bottle body and a bottle cap. The bottle is breakable bottle, the bottle lid is fixed to be set up on the bottleneck of bottle. This fire -suppression bottle only seals the fire extinguishing agent with the bottle lid, and the body is easy broken bottle. Fire -suppression bottle is simply easy -to -use in the event, throws to put out a fire to burning things which may cause a fire disaster department and flees for one's life.

title_en: Portable emergency lighting detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable emergency lighting detector which comprises a lighting detection main body, a back plate, connecting seats, bolts, a carrying component and a stabilizing component, wherein the back plate is arranged on the back side of the lighting detection main body, the two connecting seats are symmetrically arranged on the upper surface of the back plate, the bolts are in threaded connection with threaded holes formed in the surfaces of the connecting seats, one ends of the bolts penetrate through the connecting seats and are in threaded holes formed in the surfaces of the lighting detection main body, and the stabilizing component is arranged at the top end of the back plate. Therefore, the emergency lighting detector solves the problem that the prior art cannot carry with hands and effectively release hands of a detector, becomes a key bottleneck for limiting working efficiency and threatening personnel safety in emergency rescue and outdoor operation, and can be quickly fixed on the outer side of a waist or a knapsack and the like without complex binding or installing processes.
assignees: WUHAN WUCHANG CONSTRUCTION ENG QUALITY SAFETY DETECTION CO LTD

title_en: Communication device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a communication device capable of returning a call-busy response automatically to an incoming call from a caller who is not to be preferentially connected regardless of whether the own device is actually used or not for a predetermined period of time after the communication device has received an emergency earthquake alert or disaster information and has completed an informing operation.SOLUTION: A communication device includes: communication means 15 that is connected to a communication line and carries out a communication processing; reception means 11a that receives disaster information from the line by using the communication means 15; and control means 11 that controls the communication means 15 in such a manner that the communication means 15 automatically performs a call-busy response processing to the incoming call from a caller who is not to be preferentially connected for a predetermined period of time after the reception means 11a finishes informing the user of the received disaster information in the case where the communication means 15 receives an incoming signal from the line.

title_en: A kind of computational methods of the compressed-air foam intelligent cannon jet angle of pitch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of computational methods of the compressed-air foam intelligent cannon jet angle of pitch.Automatic monitoring surrounding fire condition after compressed-air foam intelligent cannon installation, when fire occurs, gun muzzle alignment burning things which may cause a fire disaster completes fire location positioning, control system feedback obtains the burning things which may cause a fire disaster orientation angle of now gun barrel, then the angle of pitch needed for compressed-air foam jet is ejected into burning things which may cause a fire disaster point is calculated according to computational methods, finally controls servomotor to complete the adjustment of gun barrel angle.The present invention breach this complex fluid of compressed-air foam from motion tracking, pinpoint technical bottleneck, compressed air foam extinguishing technology is realized to automation, the development of intelligent direction, the novel fire extinguishing equipment with the function " from motion tracking, precision strike, quick extinguishing " can be provided for the typical case such as vcehicular tunnel, garage, hangar place.The computational methods are easy and effective, and data calculation complexity is relatively low, can in real time be completed to calculate by the control system of compressed-air foam intelligent cannon.

title_en: Intelligent emergency response method based on multi-agent simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent emergency response method based on multi-agent simulation. The method is used for simulating a human emergency command system aiming at sudden emergency events, constructing a three-layer organization structure comprising a command center, a decision layer and an execution layer, distributing roles and responsibilities for each level of agents, simultaneously configuring a shared database for storing and sharing information and knowledge among the agents, updating situation description of the emergency events in an iterative manner by a plurality of agents to optimize the generated emergency response strategy, carrying out disfigurement on the emergency response process of each level of agents after the final updated emergency response strategy is formed, and carrying out structural processing on disfigurement results and new knowledge and updating the disfigurement results into the shared database to complete intelligent emergency response based on multi-agent simulation.

title_en: Blood transport method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical treatment and health, and discloses a blood transferring method which comprises the steps of collecting unlocking state of a blood transport case, blood storage bag information, temperature in the blood transport case and positioning data at high frequency, transmitting encrypted data to a cloud platform through 5G, transmitting the encrypted data to the cloud platform through a Beidou short message module under the condition of no 5G signal, transmitting the encrypted data to the cloud platform, and reversely decrypting the received data by the cloud platform to obtain real data of the blood transport case, so that the safety of blood information and related information transmission of the blood transport case can be ensured, and workers can perform emergency response processing.

title_en: Mobile payment and digital currency seamless docking system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile payment and digital currency seamless docking system, which comprises: the multi-mode payment module, the off-line transaction engine and the edge calculation optimization engine are used for realizing compatibility support of indirect payment and off-line transaction scenes in equipment through integrating NFC, two-dimensional codes and a central digital currency wallet function, and constructing a dual-promotion framework of payment success rate and transaction timeliness; the invention can creatively integrate dynamic protocol conversion, privacy calculation and hardware-level security isolation technology by constructing a multi-mode payment fusion architecture and an edge calculation enhanced offline transaction engine, and breaks through the technical bottleneck of the existing payment system in the aspects of network disaster tolerance capability, privacy protection strength and cross-chain interoperability.
assignees: INSPUR FINANCIAL INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Special operation manipulator for engineering machinery vehicle driving robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special operation manipulator for a driving robot of an engineering mechanical vehicle, which comprises a box body, an electric cylinder, a double-freedom-degree parallel five-bar mechanism and an operation handle clamping device, wherein the electric cylinder is arranged in the box body, two input ends of the double-freedom-degree parallel five-bar mechanism are respectively connected with the electric cylinder, the operation handle clamping device is arranged outside the box body and is connected with an output end of the double-freedom-degree parallel five-bar mechanism, and the operation handle clamping device can be connected with an operation handle of the engineering mechanical vehicle to finish operation. The invention can replace a human driver to finish high-risk operation tasks under the working conditions of engineering machinery vehicles such as bulldozers, loaders, mine sweeping vehicles and the like and dangerous operation conditions in the fields such as mine, nuclear power, emergency rescue and the like, reduces the risk of operators, improves the quick response capability, and breaks through the technical bottleneck of realizing unmanned operation on the premise of not changing the existing engineering equipment.

title_en: A kind of vehicle-mounted fire extinguisher
abstract_en: This utility model relates to a kind of vehicle-mounted fire extinguisher, including fire extinguisher main body, described fire extinguisher main body upper end is provided with bottleneck, described bottleneck is provided with operation handle, described bottleneck side is provided with flexible pipe, described flexible pipe one end is provided with nozzle, described flexible pipe is connected with the buckle being arranged in fire extinguisher main body, described fire extinguisher main body is provided with fixed cover, described fixed cover side is provided with fixing card, the sidewall of described fire extinguisher main body is provided with transparent observing plate, and described fire extinguisher main body lower end is connected with crushing head.This utility model, so can be easy to operate so that fixing of fire extinguisher under fixed cover, the fixing effect blocked by arranging fixed cover, fixing card；By arranging transparent observing plate, so it is easy to observe fire extinguisher internal firefighting agent residual volume；By arranging crushing head, so in case of emergency, crushing head is arranged on fire extinguisher, it is possible to realize glass for vehicle window is easily crushed, it is simple to the escape of people.
assignees: NANAN DATAI SANITARY WARE CO LTD

title_en: A kind of automobile tire with fire-extinguishing function concurrently repairs liquid and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A kind of automobile tire with fire-extinguishing function concurrently repairs liquid and preparation method thereof, its each group is divided into, natural rubber：9-20%, ethoxylated alkyl sulfate：2-5%, coconut oil diethanol amide：2-5%, isopropanol：8-20%, tetrafluoroethane：10-30%, distilled water：The sum of 30-50%, the above components weight percent is 100%.Its preparation method is as follows：1）Ethoxylated alkyl sulfate, coconut oil diethanol amide one hour of stirring are added in distilled water, uniformly；2）Isopropanol is added in step 1）Mixture, continue stir half an hour, uniformly；3）Natural rubber is added in step 2）Mixture, continue stirring one hour, uniformly；4）Tetrafluoroethane is eventually adding, is stirred one hour, uniformly.Propellant contained by the present invention is nonflammable, can utilize the pressure of the water and propellant tetrafluoroethane in component, strafe small-sized burning things which may cause a fire disaster with bottleneck and put out a fire.

title_en: Rapid specificity detection method for early warning of leakage of hydrazine hydrate in air
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid specificity detection method for early warning of leakage of hydrazine hydrate in air, and belongs to the technical field of chemical analysis and detection. The invention is characterized by hydrazine hydrate (N)  2  H  4  ·H  2  O) and reagent ions react with each other to obtain a product ion peak of hydrazine hydrate, and under the action of a uniform electric field, the product ion peak of the hydrazine hydrate and the reagent ion peak are effectively separated due to the difference of ion mobility, the response time is 80ms, the high-selectivity detection is realized, the quantitative range is 100pptv-2ppm, the detection sensitivity reaches pptv, and the method is applied to rapid specific leakage early warning detection of the hydrazine hydrate in the environment, water and soil. The analysis method has the advantages of simplicity, rapidness, no need of any sample pretreatment, sample preparation and other processes, the monitoring response time is only 80ms, the monitoring is automatically tracked and monitored by software, the supervision of on-site people is not needed, and the network data acquisition function is realizedThe remote monitoring data is automatically returned to the main control platform, so that the method is very suitable for on-site rapid early warning and monitoring of dangerous chemicals, emergency response processing and the like.

title_en: Predicting and maneuvering system of seismic sea wave
title_ko: 지진 해일의 예측 및 대응 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a predicting and responding system for seismic sea wave. The predicting and responding system for seismic sea wave according to the present invention comprises the steps of: establishing a seismic sea wave disaster factor information database (DB); analyzing seismic sea wave countermeasure current conditions in a target area along the East Sea; establishing a geographical database for coastal zones by area; analyzing flooding properties by target area along the East Sea; writing a seismic sea wave flooding prognostic chart by target area along the East Sea; and issuing a warning when a level exceeds a target level of flooding in the prognostic chart. As the only predicting and responding system for seismic sea wave utilizing a virtual scenario in Korea, the predicting and responding system for seismic sea wave according to the present invention can allow users to quickly respond to seismic sea wave through stepwise response procedures and to predict a risky area by analyzing seismic sea wave flooding properties in 43 zones in coastal areas of the East Sea by the magnitude of M7.5, M8.0, M8.5, and M9.0 and by utilizing a flooding prognostic chart. Also, by writing a seismic sea wave flooding prognostic chart for seismic sea wave risky areas, the predicting and responding system for seismic sea wave according to the present invention notifies users of risk information allowing users to precisely and easily determine the danger of seismic sea wave and thus to effectively respond, and to manage a seismic sea wave situation in real time and to make a decision, thereby solving existing problems.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지진 해일의 예측 및 대응 시스템에 대한 것으로, 상기한 본 발명의 지진 해일의 예측 및 대응 시스템은; 지진 해일 재해요소 정보 데이터베이스(DB)를 구축하는 단계; 동해안 대상지역의 지진 해일 대책현황을 분석하는 단계; 지역별 연안역 지형 데이터베이스를 구축하는 단계; 동해안 대상지역별 범람특성을 분석하는 단계; 및 동해안 대상지역별 지진 해일 침수 예상도를 작성하는 단계로 구성되고, 상기 침수 예상도에서 일정한 침수 정도를 넘으면 지진 해일 경보를 발령하는 단계로 구성되어 지는 것임을 특징으로 한다. 
상기와 같이 구성되는 본 발명의 지진 해일의 예측 및 대응 시스템은 가상시나리오를 활용한 국내 유일 지진 해일대응 시스템으로 단계별 대응절차를 통해 지진 해일 발생에 대한 신속 대응을 가능하게 하고, M7.5, M8.0, M8.5, M9.0 규모별 동해안 43개 지구의 지진 해일 범람특성의 분석 및 침수 예상도를 활용하여 위험지역의 예측을 가능하고 하고, 또한 지진 해일 위험지역에 대한 지진 해일 침수 예상도를 작성하여 위험정보 알려, 수요자가 지진 해일의 위험성을 정확하고 용이하게 판단할 수 있어 지진 해일에 효과적으로 대응할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 또한 실시간으로 지진 해일 상황을 관리하고 의사결정 지원을 할 수 있게 하여 상기한 종래의 문제점을 해결한다.

title_en: Cluster working method and device based on open virtual network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cluster working method and a device based on an open virtual network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a second gateway node from all active gateway nodes to provide backup service for the failed first gateway node; creating a backup gateway port on a second gateway node based on the medium access control address and the network address of the first gateway node, and broadcasting a reverse address resolution protocol to the cluster to update the medium access control table and the address resolution protocol table of the reachable link of the cluster for the first time; providing L3 forwarding services through a backup gateway port in place of a first gateway node using a pre-synchronized network address translation table; link routes directed to the first gateway node are deleted from the virtual router of the physical host node and upstream traffic is migrated to other active gateway nodes. The invention can provide high-performance disaster-tolerant backup function and multiply expandable forwarding performance, and solves the bottleneck of the forwarding performance in the north-south direction.
assignees: JINAN INSPUR DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster response scenario running system and method for providing same
title_ko: 재난대응 시나리오 구동 시스템 및 그 제공방법
abstract_en: A disaster response scenario running system that visualises a standard operating procedure (SOP) scenario using flow charts and the like so as to be able to easily comprehend a reaction procedure during the occurrence of a disaster, and a method for providing the same are disclosed. According to one aspect of the present invention, the SOP scenario running system comprises: an SOP DB in which a first SOP scenario defining a standard response procedure when a first pre-determined event occurs is stored; objects that respectively correspond to a plurality of unit SOPs included in the first SOP scenario; a display module for displaying the order of the respective unit SOPs; and a control module for performing a task set for a unit SOP that is to be next from among the plurality of unit SOPs, and for determining the unit SOP to be performed next based on the order of the respective unit SOPs if the task performed by the unit SOP is completed, wherein the display module changes the shape of an object corresponding to the performed unit SOP to a first modification shape, or adds a pre-determined visual effect to a component object corresponding to the performed unit SOP if tasks set for the respective unit SOPs are performed by the control module.
abstract_ko: SOP 시나리오를 플로우차트 형태 등으로 가시화하여 재난 발생 시의 대처 절차를 용이하게 파악할 수 있도록 하는 재난대응 시나리오 구동 시스템 및 그 제공방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 측면에 따르면, 소정의 제1 이벤트가 발생한 경우의 표준적인 대응절차를 정의한 제1 SOP(Standard Operating Procedure) 시나리오가 저장된 SOP DB, 상기 제1 SOP 시나리오에 포함된 복수의 단위SOP 각각에 상응하는 오브젝트, 및 각 단위 SOP 간의 선후관계를 디스플레이하는 디스플레이모듈 및 상기 복수의 단위SOP 중 수행될 차례가 된 단위SOP에 설정된 작업을 수행하고, 작업이 수행된 상기 단위SOP가 완료되는 경우 각 단위SOP 간의 선후관계에 기초하여 다음에 수행될 단위SOP를 결정하는 제어모듈을 포함하되, 상기 디스플레이모듈은, 상기 제어모듈에 의해 각 단위 SOP에 설정된 작업이 수행되면, 수행된 상기 단위SOP에 상응하는 오브젝트의 모양을 제1 변형모양으로 변경하거나 수행된 상기 단위SOP에 상응하는 컴포넌트 오브젝트에 소정의 제1시각적 효과를 부가하는 SOP 시나리오 구동 시스템이 제공된다.

title_en: Artificial intelligence-based system for hiker access and safety management using cctv
title_ko: Cctv를 이용한 인공지능 기반 등산객 출입과 안전관리 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is the artificial intelligence base climber access and the safety management system using the cctv. An operation server included in a regular system includes: an entry management unit which confirms the entry of hikers into a hiking trail and registers the confirmed hikers in an entry management table; a target tracking unit which tracks the positions of the hikers registered in the entry management table in real time; a disaster detection unit which detects a disaster in conjunction with a plurality of cctvs; a distress detection unit which detects a distress in conjunction with a mobile terminal of each of the plurality of cctvs and the hikers registered in the entry management table; and a response processing unit which transmits a notification message notifying the disaster or the distress to an external public institution server when the disaster or the distress is detected.
abstract_ko: CCTV를 이용한 인공지능 기반 등산객 출입과 안전관리 시스템이 제공된다. 상시 시스템에 포함된 운영 서버는, 등산객의 등산로 진입을 확인하고, 확인된 등산객을 입산 관리 테이블에 등록하는 입산 관리부; 상기 입산 관리 테이블에 등록된 등산객들의 위치를 실시간으로 추적하는 타겟 트래킹부; 복수의 CCTV들과 연동하여 재해를 감지하는 재해 감지부; 상기 복수의 CCTV들 및 상기 입산 관리 테이블에 등록된 등산객들 각각의 모바일 단말과 연동하여 조난을 감지하는 조난 감지부; 및 상기 재해 또는 조난이 감지된 경우 외부의 공공기관 서버에 재해 또는 조난을 알리는 알림 메시지를 전송하는 대응 처리부;를 포함한다.

title_en: Portable health service device follows system based on multimode perception
abstract_en: The invention discloses a movable health service device following system based on multi-mode sensing, which realizes a cross-platform health service function through the design of a modularized sensing unit (millimeter wave radar/vision/laser radar) and a universal control interface. The system innovatively comprises 1) a multi-device adaptive frame structure, wherein the same system can be deployed on a service robot, an intelligent wheelchair, a medical carrier and the like, the hardware multiplexing rate is more than or equal to 80%, 2) physical sign-motion cooperative control is realized by dynamically adjusting algorithm parameters (such as noise reduction strength is improved by 30% in a wheelchair mode) according to different carrier characteristics, and 3) emergency service expansion is realized by the Internet of things (such as wheelchair-carrier-robot linkage) formed among carriers, so that emergency medicine relay transportation is supported. The system overcomes the technical bottlenecks of strong equipment specificity and single function in the traditional scheme, obviously improves the cross-equipment cooperative efficiency in the actual measurement of the aged community, and shortens the emergency response time to a few minutes.
assignees: GUANGZHOU LINGHAO SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic measurement method, system, equipment and storage medium for classifying degree of rotary drum experimental rock based on visual identification
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for automatically measuring the sorting degree of ice rock in a drum experiment based on visual identification, and belongs to the technical field of geological disaster simulation and test. According to the application, the ice particle area ratio is used as the sorting degree index for the first time, and a standardized calculation model with continuous change between 0 and 1 is established, so that the method has clear physical meaning and stable mathematical characteristics. Compared with the traditional mode of relying on indirect indexes such as centroid position change, the bottleneck that the experiment can not accurately measure and extract particle information is effectively solved, the index not only has clearer physical meaning and statistical stability, but also can accurately calculate the sorting degree index in real time, and the experiment adaptability is remarkably improved.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS;UNIV TSINGHUA;UNIV CHONGQING JIAOTONG

title_en: Rainfall area identification method and system for synthetic aperture radar typhoon wind field
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a rainfall area identification method and a rainfall area identification system for a synthetic aperture radar typhoon wind field, which are used for carrying out mask processing on invalid values of land, islands and data edge areas existing in high-resolution typhoon sea surface wind field data; the method comprises the steps of identifying and determining the center position of typhoon based on wind field data, carrying out mask processing on a circular area within a certain range of a radius by taking the center as an origin, dividing the preprocessed wind field data into a plurality of standardized grids, calculating the space domain statistical characteristics of wind speed grid by grid, judging whether the grids are rainfall areas according to the calculated characteristic ratio, and marking all the grids judged to be rainfall areas to generate a typhoon rainfall spatial distribution map. According to the technical scheme, the technical bottleneck caused by dependence of traditional exogenous data can be overcome, the typhoon rainfall area can be identified with high precision and quickly, and more time-efficient support is provided for disaster early warning and defense.
assignees: SYSTEMS ENGINEERING RESEARCH INST CHINA STATE SHIPBUILDING CORPORATION

title_en: intelligent evacuation guidance simulation system for disaster situation
title_ko: 재난상황을 대비한 지능형 대피 유도 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an intelligent evacuation guidance system for guiding an evacuation route for evacuees in preparation for a disaster situation, which prevents a bottleneck phenomenon during evacuation. According to the present invention, an intelligent evacuation guidance method comprises, by the intelligent evacuation guidance system: a first step of checking the number (N) of evacuation groups existing in a distress area and the number (n) of evacuees existing in each evacuation group; a second step of checking the number (M) of escape routes existing in the distress area; a third step of calculating, on assumption that all evacuees belonging to one evacuation group are evacuated through the same escape route, all evacuation routes in which the evacuees of N evacuation groups evacuate to M escape routes; a fourth step of calculating time required for all evacuees to escape to each of the evacuation routes; and a fifth step of selecting an evacuation route having the minimum time required for evacuation as an optimal evacuation route among the evacuation routes.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 재난상황을 대비하여 대피자의 대피 경로를 안내하는 대피 유도 시스템으로서, 상기 대피 유도 시스템에 의해서, 조난지역에 존재하는 대피자 그룹의 수(N)와 각 대피자 그룹에 존재하는 대피자의 수(n)가 파악되는 1단계; 조난지역에 존재하는 탈출구의 수(M)가 파악되는 2단계; 하나의 대피자 그룹에 속하는 대피자 전원은 동일한 탈출구로 탈출한다는 가정하에, N개의 대피자 그룹의 대피자가 M개의 탈출구로 대피하는 모든 대피경로가 산출되는 3단계; 상기 대피경로 각각으로 대피자 전원이 탈출하는데 소요되는 시간이 각각 산출되는 4단계; 및 상기 대피경로 중 탈출에 소요되는 시간이 최소인 대피경로가 최적 대피경로로 선정되는 5단계;를 포함한다.
assignees: UNIV SEOUL IND COOP FOUND;IUCF HYU ERICA CAMPUS

title_en: Anti-terrorism monitoring emergency command system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to an anti-terrorism monitoring emergency command system, which comprises: monitoring equipment groups, dispatch centers and emergency response equipment groups. The monitoring equipment group is used for collecting monitoring data of the inside of the hydropower plant and the boundary of the plant area and returning the monitoring data to the dispatching center; the dispatching center is used for analyzing anti-terrorism emergency events according to the monitoring data returned by the monitoring equipment group and commanding and dispatching emergency response equipment group and personnel to defend in time according to the analysis result. The system can improve the recognition range, recognition capability and recognition timeliness of the ground global emergency event of the hydropower plant, can improve the emergency response capability and emergency response timeliness of the ground global emergency event of the hydropower plant, and can further strengthen the recognition and emergency response processing capability of the airspace emergency event of the hydropower plant.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster real-time monitoring and early warning method based on Internet of things and artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster early warning, in particular to a mountain torrent disaster real-time monitoring early warning method based on the Internet of things and artificial intelligence. According to the invention, a monitoring section with continuous change characteristics is defined by extracting continuous rising trend of water level, a response path between water level and rainfall is constructed by means of multi-node spatial distribution relation, identification and merging of an interaction area are completed, a water retention section and an upstream water supplementing direction are calibrated by comparing drainage state with node behaviors, response sustainability is analyzed by a broadcasting channel and scheduling frequency, key nodes in a change process are screened, water level, rainfall and path information are organized by a time sequence, a multi-area hydrological response process is integrated, and staged identification and risk pointing of a disaster process are advanced.
assignees: JINING WATER CONSERVANCY BUSINESS DEV CENTER

title_en: The dual-purpose fire-suppression bottle of a kind of throwing of dwarf forms bottle cap and injecting type
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of throwing and dual-purpose fire-suppression bottle of injecting type of dwarf forms bottle cap, is become with extinguishing chemical (10) Group by enclosing cover (1), spray-hole (2), pad (3), injection bottle cap (4), bottle (5), pretty footpath pipe (6), water guide wireway (7), filter (8), filter hole (9); It is characterized in that: bottle (5) is connected with injection bottle cap (4), enclosing cover (1) is connected with injection bottle cap (4) is outside, between the spray-hole (2) of enclosing cover (1) and injection bottle cap (4), be added with pad (3), bottleneck is inner to be connected with reducer pipe (5), reducer pipe (6) lower end is connected with water guide wireway (7), water guide wireway (7) is connected with filter (8), sprays spray-hole (2) in bottle cap (4) and can be a hole or multiple hole.When use, the one, can throwing put out a fire; The 2nd, hand is pinched pressure bottle ejecting extinguishing; The 3rd, dilute the fire extinguishing of splashing.Be suitable for the category-A fire of hard and soft solid material, the initial fire disaster that category-B fire causes stereoplasm thing fire and C class fire.

title_en: Emergency response organization toughness evaluation method and system based on complex network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of emergency response, and particularly discloses an emergency response organization toughness evaluation method and system based on a complex network. The method comprises the steps of constructing an organization relation matrix according to actual response data and emergency plan data to establish relations and interaction mechanisms among all main bodies in an emergency response process, constructing four stages of organizing networks of a pre-disaster plan, an emergency rescue, a recovery reconstruction and a post-disaster plan according to the organization relation matrix, evaluating node importance, evaluating toughness of network organization representing emergency response by simulating network operation conditions under a single attack strategy, coupling multiple network attack strategies by utilizing an entropy weight method, simulating different high-risk scenes, obtaining weights of the attack strategies by calculating information entropy, evaluating network efficiency under multiple attack scenes, and obtaining overall toughness level of the emergency response organization in all stages. The invention can clearly reflect the emergency response capability and the recovery capability of the organization in different stages.

title_en: Multi-band millimeter radar detection system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-band millimeter radar detection system which comprises a multi-band reconstruction radar module, an MIMO antenna array, an FPGA preprocessing module, an edge computing unit and a power management module, wherein the multi-band reconstruction radar module supports 24GHz/77GHz dynamic switching, intelligent adaptation of a penetration mode and a positioning mode is achieved through a radio frequency switch, the MIMO antenna array is used for receiving signals transmitted by the multi-band reconstruction radar module, the FPGA preprocessing module is used for preprocessing radar echo signals received by the MIMO antenna array, the edge computing unit is used for computing and analyzing the preprocessed radar echo signals to determine detection results, and the power management module is used for providing electric quantity. The invention breaks through the technical bottlenecks of weak penetrability, difficult multi-target separation and high response delay of the traditional detection equipment, fills the blank of life detection technology in a complex environment, and promotes the remarkable improvement of emergency rescue efficiency and success rate.
assignees: HUAINAN UNION UNIV HUAINAN EMPLOYEE UNIV HUAINAN BRANCH OF ANHUI OPEN UNIV

title_en: Intelligent pigsty monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent breeding, in particular to an intelligent pigsty monitoring system; including processing end and intelligent terminal, processing end includes: the system comprises an acquisition unit, an identification unit, a comparison unit, a processing unit, a breeding database, an artificial intelligence system and a data synchronization unit. The intelligent pig house monitoring system provided by the invention is based on the culture database and the artificial intelligent system, can monitor in real time and timely make corresponding emergency management measures aiming at the types of abnormal emergencies occurring in the culture process, has the sensitivity of system monitoring in a reasonable interval, is sensitive and reliable in response processing process, improves the emergency management capability of the emergency emergencies, can reduce the supervision dependence on manpower, reduces the difficulty of artificial work, and spans the difficulty of culture to digital culture by experience; based on the comparison unit, the data acquisition error can be greatly reduced by adopting a twice judgment mode, so that emergency response can be timely, accurately and effectively carried out.

title_en: Method of port logistics information security using information security management system
title_ko: 정보보호관리체계를 활용한 항만물류정보보안방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a port distribution information security method using an information protection management system. According to the present invention, the port distribution information security method using the information protection management system comprises: an invasion accident detection/receipt step (A) of detecting or receiving a security invasion accident; an invasion accident analysis step (B) of analyzing a type of the detected and received information and determining a priority order; a response procedure selecting step (C) by an offense type, of establishing and executing a security policy in accordance with the type of security attack after analysis is finished in the invasion accident analysis step; an invasion accident register step (D) of reporting an accident when the response procedure selecting step by the offense type is finished; an invasion accident responding team acting step (E) of applying the security policy in accordance with the invasion accident type by a responding team in accordance with contents reported in the invasion accident register step; an action proceeding reporting step (F) of reporting an action proceeding on the accident when the invasion accident responding team acting step is completed; and an action completion result reporting step (G) of reporting a series of processes including post management contents when the series of the steps are completely finished. The port distribution information security method using the information protection management system can reinforce security of a port by placing emphasis on not only security on hardware which is important in an existing security system but also technical security on software to protect the security from a security threat such as hacking and a DDos attack. The port distribution information security method using the information protection management system also can properly maintain balance of distribution security and distribution efficiency, which are important in a distribution industry, by actively using IT equipment in the security system on the hardware and can improve reliability of a client.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 정보보호관리체계를 활용한 항만물류정보보안방법은 보안침해사고를 탐지 또는 접수하는 침해사고 탐지/접수단계(A); 상기 탐지/접수된 사고의 유형을 분석하고 우선순위를 정하는 침해사고분석단계(B); 상기 침해사고분석단계에서 분석이 끝난 후 보안공격의 유형에 따라 보안대책을 수립 및 실시하는 공격 유형별 대응절차 선정단계(C); 상기 공격 유형별 대응절차 선정단계가 끝나면 사고를 보고하는 침해사고 등록단계(D); 상기 침해사고 등록단계에서 보고된 내용에 따라 대응 팀이 침해사고 유형에 따라 보안대책을 적용하는 침해사고 대응팀 활동단계(E); 상기 침해사고 대응팀 활동단계가 완료되면 사고에 대한 조치 경과를 보고하는 조치 경과 보고단계(F); 상기 일련의 단계들이 모두 마무리되면 사후조치 내용을 포함한 일련의 과정들을 보고하는 조치 완료결과 보고단계(G); 로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하고, 기존 보안체계에 중요시 되었던 하드웨어 측면에서의 보안뿐만 아니라 해킹, 디도스 공격 등의 보안 위협을 방어하기 위한 소프트웨어 측면에서의 기술적 보안에 중점을 두어 항만의 보안성이 더욱 강화되는 효과를 가지며, 또한 IT 장비들을 하드웨어 측면의 보안체계에 적극적으로 활용하여 근래 물류 산업에서 중요시 되고 있는 물류보안과 물류효율의 균형을 적절하게 유지하여 고객 신뢰성을 향상시키는 효과를 가진다.

title_en: System and method for automatic selection of major disaster safety types
title_ko: 주요 재난안전 유형 자동 선정 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: A system and method for automatically selecting major disaster safety types according to an embodiment collect detailed disaster safety type information, including regional disaster types, occurrence status, damage statistics, and resident perception, to calculate a final disaster occurrence score for each regional disaster, and predict the type of disaster likely to occur in a specific region based on the calculated final disaster occurrence score. In an embodiment, an artificial neural network model is trained with disaster type-related data to create a disaster prediction model. The possibility of disaster occurrence in each region can be predicted using the generated disaster prediction model. In addition, in an embodiment, when the possibility of disaster occurrence exceeds a certain level, information on the response process for predicted disaster prevention is transmitted to a local government terminal to prepare for the predicted disaster and minimize damage.
abstract_ko: 실시예에 따른 주요 재난안전 유형 자동 선정 시스템 및 방법은 지역별 재난 유형과 발생현황, 피해통계, 주민체감도 등을 포함하는 재난안전 유형 상세 정보를 수집하여 지역의 재난 별 재난 발생 최종점수를 산출하고, 산출된 재난 발생 최종점수를 통해 특정 지역에서 발생하기 쉬운 재난 유형의 종류를 예측한다.  실시예에서는 인공신경망 모델을 재난 유형 관련 데이터로 학습시켜 재난 예측 모델을 생성하고, 생성된 재난 예측 모델을 통해 지역별 재난 발생 가능성을 예측할 수 있다. 또한, 실시예에서는 재난 발생 가능성이 일정 수준을 초과하는 경우, 예측된 재난 예방을 위한 대응 프로세스 정보를 지자체 단말로 전송하여 예측된 재난에 대비하고, 피해를 최소화할 수 있도록 한다.

title_en: Hole sealing device for underground roof drilling and hole sealing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hole sealing device for underground roof drilling and a hole sealing method thereof, belonging to the technical field of hole sealing of underground roof drilling, and comprising a roof drilling hole, an orifice sleeve and grouting equipment, wherein the orifice sleeve is embedded in the roof drilling hole, a flange plate is installed on the orifice sleeve, a slurry inlet hole and a slurry return hole are formed in the flange plate, ball valves are arranged on the slurry inlet hole and the slurry return hole, a slurry return pipe is arranged in the orifice sleeve, the upper end and the lower end of the slurry return pipe respectively extend to the top end of the orifice sleeve and the slurry return hole of the flange plate, and the lower port of the slurry return pipe is in sealing connection with the slurry return hole. The invention can realize the full-height visual hole sealing function of the underground top plate drilling hole, realizes the full-height sealing of the drilling hole, thoroughly eliminates the latent threat caused by the poor sealing of the drilling hole to the tunneling of a working face, has higher safety benefit, solves the technical bottleneck which puzzles the drilling hole sealing effect of the underground top plate for a long time, and greatly reduces the cost investment of preventing and controlling the water disaster of the mine.

title_en: Network emergency response machine body
abstract_en: The invention relates to a network emergency response machine body, which belongs to the field of electronic equipment dust prevention and is used for solving the problem that the existing emergency response machine body does not have a dust removal function, wherein a response processor is arranged in a host machine, a plurality of sockets are arranged on the outer wall of one side of the host machine, the sockets are electrically connected with the response processor, and a dust guard used for blocking the sockets is arranged beside the sockets in a sliding manner; the dustproof dust-removing device is characterized in that a dustproof net is arranged on the side wall of the other side of the host relative to the socket, a lifting plate sliding up and down is arranged in the host, and an ash-removing brush for cleaning the dustproof net is fixedly connected to the lifting plate. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the dust guard prevents that the socket from advancing grey, prevents to advance grey in the host computer when the dust screen of rear side ventilates, and dustproof effectual, the ash removal brush lasts clean dust screen, avoids the dust to save the jam dust screen, guarantees ventilation and the radiating effect of host computer.
