title_en: For in-car alarm activation and the method and apparatus of response processing
abstract_en: There is provided a kind of for in-car alarm activation and the method and apparatus of response processing.A kind of system includes：One or more processors, it is configured as detection and the activation of the alarm trigger of one or more processor communication.One or more processor is additionally configured to：It is determined that the type and type based on triggering of triggering, there is provided the feedback response for being not easy to discover of design is to avoid attacker from discovering.One or more processor is extraly configured as：Radio contact emergency responder；There is provided it is determined that available data in terms of vehicle location and vehicle identification.

title_en: Outdoor mooring type multi-angle warning balloon
abstract_en: Outdoor mooring type multi-angle warning balloon, provides that a kind of time length length, distance, scope are wide, round-the-clock, unmanned, the warning using simple and safe, individual carrying portable and target guide balloon round the clock.Feature is at the bonding closed formation on-inflatable platform in local, spheroid multiple position; And on this platform plating plane mirror; At spherome surface plating convex surface light deflector; Use light storage type self luminous Material coating warning mark SOS and spheroid; Spheroid bottom is wide adaptive horn-like inflation inlet.During use, the blowing agent worn is put into the mineral water bottle or camping kettle that fill suitable quantity of water, horn-like for balloon inflation inlet is entangled bottleneck or Hu Kou rope is fastened, after the gas that reaction generates is full of spheroid, balloon inflation mouth neck portion is fastened with fishing line, the rope that solution is abroached or Hu Kou system, goes up high-altitude and sends warning and target index signal.Make search and rescue team just can find target of crying for help in far place, impose on rescue in time.

title_en: Intelligent extraction method for coal mining subsidence area ground surface cracks based on improved transducer model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent extraction method for earth surface cracks in a coal mining subsidence area based on an improved transducer model, and belongs to the technical field of remote sensing image processing. The unmanned aerial vehicle with the high-resolution optical camera is used for collecting images, the image overlapping rate of 70% -80% is guaranteed, and a training data set is constructed through professional labeling, cutting screening and data enhancement. The encoder of the innovative model has the characteristics that the self-adaptive multi-scale patch mapping layer can dynamically adjust the patch size according to the local complexity degree of the image, the characteristics are extracted efficiently, double-attention fusion is combined with optimized position encoding, long-distance dependency capture is enhanced, and the calculation amount and the overfitting of the dynamic sparse connection full-connection layer are reduced. And the residual attention enhancing pyramid pooling and space-channel attention bottleneck mechanism highlights key characteristics and suppresses noise, and the break point detection and connection rule determining module is utilized to realize complete restoration of the ground cracks. The data set is used for deployment after a model is trained, and the ground crack information can be accurately obtained through pretreatment, encoding and decoding and post-treatment, so that the data base is firmly built for mining area safety management and geological disaster prevention.

title_en: Extreme weather elastic scheduling strategy previewing system, method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of disaster prevention, disaster reduction and intelligent scheduling of an electric power system, and provides a system, a method, equipment and a medium for previewing an extreme weather elastic scheduling strategy, wherein the system comprises a meteorological-GAN modeling module, a reinforcement learning training module and a digital twin test platform which are connected in sequence; the method comprises the steps of generating an extreme weather power grid fault sequence with space-time correlation characteristics by a meteorological-GAN modeling module, training a power failure recovery decision model by a reinforcement learning training module based on the generated fault sequence, performing pressure test and robustness verification of a disaster evolution path on the decision model by a digital twin test platform, forming a closed-loop optimization framework by three modules through a bidirectional data channel, and breaking through the difficult problems of data dependence bottleneck and robustness verification of a power grid scheduling strategy under extreme weather by a collaborative mechanism of high-fidelity disaster scene generation, self-adaptive decision training and extreme pressure test.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Gesture-based disaster response device and method
title_ko: 제스처 기반의 재난대응 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a gesture-based disaster response device and a method. The device includes: a situation information collection unit for receiving an operation signal and a biosignal for disaster response from a wearable terminal including a plurality of sensors which are attached to a user's body and are operated; a gesture recognition unit for recognizing a user's gesture according to a change pattern of the operation signal based on a location characteristic according to a location of a user; a disaster occurrence detector configured to monitor the presence or absence of abnormalities in the biosignal according to the gesture to detect the occurrence of a disaster related to the user; and a disaster response processing unit which propagates disaster information including the user's location and requests a control server to proceed with emergency rescue, in case the occurrence of the disaster is detected.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 제스처 기반의 재난대응 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 상기 장치는 사용자의 신체에 부착되어 동작하는 복수의 센서들을 포함하는 웨어러블 단말로부터 재난 대응을 위한 동작 신호 및 생체 신호를 수신하는 상황 정보 수집부, 상기 사용자의 위치에 따른 장소 특성을 기초로 상기 동작 신호의 변화 패턴에 따라 상기 사용자의 제스처를 인식하는 제스처 인식부, 상기 제스처에 따른 생체 신호의 이상 유무를 모니터링하여 상기 사용자에 관한 재난 발생을 검출하는 재난 발생 검출부 및 상기 재난 발생이 검출된 경우 상기 사용자의 위치를 포함하는 재난 정보를 전파하고 관제 서버에 긴급 구조의 진행을 요청하는 재난 대응 처리부를 포함한다.

title_en: Throw formula fire -suppression bottle
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the fire -fighting equipment, a throw formula fire -suppression bottle is disclosed very much. This throw formula fire -suppression bottle, including the bottle, the bottle includes columniform body and bottleneck, and the top of bottleneck forms the bottleneck, and thread buckling has located a bottle lid on the bottleneck, the bottle lid includes a lid, and the internal diameter of lid cooperatees with the external diameter of bottleneck, hugs closely the bottleneck inner wall in the inboard of bottleneck and is equipped with the annular bead that a level set up, is equipped with a cylindrical boss at the inboard bottom surface center of lid. This throw formula fire -suppression bottle during the use directly throws away fire -suppression bottle to the burning things which may cause a fire disaster, and the bottle is broken, and convenient to use is put out a fire rapidly in fire extinguishing agent release, weight and size can design as required, are fit for children or old man's use more, convenient to carry, design into hand shrapnel's mechanics shape, throw fartherly to the convenient throw to high altitude or corner, application scope is wide.
assignees: JINAN XINRUIHAI FIRE-FIGHTING EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Multi-scene adaptive first-aid response processing device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of emergency response processing equipment, in particular to a multi-scene adaptive emergency response processing device and method. The invention provides a multi-scene adaptive emergency response processing device and method which can absorb moisture in a humid environment, can supply energy when being used outdoors and limit a drawing box when moving, and are convenient for adapting to multiple scenes. The utility model provides a first aid response processing apparatus and method of many scene adaptation, includes intelligent first-aid kit, pull case and battery etc. and sliding connection has a plurality of pull cases on the intelligent first-aid kit, and the battery has been placed in intelligent first-aid kit left part. According to the invention, the pull box is limited by the limiting frame, the moisture absorption treatment is carried out by the moisture absorption plate, and the second solar plate and the first solar plate convert solar energy into electric energy to supply power for the device, so that the effects of moisture absorption in a humid environment, energy supply in outdoor use and limitation of the pull box in moving are achieved, and the device is convenient for adapting to multiple scenes.

title_en: Intelligent building-oriented emergency evacuation path dynamic planning method and related equipment thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of building emergency evacuation path planning, and particularly provides an emergency evacuation path dynamic planning method for an intelligent building and related equipment thereof, which mainly comprise the steps of acquiring building real-time monitoring data, preprocessing the real-time monitoring data, and obtaining building security situation data; the method comprises the steps of carrying out threat diffusion simulation and region division on building security situation data to obtain security region division data, carrying out personnel cluster analysis and social force model prediction on the basis of the building security situation data to obtain personnel evacuation behavior prediction data and evacuation bottleneck early warning data. The application realizes the accurate adaptation of evacuation paths, on-site threat spreading trend and real-time change of personnel flow, avoids personnel from sinking into an unwarranted threat area, reduces local congestion, and effectively shortens the whole evacuation time.

title_en: Zero trust protection method for rail transit network
abstract_en: The invention provides a protection method of zero trust of a rail transit network, which comprises the steps of identifying assets, deploying a general collector in a road network control center, and normalizing and restraining network security situation and running condition of rail transit network information; carding the data flow path to determine a zero trust protection strategy decision point; collecting data and constructing a zero trust protection flow database; data evaluation, namely determining the sequence of the data evaluation candidate task flow; zero trust security and communication mechanisms are gradually established. By collecting the safety information of the assets in the respective network, deep analysis, statistics and association are carried out on the safety events, the safety conditions of the managed assets are perceived in time, the safety risks are positioned, various risk assets are rapidly found and positioned, and a disposal method and advice are provided in time to assist a safety manager in carrying out event analysis, risk analysis, early warning management and emergency response processing.

title_en: Physical similarity simulation experiment crack identification platform
abstract_en: The application discloses a physical similarity simulation experiment crack identification platform, which realizes the full-flow intellectualization from data acquisition to analysis and display by integrating a multi-mode data synchronous acquisition module, a self-adaptive preprocessing assembly line, a mixed deep learning module and an interactive three-dimensional visualization engine, wherein the multi-mode acquisition system solves the problem of asynchronous traditional data, the preprocessing assembly line automatically processes high-throughput data and filters noise, the mixed model combines images and stress field characteristics to improve crack identification precision, the three-dimensional visualization engine supports crack evolution dynamic playback, parameter automatic calculation and immersive interaction, the bottlenecks of high manual dependence, dynamic analysis fault, three-dimensional characterization missing and the like in the traditional method are broken through, the efficiency and the precision of rock crack research are obviously improved, and a full-period digital solution is provided for mineral engineering, geological disaster prevention and the like.

title_en: Oil leak prevention device for calliper breake
title_ko: 캘리퍼 브레이크오일 리크 방지 장치
abstract_en: An oil leak prevention device of a caliper brake is provided to dually prevent the leakage of the brake oil by additionally installing a bladder in a caliper housing. An oil leak prevention device of a caliper brake is composed of a caliper housing(10), a piston(20), a dust boot(30), and a piston seal(40). An oil inlet hole(12) is formed at one side of the caliper housing. A piston oil housing space(11) connected to the oil inlet hole is formed in the caliper housing. The piston is installed inside the caliper housing and is moved back and forth by hydraulic pressure. The dust boot is installed along the one side circumference of the piston. The dust boot prevents foreign materials from being flowed in through between the piston and the caliper housing. The piston seal is installed between the caliper housing and the piston.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 캘리퍼 브레이크오일 리크 방지 장치에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명의 캘리퍼 브레이크오일 리크 방지 장치는, 일측에 오일유입구가 형성되어 있고, 오일유입구와 연통된 피스톤수용공간이 내부에 형성되어 있는 캘리퍼하우징과, 캘리퍼하우징 내부에 설치되어 유압에 의해 전,후진하는 피스톤과, 피스톤의 일측 외주면을 따라 설치되어 피스톤과 캘리퍼하우징 사이로 이물질이 유입되는 것을 방지하는 더스트부츠와, 피스톤과 캘리퍼하우징 사이의 틈에 설치되어 오일유입구를 통해 유입된 브레이크오일의 누유를 방지하는 피스톤시일로 구성된 캘리퍼 브레이크오일 리크 방지 장치에 있어서, 상기 캘리퍼하우징의 오일유입구 내벽면에는 오일유입관과 체결되기 위한 나사산이 형성되어 있는 유입관체결부가 형성되어 있고, 유입관체결부 내측 끝단으로부터 관로 중심을 향해 평평하게 형성된 단턱부가 형성되어 있으며, 단턱부 끝단으로부터 유입관체결부보다 작은 직경을 가진 채 피스톤수용공간과 연통되어 있는 블래더밀착부가 형성되어 있고, 상기 단턱부에 밀착되도록 원판형의 형상을 가지며, 오일유입관 끝단과 단턱부 사이에 끼여 고정되는 연결부가 형성되어 있고, 연결부 끝단으로부터 피스톤수용공간 내측까지 형성되어 블래더밀착부에 외주면이 밀착되는 병목부가 형성되어 있으며, 병목부 끝단에 연결된 채 풍선 형상으로 형성되어 브레이크오일의 유입에 의해 팽창 또는 수축하도록 된 주머니부로 구성되어 있고, 부틸고무가 포함된 재질로 구성된 블래더가 설치되어 있는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     본 발명에 의하여, 캘리퍼하우징 내부에 블래더를 추가로 설치함으로써 브레이크오일의 누유를 이중으로 방지하여 브레이크오일의 누유로 인한 브레이크의 파열을 방지하고, 이로 인한 인명 사고를 방지할 수 있고, 피스톤시일의 마모로 인한 브레이크오일의 누유를 방지함으로써 브레이크오일의 사용량을 절감할 수 있게 되며, 브레이크오일이 원활히 리턴되어 디스크 마모 방지는 물론, 디스크와 패드가 항시 접촉될 수 있는 문제점을 방지하여 연료 절감에도 기여하게 된다.

title_en: Crowd evacuation auxiliary decision-making system based on ant colony algorithm and improved social model
abstract_en: The invention provides a crowd evacuation auxiliary decision-making system based on an ant colony algorithm and an improved social model, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring evacuation scene parameters through a shooting device, creating an evacuation scene model in a computer, and classifying different types of pedestrians based on a neural network face recognition system; s2, planning the pedestrian evacuation route with complete evacuation information by using the ant colony algorithm: s3, planning evacuation routes of pedestrians having local evacuation information in consideration of the individual preferences influenced by the crowd behavior, obstacles, walls, etc.; s4, driving the pedestrian to move based on the improved social force model, and simulating the crowd evacuation movement; and S5, predicting and marking the evacuation bottleneck of the pedestrian in the emergency, and reasonably setting a guide mark at the mark to induce the pedestrian to safely reach the exit. The invention can utilize facility resources in an evacuation process in a balanced manner, predict evacuation bottleneck, set a guide sign, reasonably plan a dynamic evacuation path and improve evacuation efficiency.

title_en: The system which manages a tax invoice
title_ko: 세금계산서 관리시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A tax bill management system is provided for purchase companies to easily avoid damage caused by delay of unnecessary business flow caused by multiple accessing each computer module. CONSTITUTION: A TI(Tax Invoice) management control module(101) controls an acquisition process of issuing a tax bill issued by a selling company, and a management process of tax related data of a purchase company. After a TI acquisition module(104) acquires TI, the module stores the acquired TI into TRD storage database. A TI issuance authenticity confirmation module(105) reads the record breakdown of TI stored in the TRD storage database. [Reference numerals] (10) Online network; (101) TI management control module; (102) Interface module; (103) Management information storage module; (104) TI acquisition module; (105) TI issuance authenticity confirmation module; (106) TI issuance authenticity recording module; (107) National tax service data acquisition module; (108) National tax service legacy server lon-in support module; (109) National tax service data storage module; (110) IKD/TRD dialogue processing module; (111) IKD/TRD dialogue result processing module; (20) Purchasing company legacy server; (21) IKD storage D/B; (22) TRD storage D/B; (30) National tax service legacy server; (40) Mail server; (50) Information communicator of a purchasing company coordinator
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 세금계산서(TI: Tax Invoice) 관리시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에서는 <매입업체 담당자 정보통신기 또는 메일 서버와 통신을 취하여, TI(Tax Invoice)를 취득한 후, 취득된 TI를 매입업체 기간계 서버에 의해 관리되는 TRD(The Tax Relation Data of the purchase company) 저장 D/B 내에 저장할 수 있는 전산모듈>, <매입업체 기간계 서버와 통신을 취하여, TRD 저장 D/B 내에 저장되어 있던 TI의 기록내역을 판독한 후, 국세청 기간계 서버와 통신을 취하여, TI와 동일 기록내역을 가지는 TI가 국세청 기간계 서버에 저장되어 있는지(즉, TI의 발행 진위여부)를 확인할 수 있는 전산모듈>, <TRD 저장 D/B 내에 저장되어 있던 TI의 발행 진위여부가 확인 완료되면, 매입업체 기간계 서버와 통신을 취하여, TRD 저장 D/B 내에 TI의 발행 진위여부를 기록할 수 있는 전산모듈> 등을 체계적으로 배치 제공하고, 이를 통해, 매입업체 측에서 별다른 어려움 없이 매출업체 측의 TI 발행사실 국세청 신고여부, TI 임의 취소내역, TI 국세청 수정신고내역 등을 실시간 확인할 수 있도록 함은 물론 악의의 소속직원에 의한 TI의 위/변조 사실도 실시간으로 파악할 수 있도록 함으로써, 필요절차의 진행지체 문제점, 무자료 지출사고의 유발 문제점, TI의 위/변조에 따른 각종 손실발생 문제점 등을 손쉽게 회피할 수 있도록 가이드 할 수 있다.  
또한, 본 발명에서는 <국세청 기간계 서버와 통신을 취하여, 매입업체에 상응하는 각종 국세청데이터를 일괄 취득할 수 있는 전산모듈>, <매입업체 기간계 서버와 통신을 취하여, 취득 완료된 국세청데이터를 TRD 저장 D/B 내에 일괄 저장할 수 있는 전산모듈>, <TI 또는 국세청데이터가 TRD 저장 D/B 내에 저장 완료된 상황에서, 매입업체 기간계 서버에 의해 관리되는 매입업체 측 내부관리데이터(IKD: The Internal-Keeping Date which is managed by the purchase company)와 TRD 저장 D/B 내에 저장되어 있던 TI/국세청데이터의 일치여부를 대사하고, 해당 대사에 상응하는 IKD/TRD 대사결과 데이터를 생성한 후, 생성 완료된 IKD/TRD 대사결과 데이터를 매입업체 담당자 정보통신기, 매입업체 담당자 측 메일 서버 등으로 전송할 수 있는 전산모듈> 등을 체계적으로 배치 제공하고, 이를 통해, 매입업체 측에서 장시간의 불필요한 수작업 절차(예컨대, 국세청데이터를 각 건별로 일일이 수집하는 수작업 절차, 수집 완료된 각 건별 국세청데이터를 하나의 데이터로 일일이 병합하는 수작업 절차, 병합 완료된 국세청 데이터를 매입업체 측 내부데이터와 일일이 비교하여, 누락 정보, 이중발행정보 등을 상세히 확인하는 수작업 절차 등) 없이도, 일련의 부가세 합계 표 작성절차를 단시간 내에 효과적으로 완수할 수 있도록 함으로써, 해당 부가세 합계 표 작성절차에 상응하는 각종 인적/물적 손실을 손쉽게 회피할 수 있도록 가이드 할 수 있다. 
나아가, 본 발명에서는 데이터 취득용 전산모듈들이 자신에게 필요한 일련의 데이터 취득을 위해 국세청 기간계 서버 측으로 통신을 시도할 때, 매입업체에 상응하는 복수의 공인인증정보를 해당 전산모듈 측으로 일괄 제공할 수 있는 로그인 지원용 전산모듈을 추가 배치 제공하고, 이를 통해, 국세청 기간계 서버에 통신 시도 중인 각 전산모듈들이 별다른 어려움 없이 매입업체에 상응하는 모든 사업자번호 명의로 국세청 기간계 서버에 일괄 로그인 할 수 있도록 함으로써, 매입업체 측에서 각 전산모듈들의 국세청 전산망 복수 접속에 의해 발생할 수 있는 불필요한 업무 흐름 지연 피해를 손쉽게 회피할 수 있도록 가이드 할 수 있다.

title_en: Method and system for providing adaptive SOP according to emergent situation during SOP training
title_ko: 훈련 중 상황에 따른 적응적 sop 제공방법 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: A method and a system for providing an adaptive standard operation procedure (SOP) according to situations during training are disclosed. A method for providing an adaptive SOP according to situations during training according to an aspect of the present invention includes the steps of: storing an SOP performed in the event of a disaster by an adaptive SOP providing the SOP, which is a response procedure in case of a disaster; receiving, by the adaptive SOP providing system, emergency situation occurrence information about an emergency situation during disaster situation response training according to the SOP; and determining training progress information including information on whether or not to continue the response training, whether or not to modify the SOP when the response training is continued, or a modified SOP when the SOP is modified on the basis of the emergency situation occurrence information received by the adaptive SOP providing system. The step of determining training progress information including information on whether or not to continue the response training, whether or not to modify the SOP when the response training is continued, or a modified SOP when the SOP is modified on the basis of the emergency situation occurrence information received by the adaptive SOP providing system includes a step of determining, by the adaptive SOP providing system, the training progress information on the basis of the attribute of the emergency situation, wherein the attribute includes whether or not the emergency situation is a virtual/real situation or the type of the emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 훈련 중 상황에 따른 적응적 SOP 제공방법 및 그 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 측면에 따른 훈련 중 상황에 따른 적응적 SOP 제공방법은 재난시의 대응절차인 SOP(Standard Operation Procedure)를 제공하는 적응적 SOP 제공시스템이 재난 발생 시에 수행되는 SOP를 저장하는 단계, 상기 적응적 SOP 제공시스템이 상기 SOP에 따른 재난상황의 대응훈련 중에 돌발상황에 대한 돌발상황 발생정보를 입력받는 단계, 상기 적응적 SOP 제공시스템이 입력받은 상기 돌발상황 발생정보에 기초하여 상기 대응훈련의 지속여부, 상기 대응훈련을 지속할 경우의 상기 SOP의 수정여부, 또는 상기 SOP의 수정시의 수정 SOP에 대한 정보를 포함하는 훈련진행정보를 결정하는 단계를 포함하며, 상기 적응적 SOP 제공시스템이 입력받은 상기 돌발상황 발생정보에 기초하여 상기 대응훈련의 지속여부, 상기 대응훈련을 지속할 경우의 상기 SOP의 수정여부, 또는 상기 SOP의 수정시의 수정 SOP에 대한 정보를 포함하는 훈련진행정보를 결정하는 단계는, 상기 적응적 SOP 제공시스템이 상기 돌발상황의 속성-상기 속성은 상기 돌발상황이 가상/실제상황인지 여부 또는 돌발상황의 종류를 포함함-에 기초하여 상기 훈련진행정보를 결정하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: UNE CO LTD;PARK NAM HEE;YEO WOOK HYUN

title_en: Build Gas extinguishing system and its fire extinguishing component
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of building Gas extinguishing systems and its fire extinguishing component, the common main points of the two technical solution to be：Including fire-suppression bottle group and multiple fighting nozzles, the fire-suppression bottle group includes the first gas bottle for being stored with fire-suppressant gas and the second gas bottle for being stored with power gas, and the air pressure in the second gas bottle is more than the air pressure in first gas bottle；It is communicated with fire extinction pipeline between the bottleneck and multiple fighting nozzles of the first gas bottle, dynamic tracheae is connected between the first gas bottle and second gas bottle；It is separately provided for opening the first solenoid valve of fighting nozzle between multiple fighting nozzles and the bottleneck of first gas bottle, the second solenoid valve for being connected and blocking power tracheae is provided on the power tracheae.Having reached reduces the fire-fighting system cost and maintenance cost of building, and the advantageous effect that can safely and effectively put out a fire to burning things which may cause a fire disaster.

title_en: Teaching big data resource management system based on cloud database
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of big data and discloses a teaching big data resource management system based on a cloud database, which integrates a data preparation unit, a cloud base unit and an intelligent central unit through a layered distributed architecture, builds a closed-loop service system, relies on the elastic energy storage capacity of the cloud database, senses the teaching scene load in real time through an elastic scheduling module, dynamically adjusts the computing resources and the storage space of the database by utilizing a storage resource expansion model and a resource dynamic allocation function, realizes automatic expansion in a high-load period and accurate contraction in a low-load period, avoids the performance bottleneck and resource idle problem of the traditional scheme, simultaneously ensures the data safety through cross-region synchronization, encryption storage and disaster recovery backup, combines knowledge maps and machine learning to realize intelligent analysis and recommendation of the teaching big data, provides elastic and efficient cloud database service and big data resource service management capacity for the teaching scene, and improves the resource utilization efficiency and the teaching service quality.
assignees: DALIAN ZAODAO YOUTU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide identification method, device, equipment, medium and program product based on feature extension unet
abstract_en: The application relates to a landslide identification method, a landslide identification device, a landslide identification computer readable storage medium and a landslide identification computer program product based on characteristic extension unet. The method comprises the steps of obtaining landslide feature data of a target area according to remote sensing image data and landslide factor data of the target area where an electric facility is located, obtaining landslide recognition results of the target area according to landslide feature data by utilizing a landslide recognition model constructed based on feature expansion unet, wherein a bottleneck layer of the landslide recognition model is used for carrying out space pyramid pooling processing on deep coding features from an encoder to obtain bottleneck features, and a decoder of the landslide recognition model comprises a channel attention module which is used for processing fusion features obtained according to the deep coding features and the bottleneck features to obtain deep decoding features. By adopting the method, landslide disaster occurrence conditions of the peripheral areas of the electric power facilities can be timely and accurately identified.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD CSG;GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: First response system for hazardous materials incident
title_ko: 위험물 사고 초동대응시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system to make a first response to a dangerous material accident. The system includes: a first response processing part providing emergency action information by damage range to make a first response to an accident in a specific area by generating a damage prediction model and analyzing a damage from leakage by obtaining information on a dangerous material when the dangerous material accident occurs in the specific area; a communication part communicating with an external terminal; and a control part controlling the first response processing part and the communication part.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 위험물 사고 초동대응시스템은, 특정 지역에 위험물 사고가 발생한 경우, 상기 위험물에 대한 정보를 획득하여 피해 예측모델을 생성하고, 누출피해를 분석함으로써, 상기 특정 지역에서 사고에 대한 초동대응을 수행하기 위한 피해범위에 따른 비상조치 정보를 제공하는 초동대응 처리부; 외부 단말과 통신을 수행하는 통신부; 및 상기 통신부와 상기 초동대응 처리부를 제어하는 제어부를 포함하는 기술을 제공함에 기술적 특징이 있다.

title_en: Fire rescue hip joint assistance exoskeleton robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire rescue hip joint assisting exoskeleton robot, which comprises an exoskeleton structure body and a binding system, wherein the exoskeleton structure body is provided with a plurality of left and right side frames; the exoskeleton structure body comprises a back module, a waist module, a power module and leg modules; the two sides of the bottom of the back module are respectively connected with a waist module; the side surface of each waist module is connected with one power module, and the bottom of each power module is connected with one leg module; the bottom of the side surface of the back module far away from the human body is hinged with one end of the bottleneck of the air respirator, the air respirator is sleeved with an air respirator bandage, and the air respirator bandage is fixed on the back module; the binding system includes leg straps, waist straps, and back straps; the exoskeleton robot provided by the embodiment of the invention can avoid interference between the fire-fighting air respirator and the back space of the exoskeleton device, and realize coordinated movement of human bodies and equipment.
assignees: SHANGHAI MICRO MOTOR RESEARCH INSTITUTE NO 21 RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP COR

title_en: Disaster site injury condition identification device and distributed disaster response processing system
abstract_en: The application relates to a disaster site injury condition identification device and a distributed disaster response processing system. And constructing an entity identification model oriented to multi-disaster emergency treatment according to the disaster data. Meanwhile, vital sign data of wounded in a disaster scene are obtained, the wounded condition data are processed by using a wounded condition classification model obtained based on machine learning training to generate wounded condition results, and then wounded condition scores are obtained according to the wounded condition results and evaluation indexes corresponding to the models, so that wounded condition identifiers corresponding to the wounded persons are generated. And then, identifying and analyzing disaster data and the injury identification based on the constructed entity identification model to generate a disaster response plan. And finally, distributing the plan to each disaster site, and obtaining a scheduling strategy corresponding to the disaster site. The pertinence and the practicability of the disaster response plan are remarkably improved, reasonable allocation of rescue resources and scientific arrangement of wounded persons are ensured, and the high efficiency and the intellectualization of the disaster response process are improved.
assignees: The Second Medical Center Of Chinese PLA General Hospital

title_en: Railway material allocation and path planning method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for railway material allocation and path planning, which relate to the technical field of material allocation and comprise the steps of acquiring transportation network data and supply warehouse data; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a target planning model, optimizing and adjusting basic parameters based on a constraint function preset in the target planning model, and planning transportation paths and resource allocation in an emergency scene based on the target parameters. According to the method, the optimization model is constructed through the emergency demand data and the basic parameters, the material demand and the aging demand in an emergency scene can be effectively quantized, so that timeliness of emergency response and sufficiency of material supply are ensured, the basic parameters are optimized through the constraint function in the target planning model, the configuration of transportation resources and warehouse resources can be dynamically adjusted, the transportation path and the resource allocation are optimized, various demands in the emergency response process are met, meanwhile, the resource utilization efficiency is maximized, the emergency response cost is reduced, and the efficiency and the flexibility of emergency management are improved.
assignees: CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD;RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ELECTRONIC COMPUTING TECH CHINA ACADEMY OF RAILWAY SCIENCES CORPORATION LIMITE;Beijing jingwei information technology co ltd

title_en: Drowned rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water rescue equipment, in particular to a drowning rescue device. The device includes buoyancy base, oxygen bottle, oxygen suppliment face guard and buoyancy gasbag, and buoyancy base includes the casing, and oxygen bottle, oxygen suppliment face guard and buoyancy gasbag all are placed in the casing, are equipped with the arm via hole that runs through the casing on the casing, and the oxygen bottle includes the inner bag and wraps up the fibre parcel portion in the inner bag outside, and the bottleneck of oxygen bottle is equipped with two-position three-way valve, and the oxygen suppliment face guard passes through the oxygen hose and is connected with two-position three-way valve, and buoyancy gasbag passes through the gas tube and is connected with the gas charging connection mouth of two-position three-way valve. When in use, the oxygen supply mask is taken out from the shell to supply oxygen for people falling into water. The buoyancy air bag is taken out from the shell and inflated for the person falling into water. The drowning rescue device has the advantages of simple structure, convenience in carrying and capability of supplying oxygen, and can better ensure the safety of the rescuer while rescuing the person falling into water. Especially has great advantage for remote rescue, avoids the danger caused by the physical weakness of the rescuer.

title_en: Electric power emergency plan information instruction interaction method and related device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power systems, and discloses a power emergency plan information instruction interaction method and a related device, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a power emergency plan interaction request; obtaining a query tag based on the electric power emergency plan interaction request; selecting a plurality of electric power emergency plan text interaction instructions most relevant to the query tag from preset electric power emergency plan text interaction instructions, and feeding back the electric power emergency plan text interaction instructions; the electric power emergency plan text interaction instruction is obtained by adopting an instruction template to instruct the electric power emergency plan text. Based on the fact that the electric power emergency plan text is instructed by the instruction template to obtain a plurality of electric power emergency plan text interaction instructions, in the early warning and emergency response process, particularly complex and changeable emergency scenes, an electric power emergency plan interaction request can be formed based on the current scene, and further the instructed related electric power emergency plan text interaction instructions are fed back, emergency disposal staff can refer to and execute the electric power emergency plan text interaction instructions, and the defects caused by directly developing work according to past experience are avoided.
assignees: STATE GRID SMART GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: ARM architecture-oriented hybrid precision and vectorization collaborative optimization CGFDM seismic wave solver and simulation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CGFDM seismic wave solver and a simulation method for ARM architecture-oriented hybrid precision and vectorization collaborative optimization, which aim to break through the memory bandwidth and calculation efficiency bottleneck of ARM platform seismic simulation. According to the method, firstly, the key physical quantity is adapted to the FP16 range through dimensionless reconstruction of an elastic wave equation, and the mixed precision strategy of FP16 storage and FP32 calculation is adopted, so that the memory consumption is reduced by about 50% on the premise of ensuring the precision. Secondly, aiming at ARM Scalable Vector Expansion (SVE), CGFDM differential templates are mapped to vector registers, SIMD parallel computation is realized, and throughput is remarkably improved. Finally, the FP16-SVE solver realizes data rearrangement and conversion between FP16/FP32, solves the alignment and efficiency problems in mixed precision operation, and realizes synchronous improvement of storage and calculation efficiency. Tests show that the method can maintain the accuracy, simultaneously halve the memory and obtain a speed-up ratio of approximately 3 times, and provides an efficient scheme for ARM platform large-scale earthquake simulation and real-time disaster evaluation.
assignees: NAT SUPERCOMPUTING CENTER IN SHENZHEN SHENZHEN CLOUD COMPUTING CENTER

title_en: State detection method for robot and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a state detection method for a robot and related equipment. The method comprises the steps of carrying out hardware resource monitoring, ROS node monitoring and sensor data monitoring on a robot when the robot drives automatically at a low speed, respectively obtaining hardware monitoring information, node monitoring information and sensor monitoring information and taking the hardware monitoring information, the node monitoring information and the sensor monitoring information as monitoring information sets, judging whether each piece of monitoring information in the monitoring information sets accords with a corresponding monitoring standard or not, taking monitoring information which does not accord with the corresponding monitoring standard as target monitoring information, obtaining fault processing information according to the target monitoring information, and processing faults of the robot according to the fault processing information. And evaluating the collected hardware monitoring information, node monitoring information and sensor monitoring information according to preset monitoring standards, and timely finding out resource bottlenecks and sensor anomalies, so that emergency response capability is remarkably improved.
assignees: SUZHOU GUANGMU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Novel split type regulator cubicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel split type regulator cubicle, including the regulator cubicle box, the outside top of regulator cubicle box sets up installs the carbon dioxide storage bottle, the siren is installed to regulator cubicle box one end lateral wall, powerful radiator fan is installed to the inside upper end of regulator cubicle box, the carbon dioxide nozzle has been installed on the inside top of regulator cubicle box, the hose that the carbon dioxide nozzle set up through the outside top of regulator cubicle box is connected with the reaction switch valve of carbon dioxide storage bottle bottleneck end installation, the smoke sensor is installed to regulator cubicle box one end inside wall, the outside bottom of regulator cubicle box is provided with a truckle. The utility model relates to a novelty, simple structure, the effectual heat that produces of regulator cubicle is effectual dispels, can make urgent safeguard measure and move the convenience at electric fire scene when taking place to electric fire disaster effectively, reduces the loss, and functional powerful and diversified are fit for being extensively promoted and used more.
assignees: SHENYANG ZNTAI ELECTRIC EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for forecasting storm flood in medium-small river basin with high space-time resolution
abstract_en: The application relates to precipitation and runoff forecasting technology. The application discloses a method for forecasting storm flood in a medium-small river basin with high space-time resolution, which is characterized by adopting a WRF model as a rainfall forecasting mode, correcting a rainfall error of the WRF forecast by a deviation correction method, adopting a distributed hydrologic physical model as a river basin hydrologic model, establishing a storm flood coupling forecasting model based on the WRF model and the distributed hydrologic physical model, and forecasting the river basin flood by the storm flood coupling forecasting model. The application breaks through the technical bottleneck in the storm flood forecast of the middle and small river basins, improves the intelligent degree, the accuracy, the forecast period and the forecast efficiency of the storm flood coupling forecast, meets the national important requirements of flood control and disaster reduction and the wide application requirements of industries, provides an advanced and practical forecast model platform for production units such as weather bureaus (weather desk), flood control and the like, and has important practical value, social significance and civil significance.

title_en: Method for constructing natural disaster risk knowledge graph of photovoltaic project
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a photovoltaic project natural disaster risk knowledge graph, which relates to the field of key infrastructure risk assessment and comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a photovoltaic project natural disaster geographic information database based on text big data, S2, extracting the photovoltaic project natural disaster risk causal relationship based on machine learning, and S3, drawing the photovoltaic project natural disaster risk knowledge graph based on the photovoltaic project natural disaster geographic information database and the photovoltaic project natural disaster risk causal relationship. The method breaks through the data bottleneck from the source, fully exerts the advantages of big data of the disaster text, builds a big sample database aiming at the natural disasters of the photovoltaic project through natural language processing and a geographic information system platform, and therefore the natural disaster knowledge graph built by the method has universality and integrity.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORPORATION SICHUAN ENERGY INVEST CO LTD;CHINA THREE GORGES CORP

title_en: Industrial control network emergency response method based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention provides an industrial control network emergency response method based on a knowledge graph, which carries out knowledge modeling on industrial control network emergency response related knowledge, and constructs an industrial control security threat information base, an industrial control vulnerability knowledge base, an industrial control virus feature base, an industrial control malicious attack load base, an industrial control attack behavior feature base, an industrial control security threat judgment knowledge base and an industrial control network security threat emergency response processing template base, and on the basis, knowledge extraction, knowledge fusion and reasoning calculation are carried out to support threat detection and emergency response tasks under the complex scene of an industrial network. The threat information acquisition mode of 'active and passive combination' is adopted, based on threat judgment of 'feature, abnormality and behavior' combination, a simulation response strategy of 'virtual and actual combination' and an emergency response support mechanism of 'on-site remote combination'. The accuracy of safety threat judgment facing the industrial control network and the efficiency of adopting targeted emergency response are improved, and the possible loss caused by the safety threat is reduced.

title_en: Automated panic button response system with location-based video feeds and telephonic connections
abstract_en: A panic button response system includes a panic button installed at a facility and a service provider system with a database containing location data, video feeds, and active telephones for the facility. The service provider system's server, in communication with the panic button and the database, receives an activation signal from the panic button and automatically initiates a response process. This process involves identifying the panic button's location using the database, activating available video feeds at the identified location, and establishing a telephonic connection to a telephone at the identified location. The system enhances security and emergency response capabilities by swiftly and efficiently responding to panic button activations at the facility.

title_en: Power plant safety emergency management system
abstract_en: The invention provides a power plant safety emergency management system. The power plant safety emergency management system comprises S1, a real-time monitoring module is established, S2, a data system early warning prediction, S3, risk intelligent diagnosis, S4, emergency response processing, S5, remote monitoring and control, S6, data analysis and report, the power plant safety emergency management system can quickly discover abnormal conditions by monitoring the state and environmental parameters of power plant equipment in real time through a sensor, can avoid safety accidents caused by negligence, and performs intelligent data analysis and decision support by means of big data and a system algorithm, the system can automatically start an emergency response flow, reduce human intervention time and accident loss, has self-learning capability, provides an optimization scheme for safety management of corresponding regional plates of a power plant, prevents similar conditions from happening for multiple times, and reduces loss.

title_en: Method and system for cooperatively scheduling buses and buses between stations
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bus and station cooperative dispatching method and system, firstly, collecting data in real time by using bus cooperative equipment on the bus side and station side and acquiring collected data, preprocessing and fusing the collected data to acquire a fused data set, constructing a safety early warning model of the bus and the station based on the fused data set, and identifying safety risks and generating safety early warning information by using the safety early warning model; the invention realizes the monitoring and dispatching functions of providing high efficiency, safety and intelligence for urban public transportation, is beneficial to improving the traveling experience of passengers and reducing the bus operation cost, promotes the sustainable development of urban transportation, and simultaneously automatically identifies potential safety hazards and operation bottlenecks through the fusion of video data and radar data so as to generate safety early warning and dispatching optimization suggestions, thereby ensuring the safety of passengers and vehicles, improving the bus service efficiency and quality, and being suitable for being widely popularized and used.
assignees: NANJING WISDOM TRAFFIC INFORMATION CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent life early warning method for electrolytic capacitor, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power electronics, and discloses an intelligent life early warning method of an electrolytic capacitor, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein online monitoring data of the electrolytic capacitor are split into two steps through a two-stage architecture of coarse screening before fine calculation: the method has the advantages that the truly abnormal individuals are quickly locked by the lightweight deviation analysis and LOF algorithm, and then the calculation force is concentrated on a few outlier capacitors to run the neural network for fine prediction, so that the bottleneck of insufficient calculation force of the edge chip is avoided, and the non-uniform constraint of the service life curves of manufacturers is avoided. And then consistency detection is carried out on the outlier prediction results, statistical fluctuation and high risk decline are automatically distinguished, so that the accuracy of life early warning is obviously improved while the real-time performance is ensured, potential capacitors can be replaced in advance by operation and maintenance personnel according to early warning grades, disaster faults such as leakage and explosion are avoided, and long-period reliable operation of the power electronic conversion equipment is realized.

title_en: Dual-track work process management system and management method that considers disaster response optimization and daily work continuity
title_ko: 재난 대응업무 최적화와 일상업무 연속성을 고려한 듀얼 트랙 업무 프로세스 관리시스템 및 관리방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a dual-track business process management system, management method, and program that considers disaster response optimization and daily business continuity. More specifically, the system comprises a regulation module that derives dual-track business continuity process data for an organization by performing a step-by-step analysis of the organization's current status, business impact analysis, and risk analysis. The dual-track business continuity process data comprises disaster response process data and daily business process data. The system relates to a dual-track business process management system that considers disaster response optimization and daily business continuity.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 대응업무 최적화와 일상업무 연속성을 고려한 듀얼 트랙 업무 프로세스 관리시스템, 관리방법 및 프로그램에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 기관의 현황분석, 업무영향분석, 위험분석을 단계적으로 실시하여 기관의 듀얼 트랙 업무 연속성 프로세스 데이터를 도출하는 규정모듈;을 포함하고, 상기 듀얼 트랙 업무 연속성 프로세스 데이터는 재난대응업무 프로세스 데이터와, 일상업무 프로세스 데이터를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 재난 대응업무 최적화와 일상업무 연속성을 고려한 듀얼 트랙 업무 프로세스 관리시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Quick starting method of wireless fire-fighting linkage equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication safety, in particular to a quick starting method of wireless fire-fighting linkage equipment. The method comprises the following steps: performing network protocol pre-configuration processing and network connection configuration on the wireless fire-fighting linkage equipment to obtain a wireless fire-fighting linkage equipment connection network; the smoke monitoring sensor and the temperature monitoring sensor are used for carrying out emergency triggering processing on fire signals to obtain emergency triggering signals of fire events; carrying out signal positioning, identifying and analyzing on the emergency triggering signal of the fire event to obtain the position information data of the fire event; performing broadcast response processing on the emergency trigger signal of the fire event to obtain a fire event coordinated control broadcast response instruction; based on the fire event occurrence position information data and the fire event linkage control broadcast response instruction, instruction transmission distance monitoring and distance limiting linkage starting are carried out, and a wireless fire control linkage equipment starting command is generated to execute a fire control emergency response task. The invention can rapidly realize the starting of the fire-fighting equipment.

title_en: Disaster-tolerant emergency switching exercise decision model and switching method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster recovery emergency switching exercise decision-making model and a switching method, wherein the disaster recovery emergency switching exercise decision-making model comprises a disaster recovery data center and an emergency takeover platform, wherein the emergency takeover platform comprises a cloud platform supporting module, a data level backup module, an application level disaster recovery module, a database disaster recovery module and a comprehensive management module; the implementation of the emergency take-over platform introduces highly modularized service design and dynamic visual monitoring, so that an operation and maintenance team can quickly and accurately identify and solve problems, meanwhile, the application of the intelligent fault hierarchical response model simplifies the traditional response process, a manager can acquire key information in time and make decisions quickly through intelligent analysis of the module, and the automatic arrangement and dynamic execution of the emergency plan improves the service continuity operation capability and department collaborative efficiency.

title_en: Extreme weather event prediction and emergency response system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of extreme weather emergency management, and particularly relates to an extreme weather event prediction and emergency response system. The method solves the problems of multi-source data fracturing, disaster chain prediction missing, static plan rigidification and lack of closed loop evolution in the prior art. The global disaster map is built through multi-source data real-time fusion, extreme weather and secondary disaster refined deduction is achieved through coupling of a physical mechanism and machine learning, a self-adaptive emergency scheme is generated based on a dynamic resource library and an optimization algorithm, and disaster feedback data driving models and strategy iteration are utilized to form an intelligent closed loop of prediction-decision-feedback-evolution. The method has the advantages of eliminating information islands, breaking through disaster chain modeling bottlenecks, dynamically optimizing resource scheduling, establishing a self-evolution mechanism and improving extreme weather coping efficiency.

title_en: Method and device carrying out path backtracking for system attack
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device carrying out path backtracking for system attack. The method comprises steps that, Netflow data, routing topology data and router information are acquired; a system attack safety event is acquired; on the basis of the system attack safety event and the acquired Netflow data, the routing topology data and the router information, path backtracking for the system attack is carried out by utilizing a breadth transversal method. Through the method, Internet attack emergency response processing efficiency can be effectively improved.

title_en: Transfer station accessibility service capability evaluation method, transfer station accessibility service capability evaluation device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a transfer station access service capability evaluation method, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method determines the average setting rate of transfer identifiers, the average saturation of transfer channels and the average load degree of ride-down equipment; determining an average single pass arrival time; and evaluating the accessibility service capability of the transfer station according to the average setting rate of the transfer identification, the average saturation of the transfer passage, the average load degree of the ride-down equipment and the average one-way accessibility time. According to the method, the accessibility service capability evaluation of the transfer station is carried out according to the average setting rate of transfer identifications, the average saturation of transfer channels, the average load degree of the take-off and landing equipment and the average one-way accessibility time, the evaluation method of the accessibility service of the transfer station under multiple factors is realized, the junction connection effect of the transfer station in a network is clearly reflected, the performance improvement and the later-stage new line opening under the bottleneck of a traffic junction are guided, and the method has strong practical significance for passenger flow dredging and drainage under the emergency condition.

title_en: Water life-saving neck ring
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Water life-saving neck ring, including necklace ontology, air bag, compressed gas cylinder, cylindrical outer casing, switch module and power supply；Cylindrical outer casing is fixed on front side of necklace ontology；Compressed gas cylinder is installed on the inside of cylindrical outer casing for being inflated into air bag, and the switch module is installed on the end of cylindrical outer casing, and switch module includes the solenoid valve telepathy trigger switch outside the thimble switch of push type and the press-side for covering on thimble switch；Thimble switch thimble towards compressed gas cylinder bottleneck, an emergency situation is encountered in water, user can manual trigger switch component, when user can not be manually operated in time, solenoid valve telepathy trigger switch automatic trigger switch can be passed through, make airbag aeration and by being popped up in necklace ontology, user is helped to keep afloat, achievees the purpose that emergency self-saving, this product is small, can body-worn, it is flexible and convenient to use, securely and reliably.

title_en: Method and system for selecting emergency evacuation path of passengers in departure hall of terminal building
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency evacuation, in particular to a method and a system for selecting an emergency evacuation path of passengers in a hall of a terminal building, which are used for acquiring the conditions of emergency evacuation physical facilities in the hall of the terminal building, and acquiring the environmental conditions of the hall of the terminal building and the conditions of the passengers to be evacuated; inputting emergency evacuation physical facility conditions, environment conditions, passenger conditions to be evacuated and a path generation algorithm into an emergency evacuation model, and solving a passenger evacuation path through simulation software; the method takes the influence of the layout of a terminal building departure hall, the characteristics of passengers, evacuation bottlenecks and the like on the evacuation path into consideration by constructing a terminal building infrastructure, collecting data and a path selection model, generates an optimal path for passenger evacuation by means of Anylogic simulation software and programming, verifies the feasibility of the optimal path, improves the evacuation efficiency of passengers in the face of emergency, and ensures the personal and property safety of the passengers.

title_en: Disaster recovery response processing method for multiple virtual machines in high-availability cloud computing cluster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster recovery response processing method for multiple virtual machines in a high-availability cloud computing cluster, which is characterized in that the running state, the load condition and the data condition of each virtual machine are known in time by acquiring the current data list and the state grade value of each virtual machine, so that basic data is provided for subsequent decisions; determining virtual machines to be transferred according to a preset virtual machine state grade numerical threshold, acquiring target data lists corresponding to the virtual machines, identifying the virtual machines to be subjected to disaster recovery response processing, and preparing for subsequent load transfer; determining that the target is transferred into the virtual machine through analysis such as probability analysis, priority calculation sequencing, fuzzy influence reference quantity and the like according to the target data list and the state grade value of the virtual machine, and ensuring that the transferred target virtual machine can effectively process data and requests; and turning the data access request corresponding to the target data list to a target to transfer into a virtual machine, so as to ensure the continuity and stability of data access.
assignees: TIANJIN CHUANGZHI XINTONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting safety evacuation management and control system for large commercial complex
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire control, in particular to a fire control safety evacuation control system for a large commercial complex, which is used for solving the problems of vertical through of multiple floors, rapid diffusion of smoke poison gas and high temperature, sudden drop of visibility, high people flow density, easy congestion and backflow of channel capacity bottlenecks in a scene in a large commercial complex fire disaster, and lack of safety and high-efficiency evacuation control capable of dynamically updating and connecting with a parallel instruction and illumination along with situations.

title_en: IP Based Broadcasting System for Offshore Platform and Ships
title_ko: Ip 기반의 원격 제어식 해양 구조물 및 선박용 방송 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an IP-based remotely-controlled broadcasting system for an offshore platform and a ship, which has an emergency and distress situation guidance broadcasting function and, more particularly, a technology of implementing an IP-based remotely-controlled broadcasting system that may convert the conventional analog-based broadcasting system used for an offshore platform and a ship into a digital communication. The IP-based multimedia broadcasting system for an offshore platform and a ship includes: a graphic user interface-based integrated management control module that integrally manages the entire broadcasting system and has a broadcasting algorithm for an emergency situation stored therein; a network control sound source module that has a sound source database stored therein and may operate and manage a sound source; a network public address broadcasting module that transmits network-based multi-channel public address broadcasting; a network remote amp module that classifies IP control broadcasting areas and transmits warning and guiding broadcasting; an Ethernet switch module that supports a full-duplex communication method and transmits and receives data such that there is no bottleneck phenomenon; a firefighting fire receiver module that dualizes and transmits a fire signal and is controlled by a network; an IP sound broadcasting gateway module that receives and transmits network audio broadcasting; a digital power amp module that may receive and transmit the network audio broadcasting and amplifies a sound signal; a network speaker selector module that accesses and controls a digital control-based multi-channel speaker line; and a plurality of satellite speaker modules that is installed in a warning and guiding broadcasting demand zone in an offshore structure and a ship to output a sound.
abstract_ko:

title_en: Emergency situation understanding system, method and storage medium based on multi-mode large model
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency situation understanding system based on a multi-mode large model, which comprises a multi-mode data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a multi-mode large model deployment module, a situation understanding and question-answering generation module and a tool registration and management module. Through four major core innovations of multi-mode fusion, edge intelligence, dynamic optimization and cross-domain cooperation, the bottleneck problems of the traditional emergency system in the aspects of data utilization, instantaneity, safety, intellectualization and the like are solved, the response speed, decision accuracy and cooperation efficiency of emergency management are remarkably improved, and efficient and reliable technical support is provided for the fields of public safety, disaster relief, military emergency and the like.
assignees: THE FIRST RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF TELECOMMUNICATIONS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency material scheduling method
abstract_en: The application discloses an emergency material dispatching method, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a distributed edge architecture, including edge nodes, a public platform and a cloud center which are deployed in a disaster area, wherein the cloud center is used for integrating edge node data and public platform data, constructing a global resource dynamic distribution map, generating a dispatching instruction according to material demand distribution, generating a local optimal path based on the global resource dynamic distribution map, performing global correction, determining a dispatching target priority according to disaster area early warning level and emergency material dispatching demand urgency, acquiring vehicle positions, loads and global correction paths in real time, synchronizing a supplier inventory list, and generating the dispatching instruction. The application can dynamically coordinate resources in disaster areas, avoid the bottleneck of centralized scheduling, reduce the idle driving mileage and delay and improve the resource allocation efficiency.

title_en: Outdoor Evacuation Simulation System for Disasters and Emergencies
title_ko: 재난 및 비상 상황에서의 실외 대피 시뮬레이션 시스템
abstract_en: In a simulation system estimating an evacuation route and an evacuation time by precisely simulating movement of a vehicle and a pedestrian in a disaster and emergency situation, provided is an outdoor evacuation simulation system in a disaster and emergency situation comprising: a road network data processing module; a movement model; a movement route calculation module; an occupant attribute management and evacuation time estimation module; a pedestrian movement module; a visualization and animation output module; a disaster scenario configuration module; and a road network data processing and management module. An outdoor evacuation simulation system in a disaster and emergency situation and an evacuation time estimation method according to the present invention relate to a technical field estimating the evacuation time and visually presenting the evacuation route by utilizing a Cellular Automata theory and a Micro Simulation model to simulate movement of a vehicle and walking evacuation of a person. Precisely simulating a movement route, a speed, and a vehicle type of an individual vehicle in a unit of 1 second is possible. Analyzing a bottleneck phenomenon and a congested section specifically is possible. Enabling precise individual vehicle movement simulation while maintaining calculation efficiency even in a large-scale network is possible through Cell unit modeling based on Cellular Automata.

title_en: Intelligent fire prevention monitoring method and system applied to gas film system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an intelligent fire prevention monitoring method and system applied to a gas film system. The method comprises the following steps: generating a gas film operation monitoring map according to the characteristic information of the gas film system, acquiring dynamic environment information to generate a gas film fire prevention dynamic monitoring model tree, extracting a gas film system dynamic fire hazard data set, combining the extracted gas film system fire hazard characteristic parameters to obtain gas film fire prevention dynamic response data, calibrating the gas film fire hazard dynamic characteristic value obtained from a gas film fire prevention monitoring platform to obtain a gas film operation fire hazard calibration value, and comparing the gas film fire hazard calibration value with a preset gas film system fire hazard threshold value to monitor the dynamic fire hazard state of the gas film system; therefore, the technology for monitoring the dynamic fire disaster state of the gas film by combining the gas film system with the dynamic environment information to perform model monitoring to obtain dynamic fire disaster data and performing dynamic response processing to obtain dynamic characteristic values of the fire disaster and comparing the calibrated threshold values to monitor the dynamic fire disaster state of the gas film is realized, and the technology for dynamically and intelligently monitoring the hidden fire hazards of the gas film, the system and the environment through a big data platform is realized.
assignees: ZHONGCHENG SPACE SHENZHEN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_ko: 분산 대피 경로 생성 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 실시예에 따른 분산 대피 경로 생성 방법은 건물 내 복수 개의 구역 및 출구로부터 대피하는 인원들의 대피 경로를 생성하는 방법에 있어서, 다음의 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 분산 대피 경로 생성 방법으로서, a. 각 구역의 현재 인원수를 파악하고, 각 출구의 수용 인원을 설정하며, 각 출구와 인접한 구역을 결정하는 단계와, b. a 단계에서 설정된 정보에 기초하여, 각 출구의 수용 인원만큼 해당 출구로 대피할 인접 구역의 인원들을 비율에 따라 초기 배분하는 단계와, c. b 단계에서 설정된 대피 경로상의 통로에 대한 실시간 인원 밀도를 파악하고, 인원 밀도에 따라 통로별 이동 속도를 계산하며, 이를 기반으로 해당 통로의 가중치를 동적으로 조절하는 단계와, d. 대피 경로상의 통로에 존재하는 장애물의 크기 및 상대 점유율과, 화재 시 연기 및 조명으로 인해 예상되는 시야 확보 난이도에 따라, 통로에 추가 가중치를 부여하는 단계 및 e. 강화 학습 기반의 분산 대피 모델을 이용하여, 각 개인의 최단 시간 탈출 및 전체 인원의 대피 시간 최소화의 두 가지 목표를 동시에 고려하고, c 단계와 d 단계에서 부여된 가중치들을 통합하여 대피 경로를 재조정하는 단계를 포함한다. 
상기와 같은 본 발명에 따르면, 출구들의 수용률과 각 출구에 인접한 구역의 인원수와 혼잡도, 장애물 및 시야 난이도 등을 종합적으로 반영하여 경로 가중치를 동적으로 조절함으로써, 기존의 정적 대피 계획이 예측하지 못하는 병목 현상이나 위험 구역을 효과적으로 회피하도록 최적의 분산 대피 방법을 제공함으로써 재난 발생 시 인원들을 최대한 빠르고 안전하게 대피시켜 인명 피해를 최소화할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: System applied to electrical equipment and provided with extremely early fire early warning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire alarm, in particular to a system with extremely early fire early warning function applied to electrical equipment. The system comprises a pre-disaster signal acquisition module and a response signal transmission mode planning module. The invention monitors the pre-disaster information in the narrow electric space in real time through the pre-disaster signal acquisition module, performs timely response processing by matching with the distributed external equipment, transmits different detection signals to corresponding targets through the response signal transmission mode planning module by combining the classified detection signals, responds to the corresponding targets according to the state change of the electric space, thereby realizing multi-target classification processing, ensuring that the pre-disaster signals with rapid development trend can be processed through the external equipment in time, simultaneously responding to the pre-disaster signals with slow development, performing processing through manual work, acquiring action execution conditions in real time, judging whether the external equipment needs to be started for the second time, and improving the flexibility of the whole system.
assignees: LAIWU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent patrol control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent patrol control method, which relates to the technical field of intelligent patrol control and mainly comprises the steps of obtaining a resource data storage model according to patrol resources, obtaining a quick response police task based on a shortest path calculation and task matching method according to the resource data storage model, confirming a serious police condition or a safety event, carrying out emergency response processing according to the quick response police task, and carrying out multi-equipment cooperative scheduling according to a scheduling task and patrol resources. By implementing the intelligent patrol control method provided by the invention, the police dispatch efficiency and response capability can be improved, the accuracy and the synergy of police resource integration are improved, the system construction and operation cost is reduced, the safety and the reliability of the system are enhanced, and the handling capability of emergency events is improved.

title_en: A kind of elevator rescue channel based on fault pre-alarming mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of elevator rescue channels based on fault pre-alarming mechanism, including security control center, cloud server, lift car, elevator monitoring terminal, ladder carries monitoring, ladder carries screen, elevator data collector, photoelectricity leveling inductor, weight sensor, linear velocity trans, elevator monitoring terminal, ladder carries monitoring, ladder carries screen, elevator data collector, photoelectricity leveling inductor, weight sensor, linear velocity trans are respectively mounted on the elevator car, and it is interconnected by conducting wire, elevator monitoring terminal is connected with the power supply system that elevator is run, elevator monitoring terminal also passes through network connection cloud server, the cloud server is connected by network with security control center.This system realizes that elevator faults early warning and lift facility operating status monitor in real time, when elevator malfunction accident occurs, trapped person and quick response processing are remotely pacified, upgrading updates cloud algorithm model in time, elevator significant trouble probability of happening is reduced, ensures boarding safety.
assignees: GUANGDONG COUNTRY GARDEN PROPERTY SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Water transportation emergency evacuation deployment method based on balanced flow distribution model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water transportation emergency evacuation deployment method based on a balanced flow distribution model, which comprises the steps of determining the defining range of layered emergency evacuation, establishing a water transportation emergency evacuation accessibility data model, guiding people in an evacuation forced area to an evacuation buffer area in a walking way based on the data model, and transporting people from the evacuation buffer area to an evacuation buffer destination in a water transportation way. The invention discloses a generation method of a water transportation emergency evacuation deployment method of a balanced flow distribution model, which is used for enhancing the planning of an emergency evacuation channel of a water transportation passenger ship, eliminating emergency evacuation bottlenecks, enhancing the connectivity of a water transportation passenger evacuation road system for various passenger ship emergencies, eliminating the emergency evacuation bottlenecks as much as possible through scientific planning and improving the smoothness, safety and reliability of the passenger emergency evacuation channel.

title_en: Emergency response processor of uniaxial, two-rudder vessel
abstract_en: To provide an emergency response processor of an uniaxial, two-rudder vessel, which instructs the vessel operator awoken from a doze to perform the first maneuver of the vessel and stops urgently the vessel at a colliding crisis moment.SOLUTION: An emergency response processor of an uniaxial, two-rudder vessel comprises a vessel radar device 310, a bridge navigation watch alarm device 320, a display device 262 and an alarm device 330, the vessel radar device 310 sends the collision alarm signal to a steering control device 200 when the collision with another vessel is predicted, the bridge navigational watch alarm device 320 sends the on-duty person abnormal alarm signal to the steering control device 200 when the movement of the vessel operator is not detected for the prescribed hours, and the steering control device 200 emits the audible alarm from the alarm device 330 while displaying the emergency response information on the display device 262 to urge the emergency stop of the vessel when the steering control device receives the alarm signal input from both the vessel radar device 310 and the bridge navigation watch alarm device 320.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Emergency rescue box
abstract_en: The utility model provides an emergency rescue box which is flexible and convenient to use and can be used for realizing the first aid for a plurality of wounded personnel in the open air and can be operated by doctors and nurses in the whole day, is portable and double-shouldered and is used for emergency rescue and disaster relief. The emergency rescue box comprises an upper cover (1), a clamping bottleneck (2), a surgery table (3), a clean drawer (4), an emergency medicine drawer (5), a sterile drawer (6), an emergency operation kit drawer (7), a water purifier, an oxygen machine (8), a lifting infusion stand (9), an injection table (10), a light-source lamp drawer (11), a solar charger, an ultraviolet disinfection lamp (12), a hole (13) and a medical garbage bag storage drawer (14). By adopting the structure, the emergency rescue box is convenient for realizing treatment and curing before the hospital, guaranteeing life and realizing the timely wounded personnel rescue, infusion, oxygen uptake, wound binding-up and emergency operations.

title_en: Planting, domesticating and cultivating process for nervilia fordii
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nervilia fordii cultivation processes, and discloses a nervilia fordii planting and domesticating cultivation process. According to the nervilia fordii planting, domestication and cultivation process, through screening of high-quality propagation materials, the artificial domestication and cultivation technology of nervilia fordii is solved, a standardized cultivation technology system is established, further, the technology and the propagation materials are provided for the production and development requirements of nervilia fordii, excessive collection of resources is reduced or avoided, and the purposes of effective protection and sustainable development and utilization of seed sources are achieved. The process can promote the mass production of the nervilia fordii, solve the problem of raw material supply of pharmaceutical enterprises, and solve the bottleneck problem limited by the shortage of raw materials in production. The method is beneficial to solving the contradiction between the supply and demand of the medicinal materials in the market; the phenomenon of excessive mining and digging of wild resources is reduced or avoided; effectively protects the traditional Chinese medicine resources and realizes the sustainable development and utilization of the traditional Chinese medicine resources; various disasters such as flood flooding, landslide and the like caused by the destruction of resources are reduced; achieving the purpose of harmonious development of human and nature with obvious ecological benefit.

title_en: River mouth coastal embankment risk early warning evaluation system and method under composite disaster factor
abstract_en: The risk warning and assessment system and method for estuarine and coastal embankments under composite disaster factors involve the field of water conservancy engineering safety monitoring and risk assessment technology, including multi-source data collection module, data preprocessing module, dynamic indicator system construction module, adaptive weight determination module, risk assessment module, refined warning level division module, and visual decision support module. The present invention achieves real-time perception, quantitative evaluation, and graded warning of embankment safety status through multi-source heterogeneous data fusion technology and adaptive weight optimization algorithm. It can be directly applied to disaster prevention and reduction in coastal cities, full life cycle operation and maintenance of embankment projects, emergency response to major storm surge disasters, etc., effectively breaking through the technical bottleneck of "single disaster factor, static weight, and insufficient warning accuracy" in traditional assessment methods, Provide precise technical support for the safety protection of river mouth and coastal embankments.
