title_en: Method and apparatus for identifying and disabling worms in communication networks
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for enabling a network security service and network security infrastructure to detect, identify, mitigate, neutralize, and disable worms through distributed worm probes that can be linked to centralized monitoring systems for emergency response process is disclosed. The worm probes track packets with destination unreachable errors on a per source IP address basis. In one embodiment, when the number of such errors exceeds a predefined local threshold, e.g., within a predefined local time period at a worm probe, the count of such errors as well as the source IP address will be sent to all other worm probes in the network as an alert. When the number of such errors exceeds a predefined global threshold, e.g., within a predefined global time period, traffic from the endpoint device with the identified source IP address will be blocked to prevent that endpoint device from spreading worms further.

abstract_en: A training system using simulating operation of unmanned rail system and method using the same are provided to virtually express the various situation. title_en: Firework setting off equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses firework setting off equipment, which can reduce the setting off cost, ensure setting off safety and improve the setting off effect. The equipment comprises a launching unit, which controls setting off of a plurality of fireworks by controlling different nodes and different time of output high level. The equipment also comprises a timer shaft event processing module 101, a firework setting off response processing module 102 and a wireless communication module 103, wherein a timer shaft event point 201 contained in the timer shaft event processing module 101 corresponds to a response event point 202 contained in the firework setting off response processing module 102; the wireless communication module 103 comprises an automatic transmitting assembly 302 for a firework operation command 301, a disaster emergency processing module 303 which commands subsequent fireworks to quit the setting off program or a setting off place; the disaster emergency processing module 303 comprises a supplier database 501 and a communication module 502; and a transmitter, an igniter or the firework body is provided with a command receiving module 503.

title_en: Personal portable water purification device
abstract_en: The emergency personal portable water purifying apparatus can be used by individuals to purify water that has become contaminated by natural or man-made disasters. The apparatus is lightweight, self contained, fits on most standard bottlenecks by using an expandable sealing collar integrated into the purifier and needs no extra power supply. The water is forced through the filter by pressure on the sides of the bottle or suction from the mouthpiece. The water purifier has a water inlet with a residue collection area and quick fitting changeable mouthpiece valve on the water outlet. Water is flocculated and large particles, residue and sediments are contained in the particular residue collection area. Water then passes through a micron net to remove remaining particles and is forced through the active carbon chamber via the spiral form to the water outlet.

title_en: Chain extension power supply system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power supply system, in particular to a chain extension power supply system, which is applied to bar-shaped and zonal urban regions. In a set region, three power points distributed in a bar shape are provided, four feeder lines are formed between every two adjacent power points, each feeder line adopts a multi-segment connection mode, and power is supplied to the region by feeder line units of a double-loop network. The chain extension power supply system initiatively put forwards a chain extension intermediate-voltage distribution network power supply mode suitable for the standardization and differentiation of bar-shaped and zonal regional forms, has high symmetry and uniformity, optimizes the power distribution points of a high voltage distribution networks and reorganizes the network structure of an intermediate voltage distribution network, thereby improving the power supply reliability of the distribution network, shortening the power failure time of a ser, enhancing the power supply transferring capability of the distribution network, gradually eliminating power supply 'bottlenecks' and weak links, enhancing the resistance of the distribution network to natural disasters and providing strong support for the construction of the distribution network. In a development process, the power supply system has relatively higher extensibility, and the reliability of the system is fully ensured.

The chain extension power supply system initiatively put forwards a chain extension intermediate-voltage distribution network power supply mode suitable for the standardization and differentiation of bar-shaped and zonal regional forms, has high symmetry and uniformity, optimizes the power distribution points of a high voltage distribution networks and reorganizes the network structure of an intermediate voltage distribution network, thereby improving the power supply reliability of the distribution network, shortening the power failure time of a ser, enhancing the power supply transferring capability of the distribution network, gradually eliminating power supply 'bottlenecks' and weak links, enhancing the resistance of the distribution network to natural disasters and providing strong support for the construction of the distribution network. In a development process, the power supply system has relatively higher extensibility, and the reliability of the system is fully ensured.

title_en: Mine emergency communication system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mine communication system, in particular to an emergency communication support system of coal mines. The emergency communication support system comprises an integrated command rescue call center server, an IP (Internet Protocol) telephone switchboard and an voice gateway, which are interactively connected through Ethernet, wherein the voice gateway is simultaneously connected to a dispatching switchboard, an integrated IP voice access gateway for mine is adopted as the voice gateway, a 32-bit embedded microprocessor is adopted for the voice access gateway, a protocol conversion address of the microprocessor is connected with a system interface module, a serial port of the microprocessor is connected with a field bus protocol conversion module, the field bus protocol conversion module is connected with an underground dispatching amplified phone, an MAC (Media Access Control) address of the microprocessor is connected with a network module, and the microprocessor is connected with an Ethernet switchboard through the network module. The microprocessor is provided with a corresponding data interface for connecting an optical fiber transmission module, the microprocessor is accessed to an underground industrial optical fiber ring net through the optical fiber transmission module, and the underground loud-speaking phone is accessed to the underground industrial optical fiber ring net through a converter. According to the mine communication system disclosed by the invention, a difficult problem of the speed bottleneck in the wide-band network underground communication of a mine area is solved, and a way is paved for networking and informatizing of a mine monitoring system.

abstract_en: The utility model relates to a communication system for a mine, in particular to an emergency communication guaranteeing system for a coal mine. title_en: Computer information system and dynamic disaster recovery method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a computer information system and a dynamic disaster recovery method of the computer information system. The computer information system comprises more than two service clusters divided according to service classes and dynamic disaster recovery nodes. Each service cluster comprises more than two service nodes, and each service node has service processing logics of all service types in the system. The dynamic disaster recovery nodes are used for setting dynamic disaster recovery strategies of all the service clusters and monitoring running conditions of all the service clusters. Under the condition that all the service clusters run normally, according to the dynamic disaster recovery strategies, service requests of all service classes are dispatched to the service clusters corresponding to the service classes to be subjected to response processing. Under the condition that a certain service cluster runs abnormally, a response service cluster and/or a response mode of the service requests of the corresponding service class are adjusted dynamically according to the dynamic disaster recovery strategy of the service cluster. The robustness of the computer information system can be improved by using the dynamic disaster recovery method.

title_en: SOP scenario executing system and providing method thereof
title_ko: Sop 시나리오 구동 시스템 및 그 제공방법
abstract_ko: SOP 시나리오를 플로우차트 형태 등으로 가시화하여 재난 발생 시의 대처 절차를 용이하게 파악할 수 있도록 하는 SOP 시나리오 구동 시스템 및 그 제공방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 측면에 따르면, 소정의 제1 이벤트가 발생한 경우의 표준적인 대응절차를 정의한 제1 SOP(Standard Operating Procedure) 시나리오가 저장된 SOP DB, 상기 제1 SOP 시나리오에 포함된 복수의 단위SOP 각각에 상응하는 오브젝트, 및 각 단위 SOP 간의 선후관계를 디스플레이하는 디스플레이모듈 및 상기 복수의 단위SOP 중 수행될 차례가 된 단위SOP에 설정된 작업을 수행하고, 작업이 수행된 상기 단위SOP가 완료되는 경우 각 단위SOP 간의 선후관계에 기초하여 다음에 수행될 단위SOP를 결정하는 제어모듈을 포함하되, 상기 디스플레이모듈은, 상기 제어모듈에 의해 각 단위 SOP에 설정된 작업이 수행되면, 수행된 상기 단위SOP에 상응하는 오브젝트의 모양을 제1 변형모양으로 변경하거나 수행된 상기 단위SOP에 상응하는 컴포넌트 오브젝트에 소정의 제1시각적 효과를 부가하는 SOP 시나리오 구동 시스템이 제공된다.

title_en: SOP scenario executing system and providing method thereof

abstract_en: Disclosed are an standard operating procedure (SOP) scenario executing system, which is capable of easily understanding procedures in case of disaster by visualizing an SOP scenario in the form of a flowchart or the like, and a providing method thereof. According to an embodiment of the present invention, an SOP scenario executing system includes: an SOP DB configured to store a first SOP scenario which defines a standard procedure in case of a predetermined first event; a display module configured to display an object corresponding to each of a plurality of unit SOPs included in the first SOP scenario, and the order of the unit SOPs; and a control module configured to perform tasks set to a unit SOP to be performed among the unit SOPs, and to determine a unit SOP to be performed next, based on the order of the unit SOPs, when the unit SOP is completed, wherein when tasks set to each of the unit SOPs are performed by the control module, the display module changes the shape of an object corresponding to the performed unit SOP into a first variant shape, or adds a predetermined first visual effect to a component object corresponding to the performed unit SOP.

title_en: The high-rise working method and hanging basket of preset drawstring
abstract_en: A kind of the high-rise working method and hanging basket of preset drawstring, preset drawstring forms standing hanging point to lifting device on suspension mechanism, high-rise working can be unfolded at any time using drawstring suspension lifting equipment, breaching aerial work basket cannot function as the technical bottleneck of standing suspension equipment, meet many high-rise working demands for needing to go up and down at random.For the emergency Lifting basket of fire in high buildings, load cable wire is equipped in the preset drawstring of roof and fire department, is had the characteristics that convenient for safeguarding, quick, cheap and reliable；For the maintenance Lifting basket of electric power tower, has the characteristics that save physical strength, lifting construction speed, improves operation safety；The present invention is but also widely used for the upkeep operation of wind-power electricity generation, communication iron tower, chimney maintenance and meteorological, environmentally friendly equal-height position field of operation.

title_en: High-place operation method of presetting pulling rope and hanging baskets
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-place operation method of a presetting pulling rope and hanging baskets. The pulling rope preset on a suspension mechanism forms a permanent hanging point for lifting equipment, so that the lifting equipment hung by the pulling rope can be used for carrying out a high-place operation at any time. Thus, the technical bottleneck that the hanging basket during the high-place operation cannot serve as permanent suspension equipment is broken through; the requirement of multiple high-place operations requiring random lifting is satisfied. With regard to the emergency-lifting hanging basket for a fire hazard at a tall building, the pulling rope is preset at the top of the building and a loading steel cable is adopted by a fire department, and the method has the characteristics of being convenient to maintain, rapid, economical and reliable. With regard to the maintenance lifting hanging basket for a power iron tower, the method has the characteristics that the physical power is saved, the construction speed is increased and the operational safety is improved. The method can also be widely applied to the high-place operation fields of the overhauling operations of wind power generation and communication iron towers, the maintenance of chimneys, meteorology, environmental friendliness and the like.

title_en: Integrated response system for nuclear accident
title_ko: 원전사고 통합 대응 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system capable of an integrated response to a nuclear accident, the system generating an accident scenario and establishing emergency response procedures with the nuclear accident type and environment as variables, and providing emergency response strategies capable of supporting decisions in line with the accident scenario. Moreover, the present invention calculates a radiation exposure threshold value for onsite disaster-prevention personnel and establishes the amount of work to be done by same by assessing not only the off-site danger level but also the on-site danger level, thereby allowing the safety of the on-site disaster-prevention personnel to be supported.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 원전사고에 통합적으로 대응할 수 있는 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 원전사고의 종류 및 환경을 변수로 사고 시나리오를 생성하고 비상대응절차를 수립하며, 사고 시나리오에 따른 의사결정을 지원할 수 있는 비상대응방안을 제공한다. 또한, 소외 위험도 평가뿐만 아니라 소내 위험도 평가를 통해 소내 방재요원의 피폭한계치를 산정하고 작업량을 설정함으로써 소내 방재요원의 안전을 지원할 수 있도록 한다.

title_en: Nuclear power plant accident integrated action system
title_ko: 원전사고 통합 대응 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system which can generally cope with nuclear accidents. An accident scenario is generated by using a variable as the kind and environment of nuclear accidents. An emergency response procedure is established. An emergency response plan for supporting decision making according to the accident scenario is provided. Also, the exposure limitation of the on-site disaster prevention agent is estimated by not only on-site risk assessment but also off-site risk assessment. And then, a workload is set. So, the safety of the on-site disaster prevention agent can be supported.

title_en: Building Integrated Management System and Method Based on Digital SOP and Prediction
title_ko: 디지털sop 및 예측기반 빌딩통합운영시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated operation system for a building based on a digital SOP and estimation and method for the same. Specifically, the integrated operation system for a building based on the digital SOP and estimation comprises: an IoT device unit (100) measuring environment information (110-1) including inner temperature of a building (10) and facility information (110-2) and including multiple IoT sensors (110) operating based on IoT and multiple IoT operators (120); and an artificial intelligence type central processing unit (200) comprising an IoT information collection unit (210), a digital SOP managing unit (220), a situation corresponding unit (230), and an IoT device control unit (240) operating the IoT sensor (110) and the IoT operator (120). According to an embodiment of the present invention, the integrated operation system for a building based on the digital SOP and the estimation and method for the same can maintain efficiency, immediacy, and accuracy of correspondence in an abnormal situation.

title_en: Online state data processing method, device and system of online system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device and a system for processing online state data of an online system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the data diffusion layer receives an online state change message of the client; the data diffusion layer distributes the online state change message to the data distribution layer of each partition according to a preset redundancy strategy; the data distribution layer forwards the online state change message to a data storage layer group of a data storage layer of a corresponding partition of the data distribution layer according to a preset distribution strategy, wherein the data storage layer comprises more than two data storage layer groups; the data store layer packet stores presence change messages. The method can conveniently realize parallel expansion, solve the bottleneck problems of the QPS and the system storage capacity, realize disaster recovery backup by the full redundant storage of data among all the partitions, and improve the system reliability.

title_en: The presence data processing method of on-line system, apparatus and system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of presence data processing method of on-line system, apparatus and system, and methods described comprises the following steps：Data diffusion layer receives the presence change message of client；The presence change message is distributed to the data distribution layer of each subregion by data diffusion layer by preset redundancy strategy；The data storage layer that the presence change message is forwarded to the data storage layer that the data distribution layer corresponds to subregion according to preset distribution policy by data distribution layer is grouped, and the data storage layer is grouped comprising two or more data storage layer；Data storage layer packet storage presence change message.This method can very easily realize parallel expansion, solve the bottleneck problem of query rate QPS and system memory size, and data full dose redundant storage between each subregion, realize disaster-tolerant backup, improve system reliability.

title_en: Disaster response processing method and apparatus for vehicle insurance, computer device, and storage medium
abstract_en: The present application relates to a disaster response processing method and apparatus for vehicle insurance, a computer device, and a computer readable storage medium. The disaster response processing method for vehicle insurance comprises: receiving a disaster warning message and vehicle insurance claim reporting information; screening out a city identifier from the vehicle insurance claim reporting information according to a disaster city identifier specified by the disaster warning message, the city identifier matching the disaster city identifier; analyzing the vehicle insurance claim reporting information that is screened out and a corresponding receiving frequency; if the receiving frequency of the vehicle insurance claim reporting information exceeds a warning threshold, configuring disaster response acceptance configuration information according to the disaster warning message; and according to a simplified process corresponding to the disaster response acceptance configuration information, processing the vehicle insurance claim reporting information matching the disaster response acceptance configuration information.
assignees: PING AN TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Disaster response processing method and device for vehicle insurance, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disaster response processing method and device for vehicle insurance, computer equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The disaster response processing method for the vehicle insurance comprises the following steps: receiving a disaster warning message and vehicle insurance case information; screening out city identification from the vehicle insurance case information according to the disaster city identification specified by the disaster alert message, wherein the city identification is matched with the disaster city identification; analyzing the screened vehicle insurance reporting information and the corresponding receiving frequency; when the receiving frequency of the vehicle insurance reporting information exceeds an alert threshold, configuring disaster acceptance configuration information according to the disaster alert message; and processing the vehicle insurance reporting information matched with the disaster handling configuration information according to the simplified flow corresponding to the disaster handling configuration information. When the vehicle insurance cases suddenly increase, the vehicle insurance case information can be quickly processed according to the disaster-handling acceptance configuration information, so that the vehicle insurance case information can be processed in time, and the efficiency of vehicle insurance case information processing when a disaster occurs is improved.

title_en: Data-driven crowd congestion risk analysis method for evacuation bottleneck
abstract_en: The invention relates to a non-parameter estimation method for evaluating real-time dynamic congestion risks at bottlenecks during large-scale crowd evacuation under emergency conditions based on data driving. Comprising 1) data preprocessing; 2) calculating the optimal window width; 3) estimating the jam probability; 4) and predicting the crowd evacuation risk at the bottleneck based on the congestion probability estimation. The method for predicting the crowd evacuation risk at the bottleneck based on the congestion probability estimation is completely data-driven and does not depend on any prior data hypothesis. Based on this approach, the dynamic variation of the congestion risk at the evacuation bottleneck over time can be depicted. Furthermore, for urban areas such as subway stations or other urban areas with a large amount of crowds, the method provided by the invention can be applied to depict the dynamic congestion risks at evacuation bottlenecks at different positions, so that a dynamic hotspot map of the crowd congestion risks in a large-scale scene is constructed, and important technical support is provided for crowd evacuation management and control, especially crowd evacuation management and control under emergency conditions.

title_en: InSAR two-dimensional surface deformation monitoring method based on adjacent rail data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an InSAR two-dimensional surface deformation monitoring method based on adjacent rail data. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining surface deformation measured values of the surface in two different slope directions by utilizing SAR data of adjacent tracks, then obtaining two different slope direction deformation measured values of a common area of the adjacent tracks, further calculating the incident angle and the azimuth angle of each point on the common area in the first track and the second track respectively, then constructing a coefficient matrix of each point, finally neglecting the north-south deformation according to the strict geometric relation between the imaging geometry of a satellite and the surface deformation, establishing an equation set, and solving the surface two-dimensional deformation according to a least square criterion. The method breaks through the technical bottleneck of InSAR two-dimensional deformation monitoring in a lifting rail-free data area, actively pushes the InSAR technology to be developed to the practicability, and has important scientific value for researching the geophysical process and inverting the geological disaster parameters.

title_en: A kind of InSAR two dimension earth's surface deformation monitoring method based on adjacent rail data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of InSAR two dimension earth's surface deformation monitoring method based on adjacent rail data.The earth's surface Ground Deformation measured value upward in two different oblique distances is obtained first with the SAR data of adjacent orbit, then two of adjacent orbit public domain different oblique distances are obtained to distortion measurement value, and then every bit is calculated on public domain respectively in the incidence angle and azimuth of a rail and two rails, then construct the coefficient matrix of every bit, finally according to the tight geometrical relationship between the imaging geometry of satellite and Ground Deformation, ignore north-south deformation, equation group is established, earth's surface two-dimensional deformation is solved to obtain according to criterion of least squares.The present invention breaches the technical bottleneck of the InSAR two-dimensional deformation monitoring of no lift rail data area, actively promotes InSAR technology and develops to functionization, has important scientific value to research Geophysical Process and inverting geological disaster parameter.

title_en: Dangerous chemical leakage emergency response disposal card and use method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dangerous chemical leakage emergency response processing card and a use method and application thereof, and mainly solves the problems of poor portability, inconvenient query and poor safety in the prior art. The invention adopts a dangerous chemical leakage emergency response processing card which comprises a parameter back plate and a sliding panel, wherein the sliding panel comprises leakage amount, leakage time, danger classification description, an initial isolation distance and a downwind evacuation distance schematic diagram; the parameter backboard comprises the technical scheme of chemical names, pinyin retrieval, numerical values of initial isolation distance and downwind evacuation distance, health hazards, combustion characteristics, reactivity and a using method thereof, well solves the problems, and can be used for emergency response of dangerous chemical leakage.

title_en: A kind of garden safety monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of garden safety monitoring system and method, which includes: the first data acquisition module, for obtaining the three-dimensional data of garden；Second data acquisition module, for obtaining the monitoring data of monitored object, monitoring data includes real time video data；Intelligent processing module, for carrying out Intelligent treatment to three-dimensional data and monitoring data, Intelligent treatment includes generating the threedimensional model of garden according to three-dimensional data and carrying out safe condition analysis and dispatching distribution according to monitoring data；Display module is supervised, for showing the monitoring data of monitored object in real time in the threedimensional model of garden；Emergency response module, for carrying out emergency response processing according to the result of dispatching distribution.Garden safety monitoring system in technical solution of the present invention can provide in all directions the real-time pictures of any one monitored object in conjunction with garden panorama profile, so that the safety monitoring system of entire garden is relatively reliable.

title_en: Park area safety supervisory system and method
abstract_en: A park area safety supervisory system and method. The system comprises: a first data acquisition module (100) used for acquiring three-dimensional data of a park area; a second data acquisition module (120) used for acquiring monitoring data of a monitored object, wherein the monitoring data includes real-time video data; an intelligent processing module (140) used for performing an intelligent processing on the three-dimensional data and the monitoring data, wherein the intelligent processing includes generating a three-dimensional model of the park area according to the three-dimensional data and performing safety status analysis and dispatching distribution according to the monitoring data; a supervision exhibition module (160) used to exhibit the monitoring data of the monitored object in real time in the three-dimensional model of the park area; and an emergency response module (180) used to perform emergency response processing according to the dispatching distribution result. The system can provide real-time images of the monitored object in all directions in combination with the panoramic outline of the park area, thereby making the safety supervision of the entire park area more reliable.

title_en: High-pressure spray head capable of independently flying and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-pressure spray head capable of flying independently and application thereof, wherein the high-pressure spray head consists of a cylindrical main body, and an upper cone and a lower cone which are respectively connected to the upper part and the lower part of the main body; the upper cone is a window breaking head cone, the inside of the upper cone is hollow, and a motor and a gyroscope sensor are arranged; a water flow channel is formed in the main body, direction control water outlets are uniformly distributed on the side surface of the main body, and the direction control water outlets are communicated with the water flow channel; the tail end of the lower cone is provided with a water inlet which is connected with a fire-fighting water pipe, the side surface of the lower cone is uniformly distributed with water outlets, and the water outlets are communicated with a water flow channel in the main body. According to the invention, the water outlet and the direction control water outlet are arranged on the high-pressure spray head, so that the high-pressure spray head is towed to fly upwards without mechanical lifting. The fire-fighting water pipe is arranged on the fire-fighting water pipe and applied to fire-fighting rescue, so that the high bottleneck of fire-fighting rescue can be broken through, and the personal safety of firefighters is ensured.

title_en: High-pressure sprayer capable of flying autonomously

The utility model discloses a set up delivery port and directional control delivery port on high pressure nozzle, drag and carry high pressure nozzle and fly upwards, need not mechanical frame height. The fire-fighting protection device is arranged on a fire-fighting water pipe and applied to fire rescue, the height bottleneck of the fire rescue can be broken through, and the personal safety of fire fighters is guaranteed.

title_en: Distributed equipment IP address distribution management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed equipment IP address distribution management method and a distributed equipment IP address distribution management system, wherein an SDN controller is butted with an SDN switch in a single network to manage the IP addresses of node equipment in the network, so that multipoint distribution of DHCP service is realized, configuration is not needed, the resource consumption is low, the problem of single-point bottleneck is solved, even if single-service abnormity occurs, the single-node network is only influenced, the whole network is not influenced, the fault disaster tolerance is stronger, simultaneously, the SDN controller verifies the content of a first packet before carrying out the DHCP service, the problem of IP distribution confusion caused by illegal internal network DHCP service is effectively prevented, meanwhile, malicious attack of external DHCP is effectively restrained, and the network safety is improved.

title_en: Power distribution network elastic lifting method based on multi-energy coordination in extreme weather
abstract_en: The utility model provides a distribution network elastic lifting method based on multi-energy coordination in extreme weather, which combines the disaster-causing mechanism of extreme weather to the distribution network to simulate the disturbance process; analyzing the vulnerability of the power distribution network element under extreme weather disturbance, and establishing an element fault rate model; generating a probabilistic fault scene of the power distribution network based on a time-varying fault rate curve, and acquiring successive fault positions and fault moments of the power distribution network in a disturbance process; the response process of the comprehensive energy system after the power distribution network fails is simulated, the optimal load reduction strategy of the power distribution network is adopted in the simulation process, the principle that the power distribution network preferentially ensures important load power supply is taken as a target, the power distribution network is supported through multi-energy coordination, and the optimal coordination scheme is determined, so that the elasticity of the power distribution network is improved.

title_en: Novel central authorities' anticollision barrier device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel central authorities 'anticollision barrier device, the device include at least one anticollision unit, but each anticollision unit all includes the central authorities' anticollision stand that can rise automatically, anticollision panel, is located concrete foundation and lift actuating mechanism under the stratum. The anti-collision panel is detachably arranged on two side faces of the central anti-collision upright post. The lifting driving mechanism is embedded in an open slot at the central position in the concrete foundation. The device is arranged in the central separation belt of an urban expressway or an expressway. The central anti-collision upright post of the device can automatically lift, and the automation degree is high; the anti-collision panel is detachable and can be overhauled; when an emergency accident happens, the vehicle can be integrally and quickly disassembled and hidden, and the traffic demand of a turning lane is met. abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel central anti-collision fence device which is arranged on a central separation belt of an urban expressway or an expressway. title_en: Karst soil cave search positioning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disasters caused by soil cave collapse in karst regions, in particular to a method for searching and positioning a karst soil cave, which comprises the following steps of firstly selecting a working area needing to be subjected to collapse search; then, a spraying route is defined for the selected area, and foaming agent is uniformly sprayed until the content of the foaming agent in the soil body of the earth surface covering layer reaches the designed concentration; observing whether bubbles are continuously generated on the earth surface after rain, marking bubble generation point positions, namely possible development positions of karst soil holes, and finally detecting the bubble generation point positions and adjacent areas in detail by adopting a conventional drilling or geophysical prospecting method to determine detailed characteristics of the soil holes; by adopting the karst soil cave searching and positioning method provided by the technical scheme of the invention, the specific development position of the underground karst soil cave can be detected accurately in a large area and with low cost and easy operation, the karst soil cave detection target area can be obviously reduced, and the bottleneck problem of 'where the soil cave is' in the process of karst collapse monitoring and prevention and control at present is effectively solved.

title_en: System and method for security analyst modeling and management
abstract_en: Systems and methods for managing incoming cybersecurity events. Incoming security events are first classified based on stored event profiles from previous events. Multiple analysts with relevant experience and background are determined based on the analysts' stored profiles. The incoming event is assigned and dispatched as necessary to one of these analysts. Analyst stress levels and mood is assessed, and the assessments are stored in the analyst profiles. Analyst resolution steps and performance against those steps in resolving the events are also stored in the relevant analyst profiles and in an event record database. QA reviews of resolved events are conducted when norm deviant circumstances arise. AI and process mining techniques are used in classifying the incoming events, assigning the incoming events to the relevant analyst, and determining lessons to be learned from previous events. The analyst profiles models specific analyst behaviour and are used for assigning incoming events.

title_en: Forest fire monitoring and early warning method based on sky-ground integration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of forest fire early warning, in particular to a forest fire monitoring and early warning method based on sky-ground integration. The method comprises the following steps of S1, preprocessing high-spatial-temporal-resolution multisource satellite remote sensing data; s2, performing integrated collaborative monitoring and multi-source data fusion processing on the sky and the ground; s3, intelligently identifying and monitoring the sky-ground integrated high-precision forest fire; and S4, modeling and early warning of the weather grade of the forest fire danger. abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-type user oriented nuclear accident multi-element information visualization method and electronic equipment, comprising the following steps: determining a user type; acquiring nuclear accident multielement information; acquiring a nuclear accident multi-element information set based on the user type and the nuclear accident multi-element information; performing information analysis and drawing on the nuclear accident multi-element information set to obtain a visual graph; and displaying the visual graph. title_en: Emergency resource optimal allocation method for emergency events based on event log mining
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency resource optimal configuration method based on event log mining, which comprises the following steps: 1) Acquiring an event log of an emergency handling process of an emergency event; 2) Excavating the emergency disposal flow by using the obtained event log of the emergency disposal flow, and excavating an emergency resource disposal flow model of the emergency disposal flow; 3) Processing emergency resources contained in the model by utilizing the excavated emergency resource disposal flow model; 4) Detecting the existing resource dependency relationship by using the result obtained by the processing in the step 3), and carrying out emergency resource demand analysis; 5) And performing optimized configuration on emergency resources through two emergency resource allocation strategies, namely a minimum time allocation strategy and a minimum resource allocation strategy. The method breaks through the problem that the existing process mining technology cannot be directly applied to the analysis of the emergency handling process event logs of the emergency, and is favorable for the success of emergency tasks with high time performance and high emergency resource utilization rate.

Therefore, the risk capability of the structure for resisting disasters is improved, the long-term cooperative work of the steel bar and the concrete is ensured, and the low-energy consumption and green development in the field of civil engineering is promoted.

title_en: Urban multipoint circulating emergency evacuation and simulation deduction method based on variable cells
abstract_en: The invention provides a variable cell-based urban multipoint circulating emergency evacuation and simulation deduction method, which comprises the following steps: s1, initializing a traffic evacuation road network, designating a plurality of parking points, evacuation points and safety points, and acquiring traffic states; s2, mapping the actual road network and the evacuation scene to a virtual road network based on a variable cell transmission model; s3, establishing a path selection model of vehicle many-to-many cycle reciprocating evacuation, and modeling to solve parameters; s4, performing real-time simulation rehearsal evaluation on the evacuation path solved under the determined scene in the virtual road network; s5, diagnosing whether an evacuation bottleneck exists according to the simulation result, and outputting an evacuation path and an evaluation index if the evacuation bottleneck does not exist; if so, repeating the steps S2-S4 until the evacuation bottleneck is eliminated or the evacuation target is reached. The invention has strong comprehensiveness, wide applicability and high reliability, and integrates key technologies of vehicle path selection, evacuation control measures, traffic simulation evaluation and the like; the method can adapt to evacuation road networks in different scenes; the reliability of the simulation evaluation is determined through example verification.

title_en: Urban multipoint circulating emergency evacuation and simulation deduction method based on variable cells
abstract_en: The invention provides a variable cell-based urban multipoint circulating emergency evacuation and simulation deduction method, which comprises the following steps: s1, initializing a traffic evacuation road network, designating a plurality of parking points, evacuation points and safety points, and acquiring a traffic state; s2, mapping the actual road network and the evacuation scene to a virtual road network based on a variable cell transmission model; s3, establishing a path selection model of vehicle many-to-many cycle reciprocating evacuation, and modeling to solve parameters; s4, performing real-time simulation rehearsal evaluation on the evacuation path solved under the determined scene in the virtual road network; s5, diagnosing whether an evacuation bottleneck exists or not according to a simulation result, and outputting an evacuation path and an evaluation index if the evacuation bottleneck does not exist; if so, repeating the steps S2-S4 until the evacuation bottleneck is eliminated or the evacuation target is reached. title_en: Disaster response processing method, device, equipment and storage medium for distributed data system
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of artificial intelligence and system disaster response processing, and provides a disaster response processing method, device, equipment and storage medium of a distributed data system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the current resource utilization rate of the distributed data system, and judging whether the current resource utilization rate of the distributed data system reaches a disaster-response starting threshold value or not; if the resource utilization rate reaches the disaster-response starting threshold value, a preset disaster-response model is adopted to solve the calculation resource usage amount which needs to be added when the system is in disaster-response; and performing resource scheduling processing on the distributed data system according to the consumption of the computing resources which need to be added, so that the resource utilization rate of the distributed data system is reduced to a reference value representing the safe operation of the system. Based on the method, when a sudden data disaster event occurs in the distributed data system, the annealing algorithm can be used for carrying out 'cast-out' on the data disaster, so that the resource utilization rate of the cluster in the distributed data system is reduced to a safe value, and the normal operation of the system is ensured.

title_en: Disaster response processing method, device, equipment and storage medium of distributed data system
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of artificial intelligence and system disaster response processing, and provides a disaster response processing method, device, equipment and storage medium of a distributed data system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the current resource utilization rate of the distributed data system, and judging whether the current resource utilization rate of the distributed data system reaches a disaster response starting threshold; if the resource utilization rate reaches the disaster response starting threshold, solving the consumption of the computing resource which needs to be added in the disaster response of the system by adopting a preset disaster response model; and carrying out resource scheduling processing on the distributed data system according to the consumption of the computing resources which are required to be added, so that the resource utilization rate of the distributed data system is reduced to a reference value representing the safe operation of the system. Based on the method, when the distributed data system has a sudden data disaster event, the annealing algorithm can be utilized to perform data disaster 'pouring-out', so that the resource utilization rate of clusters in the distributed data system is reduced to a safe value, and the normal operation of the system is ensured.

title_en: Intelligent disaster response system between sensors and servers based on disaster response procedures
title_ko: 재난대응절차 기반 센서-서버 간 지능형 재난대응시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sensor-server intelligent disaster response system capable of automatically sorting symptoms related with a diameter from a large amount of sensing information provided in real time to report accurate information to a user, thereby enabling the user to quickly become ready for ethe diameter. The sensor-server intelligent disaster response system comprises: various types of disaster sensors; CCTVs installed along with the sensors in a site; a disaster information communication server receiving data sensed by the sensors and the CCTVs through a communication network; an external disaster data system connected to provide information of a densely populated area, disaster damage and history information to the disaster information communication server; and a disaster information visualization dashboard displaying the disaster information through visualization information outputted from the disaster information communication server. The sensor-server intelligent disaster response system receives the sensing information from the various sensors in real time, and, when detecting a symptom related with a disaster, provides a corresponding location and an abnormal sensor value to a user, while automatically visualizing a screen of an adjacent CCVT of the location in which the symptom is detected, to cause the user to doublecheck whether the disaster occurs, calculates a phenomenon value of a sensor and the degree of risk of a neighboring area to diagnose a current disaster occurrence level, and maps the sensing information, the sensor information, the degree of risk and disaster responses with a map, schematizes the information into numerical values, or indicates the information in a graph, thereby enabling the user to quickly and accurately become ready for the disaster situation or respond thereto.
abstract_ko:

title_en: Communication network-based hazardous chemical accident detection and response system
title_ko: 통신망 기반 유해화학사고 감지 및 대응 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for detecting and responding to hazardous chemical accidents based on a communication network. Through a disaster safety communication network, the concentration of hazardous substances is displayed in real time, and the concentration is displayed in color on a map according to the location of a sensor so that a user can recognize the level of risk at a glance. The system includes: sensor information collected from disaster detection sensors; a disaster management server that executes a disaster management program when the sensor information is input, detects symptoms of a disaster, and sequentially executes an initial response and an emergency response; and a monitor that is connected to the disaster management server so that signs of disaster, initial response, and emergency response are displayed on the screen. The disaster management server provides real-time numerical values of sensor information collected from various sensors by a built-in disaster management program, diagrams, converts the same into graphs, or displays the same along with a map of the corresponding area. In addition to the variety of sensor information, one or more of CCTV information, base station information, populated area information, and weather information are added to the input information for the disaster management server. Various sensor information, CCTV information, base station information, populated area information, and weather information input to the disaster management server are displayed on the monitor as the disaster management program is executed. In the disaster response process, a symptom detection step, an initial response step, and an emergency response step are configured to be executed sequentially.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난안전통신망을 통해 유해물질 농도를 실시간으로 표출하고, 센서 위치에 따라 지도위에 농도를 색상으로 표출하여 사용자가 위험도를 한눈에 알아볼 수 있도록 한 통신망 기반 유해화학사고 감지 및 대응 시스템에 관한 것으로, 재난 감지용 센서들로부터 수집된 센서정보들과; 상기 센서정보들이 입력되면 재난관리프로그램이 실행되어 재난의 징후를 감지하고, 초기대응 및 비상대응이 순차적으로 실행되도록 하는 재난관리 서버와; 상기 재난관리 서버와 연결되어 재난의 징후, 초기대응 및 비상대응의 과정이 화면에 디스플레이되도록 하는 모니터로 구성된 통신망 기반 유해화학사고 감지 및 대응 시스템에 있어서, 상기 재난관리서버는 내장된 재난관리프로그램에 의해, 각종 센서들로부터 수집된 센서정보들을 실시간 수치로 제공하거나, 도표로 도식화하거나, 그래프로 변환하여 나타내거나, 해당 지역의 지도와 함께 표시하며, 상기 재난관리서버에 대한 입력 정보들은, 상기 '각종 센서정보' 외에도, 'CCTV 정보'와, '기지국 정보'와, '인구 밀집지역 정보'와, '기상정보' 들 중에서 한개 이상이 추가되며, 상기 재난관리서버에 입력된 '각종 센서정보', 'CCTV 정보', '기지국 정보', '인구 밀집지역 정보', '기상정보' 들은 재난관리 프로그램이 실행됨에 따라 상기  모니터에 디스플레이되는데, 재난 대응과정에서 징후감지 단계와, 초기대응 단계와, 비상대응 단계가 순차적으로 실행되도록 구성된 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: ENSO diversity prediction method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ENSO diversity forecasting method based on artificial intelligence, which extracts the first three main modes from equatorial Pacific SSTA observation data by using an EOF decomposition method, and projects CMIP6 historical simulation data on the three main modes to obtain three groups of PC values; three groups of PC values are used as forecast values, SSTA of an initial month and Tendency items of sea temperature data are used as input values of training, and a CMIP6 mode is used for training VGG-11; and inputting observation data into the trained model to obtain PC values at three future moments, and combining the PC values with 3 EOF main modes to reconstruct the SSTA space form of the equatorial Pacific region at the future moments. The method improves the forecasting skill of the middle Pacific type Erleno and breaks through the bottleneck of forecasting in the middle Pacific area in the previous dynamic mode. The method improves the forecasting skill of ENSO, is beneficial to forecasting and early warning of climate disasters, and is beneficial to reducing personnel and property loss.

title_en: High-performance interactive processing method for collecting disaster-resistant emergency Web application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-performance interactive processing method for collecting disaster-resistant emergency Web applications, and relates to the field of power grid operation and maintenance; the invention comprises the following steps: acquiring power failure event reporting information; studying and judging in the power failure stage; studying and judging in the power recovery stage; outputting power failure research and judgment real-time data; acquiring power failure research and judgment real-time data, and realizing real-time input/output of the power failure data by using a high-throughput distributed stream processing technology Kafka; acquiring Kafka real-time power failure shared data, and caching power failure data within 2 hours in an application server memory in real time; acquiring data of a data collection center, and solidifying power failure data before the current 2 hours to an application server in a file form. title_en: Ship accident response system with buoyancy assistance apparatus
title_ko: 능동개방이 가능한 팽창식 부력보조시스템
abstract_ko: 선박의 침수사고 발생시, 침수해석 데이터베이스 데이터와 전자식 경사계의 검출 데이터를 연동하여 침수의 확산 위험도를 판단하고, 침수확산 범위가 위험 범위를 초과할 경우 자동으로 선박의 부력보조시스템을 동작시켜 침수 사고에 적절히 대응할 수 있도록 한 능동개방이 가능한 팽창식 부력보조시스템에 관한 것으로서, 선박의 롤(Roll) 동요량 및 횡경사(Heel) 경사각을 제공하는 전자식 경사계, 침수 사고 발생시 미리 설정된 사고대응 시나리오에 따라 침수대응절차를 진행하며, 전자식 경사계의 제공 데이터와 침수해석 데이터베이스의 침수 해석 정보를 기초로 확산 위험도를 판단하고, 확산 위험도가 위험범위를 초과하면 부력 보조를 통해 전복(Capsizing) 지연을 유도하기 위해 자동으로 부력 보조 장치를 동작시키는 사고대응시스템, 선내에 설치된 부력 보조체를 활성화시켜 보조 부력을 생성하고, 생성한 보조 부력으로 선박 복원성을 보조하여 선박 전복을 지연시키는 부력보조장치를 포함하여, 능동개방이 가능한 팽창식 부력보조시스템을 구현한다.

title_en: Ship accident response system with buoyancy assistance apparatus
title_ko: 능동개방이 가능한 팽창식 부력보조시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an inflatable buoyancy assistance system capable of active opening so as to appropriately respond to a flooding accident. The inflatable buoyancy assistance system capable of active opening includes: an electronic inclinometer which provides a roll amount and a heel angle of a ship; an accident response system which, when a flooding accident of the ship occurs, carries out a flooding response procedure according to a preset accident response scenario, determines the level of spread risk based on the data provided by the electronic inclinometer and flooding analysis information of a flooding analysis database, and automatically operates buoyancy assistance equipment to induce a delay in capsizing through buoyancy assistance if the level of spread risk exceeds a preset risk range; and a buoyancy assistance device which activates a buoyancy assistance body installed in the ship under the control of the accident response system to generate assistance buoyancy, and assists the stability of the ship with the generated assistance buoyancy to delay capsizing. According to the present invention, the inflatable buoyancy assistance system responds to a flooding accident of a ship, while, if the risk of flooding spreading in the event of a flooding accident exceeds a set risk range, actively operating a buoyancy assistance device, thereby delaying capsizing and maximally maintaining survivability when the ship loses stability after the flooding accident.
abstract_ko: 선박의 침수사고 발생시, 침수해석 데이터베이스 데이터와 전자식 경사계의 검출 데이터를 연동하여 침수의 확산 위험도를 판단하고, 침수확산 범위가 위험 범위를 초과할 경우 자동으로 선박의 부력보조시스템을 동작시켜 침수 사고에 적절히 대응할 수 있도록 한 능동개방이 가능한 팽창식 부력보조시스템에 관한 것으로서, 선박의 롤(Roll) 동요량 및 횡경사(Heel) 경사각을 제공하는 전자식 경사계, 침수 사고 발생시 미리 설정된 사고대응 시나리오에 따라 침수대응절차를 진행하며, 전자식 경사계의 제공 데이터와 침수해석 데이터베이스의 침수 해석 정보를 기초로 확산 위험도를 판단하고, 확산 위험도가 위험범위를 초과하면 부력 보조를 통해 전복(Capsizing) 지연을 유도하기 위해 자동으로 부력 보조 장치를 동작시키는 사고대응시스템, 선내에 설치된 부력 보조체를 활성화시켜 보조 부력을 생성하고, 생성한 보조 부력으로 선박 복원성을 보조하여 선박 전복을 지연시키는 부력보조장치를 포함하여, 능동개방이 가능한 팽창식 부력보조시스템을 구현한다.

title_en: Evaluation method and system for spatial scene layout design
abstract_en: The invention provides an evaluation method and system for spatial scene layout design. The method comprises the following steps: simulating the emergency evacuation process of the crowd in the space scene based on the group perception evacuation model to obtain a group evacuation process simulation result; the group perception evacuation model is obtained by constructing a preset object space index method and a group random model based on a preset perception evacuation model and a preset group evacuation model; and evaluating the layout design in the space scene based on the simulation result of the group evacuation process, and determining an evacuation bottleneck region in the space scene. The evaluation method for the layout design of the space scene, provided by the invention, can consider the influence of the group on the emergency evacuation process, and effectively improve the evaluation efficiency and accuracy of the layout setting and the emergency plan design in the space scene, so that the evacuation bottleneck area is quickly determined.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES;ZHEJIANG CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCE SPACE INFORMATION TECH APPLICATION CENTER

title_en: Rail transit multi-professional operation and maintenance data processing method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a rail transit multi-professional operation and maintenance data processing method and a system, which comprises the steps of communicating with existing application systems of rail transit, transmitting acquired data and performing data processing; standardizing and storing the acquired data, further carrying out multi-dimensional data analysis, generating fault alarm data or overrun alarm data, and generating health degree evaluation and early warning data; carrying out operation and maintenance closed-loop operation and associated emergency management on the alarm data and the early warning data; the method comprises the steps of visually displaying standardized data and alarm early warning data, carrying out workflow analysis on operation and maintenance closed-loop operation and emergency management processes, carrying out differential maintenance and intelligent maintenance according to multidimensional data analysis results, solving the problems of insufficient data accuracy, instantaneity and integrity caused by existing artificial operation and maintenance and various professional information islands, and solving the problems of long fault problem processing time limit, low efficiency, easy influence on operation safety and the like.

title_ko: 아이피 카메라 융합 스마트 불꽃감지기를 이용한 화재감지 및 대피시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 감지된 화재의 모니터링 기능을 제공할 뿐만 아니라 화재의 진화를 자체적으로 수행가능하게 안내하여 주고, 화재발생 시 기본적으로 화재진화와 더불어 부가적으로 소방서측에 이를 전파하여 조속한 화재진압을 가능하게 안내하여 주며, 건물에 화재발생 시 건물을 관리하는 건물관리자에게 화재가 발생된 건물의 건물내부영역을 안내하고, 발생된 화재에 대응하여 건물입주자의 대피나 화재진압을 위한 대응절차를 안내하여 주고, 건물에서 화재 발생에 따라 야기되는 고온의 열기나 유독가스가 화재가 발생된 건물내부영역의 주변 영역으로 이동 시 이를 감지하기 위한 온도감지센서 및 가스감지센서를 드론에 탑재하여 제공함으로써, 건물의 각 층별 건물내부영역에 일정간격마다  온도감지센서 및 가스감지센서를 설치할 필요가 없어 설치비용이 절감될 뿐만 아니라 정밀한 측정이 가능하여 건물입주자의 대피 시 야기되는 열기나 유독가스에 대한 피해를 극소화시켜주는 아이피 카메라 융합 스마트 불꽃감지기를 이용한 화재감지 및 대피시스템에 관한 것으로, 건물을 이루는 각 층의 건물내부영역(A) 마다 기지정된 위치에 설치되는 것으로, 설치된 건물내부영역(A)에서 화재시 발생하는 불꽃을 감지하여 불꽃감지정보를 생성하는 불꽃감지센서(110), 설치된 건물내부영역(A)을 촬영하여 정지영상이나 동영상을 포함하는 건물내부영역별 영상정보를 생성하는 IP 카메라(120) 및 스프링쿨러(130)를 포함하고, 생성되는 불꽃감지정보 및 건물내부영역별 영상정보와 더불어 상기 불꽃감지센서(110)가 건물내부영역(A)에 설치된 위치좌표인 센서설치좌표정보를 포함하는 화재감지신호를 전송하는 방재부(100)와; 상기 방재부(100)로부터 전송되는 화재감지신호를 건물측 정보저장부(210)에 저장관리함과 아울러 상기 화재감지신호에 해당 건물을 식별하는 건물식별자를 취합하여 중계전송하고, 상기 화재감지신호에 포함된 건물내부영역별 영상정보를 건물측 정보출력부(220)를 통해 출력하며, 상기 방재부(100)의 스프링쿨러(130)를 개방제어하여 방화수가 토출되도록 제어하는 건물측 제어부(230)를 포함하는 건물측 관리단말(200)과; 상기 방재부(100)로부터 화재감지신호가 전송되면, 경보처리부(310)를 통해 경보신호를 출력하는 화재수신기(300)와; 화재사고를 수습하는 소방서측에서 운영하는 소방서측 단말(410)과; 상기 건물측 관리단말(200)로부터 건물식별자가 취합된 화재감지신호를 건물 층별 화재감지내역정보 DB(513)에 저장관리함과 아울러 상기 소방서측 단말(410)로 중계전송하여 건물의 화재가 수습되도록 제어하는 중앙방재서버(500);를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: System for fire detection and evacuation using IP camera fused smart fire detector

abstract_en: A flame detection and evacuation system using an IP camera fusion smart flame detector comprises: a flame sensor (110) which generates flame detection information by detecting flame generated in case of flame in an installed building inner area (A); an IP camera (120) which generates image information for each building inner area including a stop image or a video by photographing the installed building inner area (A); and a sprinkler (130). The present invention guides a building occupant to easily evacuate.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재를 감지하여 모니터링하여 줄 뿐만 아니라 발생된 화재의 진화를 스프링쿨러를 이용하여 자체적으로 수행가능하게 안내하되, 건물내부영역 마다 기지정된 위치에 설치된 다수의 스프링쿨러 중 화재가 발생된 영역에 인접한 스프링쿨러에서만 소방수가 토출되도록 함으로써, 건물입주자가 용이하게 대피할 수 있도록 안내하여 주고, 발생된 화재에 대응하여 건물입주자의 대피나 화재진압을 위한 대응절차를 안내하여 주고, 건물에서 화재 발생에 따라 야기되는 고온의 열기나 유독가스가 화재가 발생된 건물내부영역의 주변 영역으로 이동 시 이를 감지하기 위한 온도감지센서 및 가스감지센서를 드론에 탑재하여 제공함으로써, 건물의 각 층별 건물내부영역에 일정간격마다  온도감지센서 및 가스감지센서를 설치할 필요가 없어 설치비용이 절감될 뿐만 아니라 정밀한 측정이 가능하여 건물입주자의 대피 시 야기되는 열기나 유독가스에 대한 피해를 극소화시켜주는 아이피 카메라 융합 스마트 불꽃감지기를 이용한 화재감지 및 대피시스템에 관한 것으로, 건물을 이루는 각 층의 건물내부영역(A) 마다 기지정된 위치에 설치되는 것으로, 설치된 건물내부영역(A)에서 화재시 발생하는 불꽃을 감지하여 불꽃감지정보를 생성하는 불꽃감지센서(110), 설치된 건물내부영역(A)을 촬영하여 정지영상이나 동영상을 포함하는 건물내부영역별 영상정보를 생성하는 IP 카메라(120) 및 스프링쿨러(130)를 포함하고, 생성되는 불꽃감지정보 및 건물내부영역별 영상정보와 더불어 상기 불꽃감지센서(110)가 건물내부영역(A)에 설치된 위치좌표인 센서설치좌표정보를 포함하는 화재감지신호를 전송하는 방재부(100)와; 상기 방재부(100)로부터 전송되는 화재감지신호를 건물측 정보저장부(210)에 저장관리함과 아울러 상기 화재감지신호에 해당 건물을 식별하는 건물식별자를 취합하여 중계전송하고, 상기 화재감지신호에 포함된 건물내부영역별 영상정보를 건물측 정보출력부(220)를 통해 출력하며, 상기 방재부(100)의 스프링쿨러(130)를 개방제어하여 방화수가 토출되도록 제어하는 건물측 제어부(230)를 포함하는 건물측 관리단말(200)과; 상기 방재부(100)로부터 화재감지신호가 전송되면, 경보처리부(310)를 통해 경보신호를 출력하는 화재수신기(300)와; 화재사고를 수습하는 소방서측에서 운영하는 소방서측 단말(410)과; 상기 건물측 관리단말(200)로부터 건물식별자가 취합된 화재감지신호를 건물 층별 화재감지내역정보 DB(513)에 저장관리함과 아울러 상기 소방서측 단말(410)로 중계전송하여 건물의 화재가 수습되도록 제어하는 중앙방재서버(500);를 포함하고, 상기 방재부(100)에는, 건물을 이루는 각 층의 건물내부영역(A) 마다 기지정된 위치에 설치되는 것으로, 건물내부영역(A)에서 발생된 화재의 거리를 측정하여, 화재거리 감지정보를 생성하는 레이저 거리측정기(140);를 포함하며, 상기 방재부(100)에서, 상기 화재감지신호에 상기 화재거리 감지정보를 취합하여 전송하고, 상기 건물측 관리단말(200)의 건물측 제어부(230)에서, 상기 화재감지신호에 취합된 화재거리 감지정보를 참조하여, 건물내부영역(A) 마다 기지정된 위치에 설치된 다수의 스프링쿨러(130) 중 화재가 발생된 영역에 인접한 스프링쿨러(130)만 개방되도록 제어하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: System for fire detection and evacuation using IP camera fused smart fire detector
title_ko: 아이피 카메라 융합 스마트 불꽃감지기를 이용한 화재감지 및 대피시스템
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide a fire detection and evacuation system using an IP camera fused-smart flame detector that not only provides a function of monitoring a detected fire, but also guides the fire extinguishment to be performed autonomously. The fire detection and evacuation system using an IP camera fused-smart flame detector of the present invention comprises: a fire prevention unit (100) for transmitting a fire detection signal; a building-side management terminal (200); a fire receiver (300) for outputting an alarm signal through an alarm processing unit (310) when a fire detection signal is transmitted from the fire prevention unit (100); a fire station-side terminal (410) operated by a fire station that handles a fire accident; and a central fire prevention server (500) for storing and managing a fire detection signal, in which a building identifier is collected from the building-side management terminal (200), in a building floor-by-floor fire detection history information DB (513) and relaying and transmitting the same to the fire station-side terminal (410) so that a fire in the building can be handled. The present invention has the effect of basically extinguishing a fire when a fire occurs, and additionally transmitting the occurrence of a fire to the fire station to enable rapid fire extinguishment.

title_en: Ground simulation experiment method for near-earth asteroid entering effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of protection of asteroid in the near field, in particular to a ground simulation experiment method for the entering effect of asteroid in the near field. According to the invention, the ionization explosion of the atmosphere layer at different incidence angles of the asteroid is realized through a relatively real experiment for simulating the process that the asteroid enters the atmosphere layer at an ultrahigh speed and impacts the earth, and the impact effect and the evolution process of the ocean and the land under the gravity environment are simulated, so that the technical problem that the asteroid can not impact an ocean target in the current horizontal light gas gun is solved, the dynamic response process that the asteroid impacts the water surface and the land and is influenced by the gravity can be simulated in a laboratory, and the monitoring and quantitative analysis of the whole upper and lower regions of a horizontal plane (ground plane) are realized. According to the method and the device, the phenomenon and the process that asteroid enters the atmosphere to impact the earth can be truly simulated, and a basis is provided for disaster assessment and coping and disposal strategy formulation.

title_en: IOT-based intelligent agricultural pollution emergency response method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural pollution treatment, and provides an intelligent agricultural pollution emergency response method and system based on IOT, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1, data acquisition, namely acquiring original data of the agricultural pollution treatment facility; step 2, alarm judgment, namely comparing the original data or the characteristic data obtained by extracting the characteristics of the original data with preset parameters to judge whether the original data meets alarm conditions; if the alarm condition is not met, directly ending the flow in the current round, otherwise, generating alarm data and transferring to the alarm flow; and step 3, an alarm process comprising an emergency disposal process and an alarm disposal process. The invention solves the problems that after the agricultural and pollutant treatment facility takes place an alarm emergency event on site, the emergency response speed of related personnel is low, and the local emergency response-free treatment scheme carries out timely and reasonable emergency response treatment; and the problem that the local emergency response processing scheme for the field alarm of the agricultural pollution treatment facility cannot be updated and maintained in time.

title_en: Emergency event response and material overall allocation method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing, and provides an emergency event response and material overall allocation method and system. Analyzing and obtaining existing emergency material information, text request data and video request data according to emergency event response request information, and generating text request features and feature frame request features based on the request data; and obtaining emergency grade information according to the text request characteristics and the characteristic frame request characteristics, and carrying out material calling management according to the existing emergency material information, the emergency grade information and the emergency place. The technical problems of invalid rescue or excessive material waste caused by unmatched emergency material and emergency event requirements in the prior art due to the fact that the dependence of the emergency event response processing method and the generation of a material calling scheme on manual experience is too high are solved, and the technical effects of reducing the dependence of emergency time rescue response and material calling on manual experience, improving the using effectiveness of emergency rescue materials and avoiding invalid rescue or excessive material waste are achieved.

title_en: Method for simulating risk exposure space of disaster-bearing body on underlying surface of heterogeneous city
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simulating risk exposure space of a disaster-bearing body on the underlying surface of a heterogeneous city, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting multi-source heterogeneous data of the city and preprocessing the multi-source heterogeneous data to obtain preprocessed data; calculating risk exposure parameters of the disaster-bearing body of the urban underlying surface according to the preprocessing data, and constructing a risk exposure characteristic set of the disaster-bearing body of the urban underlying surface; then collecting grid sample data of a disaster-bearing body of the urban underlying surface, and constructing a disaster-bearing body weight exposure grid sample; and finally, according to the disaster-bearing body risk exposure feature set and the disaster-bearing body weight exposure grid sample of the urban underlying surface, adopting a random forest algorithm to simulate the disaster-bearing body risk exposure space of the heterogeneous urban underlying surface. The invention breaks through the bottleneck problem of larger estimation error of the risk exposure of the disaster-bearing body by taking the administrative boundary as a statistics unit, is beneficial to improving the accuracy of the risk exposure simulation of the urban underlying surface, and is suitable for the fields of urban disaster prevention, disaster reduction, emergency management and the like.

title_en: Ducted gas detector
title_ko: 덕트형 가스 검출기
abstract_en: A system for detecting a gas leak within a battery pack comprises: a battery pack; a controller; and a detector. The battery pack comprises a plurality of cells capable of experiencing a gas leak. The detector is mounted remotely from the battery pack and is connected to the battery pack via a gas-tight tube. A fan passes air from the battery pack to the detector. The detector is configured to read a concentration value of one or more gases. The detector is electrically connected to the controller and is configured to transmit a return signal to the controller indicating no alarm, a first alarm level, or a second alarm level. The controller is configured to output the no alarm, the first alarm level, or the second alarm level in response to the return signal. An emergency response procedure is implemented based on the level of gas leak within the battery pack.
abstract_ko: 배터리 팩 내의 가스 누출을 검출하는 시스템은 배터리 팩, 제어기 및 검출기를 포함한다. 배터리 팩은 가스 누출이 발생할 수 있는 복수의 셀을 포함한다. 검출기는 배터리 팩에서 원격으로 장착되며, 기밀 튜브를 통해 배터리 팩에 연결된다. 팬은 배터리 팩에서 검출기로 공기를 전달한다. 검출기는 하나 이상의 가스의 농도 값을 판독하도록 구성된다. 검출기는 제어기에 전기적으로 연결되며, 제어기에 알람 없음, 제1 알람 레벨, 또는 제2 알람 레벨을 나타내는 복귀 신호를 전송하도록 구성된다. 제어기는 복귀 신호에 응답하여 알람 없음, 제1 알람 레벨 또는 제2 알람 레벨을 출력하도록 구성된다. 비상 대응 절차는 배터리 팩 내의 가스 누출 레벨에 기초하여 구현된다.

title_en: Lithium ion battery gas and optical detector
title_ko: 리튬 이온 배터리 가스 및 광학 검출기
abstract_en: A system for detecting a gas leak and/or fire event within a battery pack comprises a battery pack, a controller, a gas detector, and an infrared detector. The battery pack comprises a plurality of cells capable of experiencing a gas leak or fire. The gas detector is configured to read a concentration value of one or more gases. The infrared detector is configured to read a level of infrared radiation. The gas detector and the infrared detector are configured to transmit an alarm level signal to the controller. The controller is configured to output a first alarm level or a second alarm level in response to the concentration value of the gas. The controller is configured to output a third alarm level in response to the level of infrared radiation. Based on the indicated gas leak or level of infrared radiation within the battery pack, an emergency response procedure can be executed.
abstract_ko: 배터리 팩 내부의 가스 누출 및/또는 화재 이벤트를 검출하기 위한 시스템은 배터리 팩, 제어기, 가스 검출기 및 적외선 검출기 포함한다. 배터리 팩은 가스 누출이나 화재가 발생할 수 있는 복수의 셀을 포함한다. 가스 검출기는 하나 이상의 가스의 농도 값을 판독하도록 구성된다. 적외선 검출기는 적외선 방사선의 레벨을 판독하도록 구성된다. 가스 검출기와 적외선 검출기는 경보 레벨 신호를 제어기로 송신하도록 구성된다. 제어기는 가스의 농도 값에 응답하여 제1 경보 레벨 또는 제2 경보 레벨을 출력하도록 구성된다. 제어기는 적외선 방사선의 레벨에 응답하여 제3 경보 레벨을 출력하도록 구성된다. 표시된 배터리 팩 내 가스 누출 또는 적외선 방사선의 레벨에 기초하여 비상 대응 절차가 실행될 수 있다.

title_en: Battery outgassing detector
title_ko: 배터리 가스방출 검출기
abstract_en: A system for detecting a gas leak inside a battery pack includes a battery pack, a controller, and a detector. The battery pack includes a plurality of cells in which a gas leak may occur. The detector is configured to detect a concentration value of one or more gases. The detector is further configured to generate a return signal indicating no alert, a first alert level, or a second alert level. The detector is electrically connected to the controller and is configured to transmit the return signal to the controller. The controller is configured to output the first alert level or the second alert level in response to the return signal. An emergency response procedure may be implemented based on the indicated gas leak level in the battery pack.

title_en: Task allocation method and system based on self-adaptive ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device task allocation technology and discloses a task allocation method and a task allocation system based on a self-adaptive ant colony algorithm, wherein the task allocation method and the task allocation system comprise the steps of importing task data, preprocessing the imported data, and splitting the task data according to device state information; and (3) distributing task data in real time, establishing a multi-target multi-constraint task distribution mathematical model for the imported task data, adding a convergence parameter negative feedback link through an ant colony algorithm, solving the task distribution mathematical model by combining with a workshop scheduling rule, and obtaining a real-time distribution result of the task data through dynamic response processing. title_en: Intelligent risk prediction method based on process mining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk intelligent prediction method based on process mining, which comprises the following steps: reading real-time monitoring data of a sensor, and preprocessing; step two, judging whether the real-time monitoring data is abnormal or not and judging the abnormal grade; step three, judging whether the abnormity is false alarm; generating a flow model candidate set according to the abnormal type; step five, screening the process models in the candidate set according to the abnormity in a grading manner; step six, calculating the probability that the screened emergency management process model is suitable for the current abnormity; and seventhly, sequencing the prediction results and sending out prediction early warning. The method can not only send out early warning by monitoring the abnormal condition of data, but also obtain the possible future events, dangerous situations, sensor value change and the probability of occurrence thereof by using the process model base and the emergency management knowledge base, and even the historical processing mode and the effect of the specific condition as decision support information to be output.

title_en: Intelligent risk prediction method based on process mining

title_en: Vehicle ramp entrance confluence control method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: A vehicle ramp entrance confluence control method based on deep reinforcement learning is characterized in that a ramp confluence simulation environment is built by utilizing SUMO, relevant state information is obtained, a state space, an action space and a rewarding function are designed, an Actor network and a Critic network are built based on a near-end strategy optimization algorithm, iterative training is carried out on the network until convergence, finally, the ramp entrance confluence behavior is completed through interaction between TraCI interfaces and the SUMO, other rewarding standards such as efficiency and comfort level are added, the traffic efficiency of bottleneck road sections can be effectively improved, and the problem that the conventional deep reinforcement learning method is prone to being in the dilemma of state space explosion when the complex state space is processed is effectively solved by adopting the PPO deep reinforcement learning method of Actor-Critic architecture, so that the dimension disaster problem is caused. The invention has the advantages of realizing the control of the ramp confluence of the vehicles, improving the safety of the vehicle running in the ramp confluence area and the road traffic passing efficiency, and simultaneously ensuring the comfort of passengers.

title_en: Subway-bus composite network key station identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a subway-bus composite network key station identification method, which is used for calculating the trip amount of each time period OD pair in a subway-bus composite network by using a trip chain OD back-push method based on the minimum entropy rate based on subway and bus line and station data and historical card swiping data; taking the travel quantity of the OD pairs in each period as input, taking the shortest travel path length of passengers as a target, and acquiring the passenger flow quantity of each side of each period in the subway-bus composite network; comprehensively considering the travel quantity of OD pairs in each period and the passenger flow quantity of each side, and calculating the parameters of each station in each period aiming at a subway-bus weighted time-varying network; and calculating the comprehensive importance of each station in each period by using an entropy weight method, and identifying key subways and bus stations in each period based on the comprehensive importance. The invention helps public transportation operation enterprises rapidly identify the passenger flow trip bottleneck stations in the network of each period, and provides decision support for network planning, station layout, capacity configuration and emergency plans under emergencies.

title_en: Subway transfer station passenger flow bottleneck control method based on platform congestion degree
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of transportation, in particular to a subway transfer station passenger flow bottleneck control method based on the station congestion degree, which comprises the steps of respectively calculating the number of retained stations and the maximum instantaneous passenger flow density of the stations during the stop of subway trains to obtain the station congestion degree; and performing passenger flow bottleneck control through equipment configuration control, train interval adjustment and entrance control.
