title_en: Flood invasion underground space crowd evacuation simulation experiment device and method
abstract_en: A crowd evacuation simulation experiment device and method for a flood invading underground space relates to the technical field of simulation experiments, and comprises three reservoirs, a stair area, a plane water accumulation area and a reflux water channel. The three reservoirs are connected with each other to output stable water flow for a stair area and a flat water area, and simulate flood to invade an underground space, wherein the flat water area comprises a first area and a second area; the first area and the second area are separated by a gate; one side of the first area is connected with the stair area, and the other side of the first area is connected with the gate; one side of the second area is connected with a gate, and the other side of the second area is connected with an open gate; the return channel returns accumulated water to the reservoir. According to the application, through the plane water accumulation area and the gate, the situation that the underground space has a water level difference and an evacuation bottleneck is simulated, and omnibearing simulation data are provided for formulating an emergency evacuation scheme of flood invasion underground space crowd.

title_en: Cluster type video safety boundary exchange method and device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data interaction, solves the problems of performance bottleneck and single point of failure caused by a single link in the prior art, and discloses a cluster video security boundary exchange method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: providing unique exposed IP addresses to producers and consumers in a cluster through virtual IP technology; receiving a signaling request sent by a producer or a consumer through a load balancing program, and forwarding the signaling request to a signaling engine according to a preset strategy; judging whether the signaling request is a code stream negotiation data packet or not; after the gateway or the node is found to be faulty, judging whether the fault is a flow node or a management node, wherein the method can achieve the disaster recovery effect by adopting a multi-link cluster structure, and when part of equipment is faulty, the service cannot be interrupted, and secondly, as the multi-link is used for simultaneously transmitting the service, larger data flux can be transmitted in the same cross-network transmission boundary.

title_en: Expressway bottleneck section emergency lane management and control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency lane control system for a bottleneck section of a highway, and relates to the technical field of emergency lane control of the highway. The system comprises a bottleneck section entrance camera, a network connection device, a background processor and a traffic guidance device; the method comprises the steps of collecting video data through a bottleneck road section entrance camera, transmitting the video data to a background processor through a network connection device, converting the video data into vehicle type traffic volume and vehicle speed through a deep learning algorithm, carrying out flow prediction on the preprocessed data through an EMD-KNN-GRU combined model, comprehensively judging whether an emergency lane needs to be started according to service level and vehicle speed according to different scenes of congestion, construction and accidents, displaying a current closed lane and an open lane through a traffic guidance device, and displaying emergency lane closing information after the road section is unblocked after the road section is restored. The invention can effectively reduce the congestion time of the expressway, avoid the waste of emergency resources caused by opening the emergency lane for a long time, and has the advantages of low investment cost, simple design and high reliability.

title_en: Emergency communication channel shunting method based on edge calculation

title_en: Multi-source data fusion method, computer program product and system for preventing hidden danger of cigarette warehouse fire
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a computer program product and a system for preventing hidden danger of fire hazard in a cigarette warehouse by multi-source data fusion, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a three-dimensional virtual model of a cigarette warehouse, simulating the height of a cigarette stack according to the variety and packaging characteristics of the cigarettes, calculating the stability of the cigarette stack according to the height of the cigarette stack and the temperature and humidity data of the cigarette warehouse, predicting fire types and fire scales by combining temperature, smoke concentration, combustion characteristic data and the stability of the cigarette stack, predicting a fire spreading path, a fire spreading speed and smoke distribution in the cigarette warehouse, determining potential high-risk positions of the fire spreading, determining a fire coping strategy in the cigarette warehouse, including an emergency evacuation path and a putting out path avoiding the potential high-risk positions, predicting evacuation time and an evacuation bottleneck region according to the channel layout of the emergency evacuation path and the putting out path, and outputting a scheme for optimizing the channel layout of the evacuation bottleneck region, the height of the cigarette stack, the fire extinguishing agent distribution and the arrangement of a safety outlet.

title_en: Extreme storm waterlogging disaster risk dynamic assessment method for disaster prevention and reduction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an extreme raindrop and waterlogging disaster risk dynamic assessment method for disaster prevention and reduction, which is used for researching urban system data and disaster prevention and reduction data, carrying out refined risk unit division on disaster-bearing bodies on urban building and road network scales by utilizing a GIS technology and determining disaster-bearing body space distribution, simulating disaster influence on the disaster-bearing bodies based on an extreme raindrop and waterlogging scene simulation waterlogging ponding depth dynamic change process, carrying out waterlogging risk refined dynamic assessment by combining two methods of waterlogging process simulation and an index system, calculating traffic capacity and emergency service accessibility of a road network system by utilizing space complex network and shortest path planning, comprehensively considering reasonable distribution of disaster prevention emergency drainage and emergency rescue service on a high risk area, and providing a waterlogging risk dynamic assessment technology integrating disaster evolution and disaster prevention response process, so as to finally realize dynamic assessment of waterlogging risk of each disaster-bearing unit in the waterlogging disaster evolution process.

title_en: Dynamic evaluation method for extreme rainstorm waterlogging disaster risk for disaster prevention and reduction
abstract_en: A dynamic evaluation method for an extreme rainstorm waterlogging disaster risk for disaster prevention and reduction. title_en: Test device and method for simulating rapid sedimentation to trigger submarine landslide
abstract_en: The invention provides a test device and a method for triggering submarine landslide by simulating rapid sedimentation, and relates to the field of marine geological disaster simulation. The invention has the beneficial effects that the soil particle release module adjusts the height of the deposited soil body in the soil supply box through the push rod motor, and controls the suspension amount of the soil particles of the deposited soil body in the air and the settlement amount of the soil particles in the water through the wind speed of the fan, thereby realizing the uniform distribution and deposition of the sediment on the slope and measuring the sediment deposition rate in real time. The test device also realizes the cooperative measurement of the lateral displacement of the internal linear region of the deposit layer and the water pressure of the super pore. The test device and the test method can be applied to simulating the submarine slope response process under different deposition environments and conditions of deposition physical and mechanical properties, so that the submarine landslide damage instability mechanism is researched.

title_en: Task management method and system based on time axis

title_en: Forestry remote sensing data light weight method based on subspace optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forestry remote sensing data light-weight method based on latent space optimization, which belongs to the technical field of image processing and comprises the steps of obtaining a forestry remote sensing image data set D1 to be compressed, constructing a data light-weight network, training the variable self-encoder and the image classification network by using the D1, generating a clustering data set D2 based on the encoder and the clustering unit, updating latent space variables in the D2 by using the training data light-weight network, and reconstructing data by using a decoder. The compression data set with high precision and representativeness is generated by improving the data set distillation based on the variation self-encoder and the meta-gradient optimization, so that the bottleneck problem of forestry remote sensing data set storage and processing is effectively solved, and the data storage capacity can be reduced while the model training precision is maintained. The method is suitable for various practical application scenes such as forestry resource monitoring, forest health evaluation, disaster response and the like.

title_en: River and lake system ecological scheduling method coupling river basin hydrologic response
abstract_en: A river and lake system ecological dispatching method based on coupling river basin hydrologic response belongs to the field of reservoir ecological dispatching and comprises the steps of firstly selecting a research area to represent hydrologic stations, drawing a river basin hydrologic evolution topological graph, secondly constructing a river basin hydrologic response model step by step, simulating a response process of lake hydrologic situation to upstream water reservoir drainage, thirdly, providing ecological assessment indexes, quantifying lake hydrologic-ecological response, fourthly, constructing a river lake system multi-target optimal dispatching model, fifth, optimizing the river lake system multi-target optimal dispatching model, and finally recommending a reservoir optimal dispatching rule conforming to decision preference based on a fuzzy optimization method. The invention can furthest weaken the adverse effect of concentrated water storage of an upstream water reservoir on ecology of a downstream lake while ensuring the beneficial benefits of power generation, water supply and the like of the reservoir, and recommend reservoir dispatching rules with maximized comprehensive benefits, thereby providing scientific dispatching basis and decision support for the green development of river and lake systems.

title_en: Method for realizing double-activity of ESB (electronic service bus) in two places and three centers
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of storage, and discloses a method for realizing double activity of two places and three centers of ESB, which comprises the steps of disposing two data copies in a production center, a same-city disaster recovery center and a different-place disaster recovery center, and complete service system and data processing capability are configured, so that a dual-activity architecture is realized, and the availability and fault tolerance of the system are improved. Meanwhile, by using the broadcasting mechanism of ESB, the real-time synchronization of data change is realized, the number of times of data copying is reduced, the data superposition and the waste of resources are avoided, and the running cost is reduced. In addition, the method is also based on a fault detection and recovery mechanism of ESB, and when any center fails, the method can be rapidly switched to the standby copy, so that the continuity and stability of the service are ensured. The architecture and the mechanism not only solve the single point failure and performance bottleneck problems in the traditional ESB architecture, but also meet the high availability and expandability requirements of the service, and provide a more efficient, flexible and reliable solution for large enterprises and Internet companies.

title_en: Regional green accurate grouting comprehensive treatment method for double-mining coal seam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional green accurate grouting comprehensive treatment method for a repeated mining coal seam, and relates to the technical field of mining and safety. The method comprises the following steps of S1, accurately identifying and classifying regional grouting space and disaster source states of a double-mining coal seam, S2, carrying out structural design and arrangement of a multifunctional grouting pipeline according to the accurate identification and classification result of S1, S3, preparing green grouting slurry of the double-mining coal seam, S4, grouting the double-mining coal seam by adopting the grouting slurry prepared in the S3, and carrying out grouting effect monitoring feedback in the grouting process by adopting a grouting monitoring system so as to dynamically control and regulate. The invention not only solves the technical bottleneck in the treatment of the repeated mining coal seam, but also realizes safe, efficient and green coal resource recovery, and has important significance for improving the economic benefit of coal enterprises, prolonging the service life of mines and guaranteeing the national energy safety. The popularization and application of the method can powerfully promote the progress and development of the coal mine repeated mining technology in China.

title_en: Passenger flow evacuation method for train foldback station under subway sudden operation interruption
abstract_en: The invention relates to a passenger flow evacuation method for a train foldback station under a subway burst operation interruption, and belongs to the field of emergency evacuation of subway burst interruption. The method comprises the steps of building a passenger flow evacuation simulation environment of a train foldback station through relevant data under the condition of a subway sudden operation interruption, building an improved social force model considering the urgent and the popular psychology of passengers under the condition of the subway sudden operation interruption, identifying the passenger flow evacuation bottleneck position of the foldback station based on the built passenger flow evacuation simulation environment and the improved social force model of the train foldback station, improving the facility layout in the station, and realizing the passenger flow evacuation of the train foldback station under the condition of the subway sudden operation interruption. The invention can timely identify the bottleneck position of passenger flow evacuation in the foldback station, provides a scheme for improving the layout of facilities in the station, and provides decision basis for a subway management department to formulate a passenger flow evacuation scheme after the subway burst operation is interrupted.

abstract_en: The invention provides an acoustic detection principle model machine for ground characteristic recognition, which consists of an acoustic probe section, a connecting section, an electronic circuit system section, a battery and a communication module section, wherein an acoustic probe is arranged in the acoustic probe section, a gyroscope, a data acquisition module, a main controller and a memory are arranged in the electronic circuit system section, the data acquisition module comprises an acoustic probe signal processing circuit and an ADC acquisition chip, and a communication isolation chip, a wireless communication module, a positioning module and a power supply module are arranged in the battery and communication module section. The invention has reasonable and compact structural design, realizes system integration, volume miniaturization and weight light-weight, can be applied to remote and rapid survey of ground mechanics in disaster areas and areas where personnel are difficult to reach, breaks through the technical bottlenecks of traditional manual approach survey and inaccurate space-based remote sensing and space-based geophysical prospecting measurement, and realizes in-situ accurate survey of the ground mechanics.

title_en: Adaptive threshold optimization method and system for field city border region
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the crossing field of remote sensing image processing and disaster risk management, and provides a self-adaptive threshold optimization method and a self-adaptive threshold optimization system for a wild city border region, wherein the technical scheme is that building density is calculated according to building segmentation results; the method comprises the steps of respectively calculating vegetation coverage, field patch area and distance measure, determining a WUI judgment rule, combining the judgment rule to determine the type of the WUI, setting threshold ranges of building density, vegetation coverage, field patch area and buffer area distance measure, calculating WUI areas of different types of WUI under different thresholds, defining fire exposure indexes by combining historical fire trace data and the WUI areas, taking spatial distribution characteristics of the WUI areas as independent variables of an RF model, taking fire exposure indexes under different thresholds as dependent variables of the RF model, fitting to obtain an optimal threshold, and effectively solving the technical bottlenecks of low element extraction precision, single quantization standard, strong subjectivity of threshold setting and the like in the traditional WUI identification.

title_en: Steel logistics whole-flow real-time dynamic management method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for dynamically managing a steel logistics whole process in real time, belonging to the technical field of steel logistics control methods and devices. The technical scheme includes data acquisition and monitoring, tracking of states of transportation vehicles and goods, demand prediction and stock dynamic adjustment, high-frequency goods allocation according to shipment frequency to respond to emergency orders, visual management of a supply chain, establishment of shared data of all links of the supply chain, construction of a 3D logistics map, real-time display of stock, transportation states and bottleneck nodes, risk control management and rapid starting of alternative schemes when early warning is triggered. title_en: Greenhouse environment optimization control method and device integrating deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a greenhouse environment optimization control method and device integrating deep reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of training and obtaining a crop growth state track, a control input track and a greenhouse environment state track through reinforcement learning algorithm on a slow time scale, inverting to obtain a coordination state track, adding the crop growth state track and the coordination state track to a control target of fast time scale control, obtaining an initial guess of the fast time scale control through reinforcement learning algorithm, optimizing the initial guess through optimization control algorithm, and determining a short time domain control decision sequence for finally controlling a greenhouse to be controlled. The rapid decision capability of the reinforcement learning agent is utilized, the bottleneck of optimizing and controlling dimension disaster is broken through, the control instantaneity is improved, the decision of the agent is optimized and the mechanism is interpreted through the optimizing control, and the precise and rapid control of the greenhouse environment is realized so as to ensure the maximization of economic benefit.

title_en: Waking up response method based on Beidou short message and emergency broadcast linkage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wake-up response method based on Beidou short message and emergency broadcast linkage, which relates to the technical field of emergency communication and disaster early warning and comprises the following steps of generating early warning information and sending the early warning information to an early warning terminal; the method comprises the steps of displaying early warning content and triggering a buzzer to give an alarm, enabling a terminal to confirm response within a preset time and transmit the response in a broadcasting mode, enabling the terminal to automatically activate an SOS alarm key and start Beidou positioning again without confirming the response, reporting a real-time position to a back-end management platform, enabling the back-end management platform to carry out resource scheduling, coordinating rescue force and tracking each response process, and generating a response chain. According to the invention, a multi-level and omnibearing disaster early warning and response system is formed by integrating Beidou short message communication, emergency broadcasting, SOS warning and positioning tracking technologies, so that early warning information can be quickly transmitted and people in a disaster area can be forcedly awakened, and timely and effective rescue information and response guidance can be obtained when a disaster occurs for the people.

title_en: Color ring music box sequential playing system and method based on distributed cache
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system and a method for sequentially playing color ring back tone music boxes based on distributed caching, which aim to solve the technical bottleneck of sequential playing of multiple ring back tones in the existing color ring back tone system. The system stores music box data through distributed cache, improves storage efficiency by utilizing key value pair form, and ensures data consistency and system stability by adopting atomic operation and disaster recovery mechanism. The user can customize the playing sequence through the interface module to realize personalized color ring service. The system improves the data access efficiency, enhances the user experience, and is suitable for high concurrency scenes.
assignees: CHINA UNICOM WO MUSIC & CULTURE CO LTD

title_en: Remote sensing image ground object identification method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a remote sensing image ground object identification method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of carrying out data acquisition and preprocessing on a ground surface target area, eliminating position deviation through geometric correction and combining radiation equalization processing illumination difference to generate a ground object registration image, carrying out multidimensional feature fusion processing on the image, carrying out tensor fusion on vegetation spectral features, ground surface texture features, point cloud data features and linear ground object features to construct a ground object fusion matrix, respectively extracting spectral response characteristics and spatial association characteristics by adopting a bilateral convolution neural network, realizing feature interaction through a concentration mechanism to generate a ground object probability distribution map, and finally carrying out noise filtering, boundary refinement and vectorization conversion processing on classification results to output a ground object classification vector map. The method solves the three technical bottlenecks of insufficient cooperative utilization of multi-source heterogeneous data, insufficient spectrum-space feature fusion and poor GIS compatibility, and can remarkably improve the working efficiency of scenes such as homeland investigation, disaster monitoring and the like.

title_en: Building pedestrian simulation statistics and analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building pedestrian simulation statistics and analysis method, and belongs to the technical field of simulation. The system manages pedestrian density through KD tree, and utilizes ScottPlot to make real-time data visualization to generate one-dimensional, two-dimensional and three-dimensional charts, and visually display pedestrian distribution and flow conditions in the building. In emergency evacuation scenarios, the system passes The algorithm dynamically plans the path, and identifies and relieves potential bottleneck areas by combining heuristic functions of congestion metrics. The simulation system can collect abundant statistical data, including evacuation time, people flow distribution, congestion point analysis and the like, and provides scientific basis for safety design improvement and emergency plan formulation of the building.

title_en: Aiops-based artificial intelligence model and big data management system for coastal disaster response

abstract_en: According to an exemplary embodiment of the present invention, a system comprises: a real-time data processing unit configured to collect real-time marine disaster data, extract real-time features for the real-time marine disaster data, store the real-time features in an online feature store, generate a prompt based on the real-time features, and generate and provide real-time marine disaster integrated information using generative AI based on the prompt; and a batch data processing unit configured to collect non-real-time marine disaster data, extract batch features for the non-real-time marine disaster data, store the batch features in an offline feature store, and train a supervised learning-based model based on the batch features. title_en: Landslide potential displacement monitoring system using multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide hidden danger displacement monitoring system using multi-source data fusion, which comprises a multi-source sensing unit, an earth surface deformation sensing module and an edge computing unit, wherein the multi-source sensing unit comprises a satellite-borne radar sensing module, the satellite-borne radar sensing module is used for acquiring large-range earth surface deformation data through a synthetic aperture radar, the earth surface deformation sensing module is used for monitoring earth surface displacement in real time through a dual-frequency GNSS receiver and a fiber grating sensor, the underground stress sensing module is used for acquiring underground rock-soil body stress change through a microseismic monitoring array and a distributed fiber sensor, and the edge computing unit comprises a dynamic weight fusion module, and is used for dynamically distributing multi-source sensor weights according to geological states to generate high-precision fusion displacement field data. The invention can break through the bottleneck of the traditional monitoring system in terms of data quality, model precision and response efficiency through multisource data fusion, model parameter real-time updating and closed-loop optimization mechanism, and provides data support for accurate early warning and intelligent emergency of landslide disasters.

title_en: Visual system and method for simulating earthquake disasters of urban building group
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of urban earthquake disaster simulation, and provides a visual system and a visual method for urban building group earthquake disaster simulation, wherein the system comprises an offline data preprocessing and blocking organizing module and a blocking dynamic data management and scheduling module; the system comprises a GPU acceleration rendering module, a GPU parallel displacement animation module, a high-efficiency interaction module and a high-efficiency interaction module, wherein the GPU acceleration rendering module is used for endowing unique identifiers for vertexes through global floor index mapping, finally submitting a merging model to the GPU, realizing real-time rendering of building forms in cooperation with displacement textures and a custom shader, the GPU parallel displacement animation module is deeply coupled to a GPU rendering pipeline and used for resolving vertex displacement and color values in real time and injecting the vertex displacement and color values into the rendering pipeline, and the high-efficiency interaction module is used for dynamically updating label content and coordinates to realize three-dimensional interaction. According to the application, massive time sequence displacement data are encoded into textures, and parallel computation is performed by using the GPU vertex shader, so that real-time and smooth animation simulation of all building earthquake responses is realized, and the performance bottleneck of the traditional CPU computing mode is solved.

abstract_en: The invention provides a coal preparation plant early warning and responding method, system and equipment based on multi-modal analysis, which comprise the steps of obtaining multi-modal data corresponding to a coal preparation plant, carrying out time and space alignment processing on the multi-modal data to obtain a multi-modal data sequence, carrying out cross-modal feature clustering on the multi-modal data sequence through a pre-constructed abnormal early warning network, identifying abnormal events occurring in the coal preparation plant based on an abnormal event feature cluster obtained through the cross-modal feature clustering to obtain an abnormal early warning result, and determining an event decision result corresponding to the abnormal events based on the abnormal early warning result and a coal preparation industry knowledge graph through the pre-constructed abnormal decision network so as to carry out emergency response on the abnormal events according to the event decision result. The invention can obviously improve the early warning and response processing efficiency, reduce the false alarm rate of the warning and can also meet the requirements of more special and complex service scenes.

title_en: Multi-disaster integrated prevention and control method for island working face in complex stress area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-disaster integrated prevention and control method for a island working face of a complex stress area, which comprises the steps of inducing crack expansion in a stress concentration area through hydraulic fracturing and deep hole blasting, weakening a top plate and reducing the area of a suspended ceiling; drilling holes for outburst prevention measures in the coal seam construction completion area, drilling holes for hole making, pressure relief and permeability increasing of construction machinery, drilling holes for penetrating layers in transportation drainage roadway construction, pumping pressure relief gas in adjacent layers of coal seams, continuously performing pressure relief extraction on the coal seam which is not mined by the bottom plate, performing pressure relief gas extraction on the adjacent layers, dividing working surfaces according to the area verification condition during extraction according to high-risk areas, buffer areas and safety areas, and performing regional prevention and control on different areas. The method solves the bottleneck technology of island working disaster prevention and control in the high-stress concentration area under the disturbance of multiple legacy coal pillars, solves the problem of gas prevention and control of the island working face in the complex stress area, effectively relieves the main contradiction of the current coal mine safety production, and solves the problem that the actually measured drilling cuttings desorption index K1 exceeds the standard during the stoping period.

title_en: Rail transit junction emergency regulation and control method and system based on real-time simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rail transit junction emergency control method and system based on real-time simulation, which relate to the technical field of intelligent transportation and rail transit emergency management and comprise the steps of performing time synchronization processing on real-time passenger flow data and train running state data to generate a junction state data set; the method comprises the steps of establishing a multi-level simulation model, simulating a passenger flow distribution evolution process by presetting passenger flow evacuation behaviors and train operation constraint conditions, positioning capacity limiting nodes in each evacuation path based on an output result of the multi-level simulation model by adopting a bottleneck recognition algorithm, calculating passenger flow bearing capacity, generating optimal path regulation parameters aiming at shortest evacuation time, converting the optimal path regulation parameters into a train automatic control system instruction and a passenger flow guiding display instruction, and transmitting the train automatic control system instruction and the passenger flow guiding display instruction to each line control unit by a hub centralized dispatching system to regulate train operation frequency and passenger flow evacuation direction. The invention realizes the intellectualization and the coordination of the emergency control of the rail transit junction.

title_en: Task processing method and device for intelligent capsule fresh extract beverage machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a task processing method and a task processing device for an intelligent capsule fresh-extraction beverage machine, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a double-layer space structure through a differential private space efficiency algorithm based on an initial parameter set containing a capsule basic formula, and generating a task model containing priority; the method comprises the steps of constructing a task dependency graph based on a task model, extracting spectral features, generating a task scheduling strategy based on the spectral features, predicting resource requirements and resolving conflicts based on the task scheduling strategy to form a resource allocation plan, controlling parameters through an environmental factor compensation mechanism based on the resource allocation plan and an initial parameter set to obtain an optimized parameter set, executing a beverage preparation task according to the optimized parameter set and the task scheduling strategy, and carrying out anomaly detection and emergency response processing on the beverage preparation task. title_en: Sudden death prevention mechanism system applied to mouse
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mouse application, in particular to an anti-sudden death mechanism system applied to a mouse, a target user uses a mouse body, heart rate data of the target user is collected in real time through a heart rate monitoring module, the heart rate data is accurately associated with an authenticated personal heart rate file of the target user through face recognition or identity information verification based on a user identity management module, meanwhile, the heart rate abnormality detection module is utilized to monitor the real-time heart rate data of the target user, whether the real-time heart rate data indicates a user arrhythmia attribute is judged according to a preset heart rate detection threshold value, and a preset anti-sudden death rescue means is triggered through an emergency response processing module based on a specific type according to the user arrhythmia attribute, so that sufficient time can be provided for rescue of the target user to cope with sudden death emergencies.
assignees: DONGGUAN HONGJIANXIN ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: GNSS (Global navigation satellite System) seismoless sliding signal extraction method based on template matching and linear rate correction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a GNSS seismoless slipping signal extraction method based on template matching and linear rate correction, which relates to the technical field of geodetic measurement and geophysical monitoring and comprises the steps of decomposing mixed noise in a GNSS/InSAR time sequence and extracting a denoising residual signal; the method comprises the steps of separating transient and non-transient signal segments by using a mask technology, dynamically correcting linear trend errors based on variance weighted average speed of non-transient data before and after the transient segments, extracting millimeter-level amplitude of the transient signals through iterative optimization, constructing an exponential decay and cosine type transient signal template library, calculating full-sequence cross-correlation through sliding the template along a residual sequence, and accurately identifying signal amplitude, duration and spatial distribution. The invention breaks through the technical bottlenecks of linear velocity interference and multi-signal superposition, provides high-precision data support for fault slip behavior, earthquake-free slip identification and earthquake risk assessment, and remarkably improves the engineering application value of the GNSS/InSAR technology in geophysical research and disaster early warning.

title_en: Forest fire risk assessment method based on interpretable deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire risk assessment method based on interpretable deep learning, which relates to the technical field of forest disaster prevention and comprises the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data and preprocessing the multi-source heterogeneous data to generate a multi-dimensional data cube, extracting a logic relation for forming forest fire risk based on the multi-dimensional data cube, constructing a forest fire risk field knowledge graph based on the logic relation of the forest fire risk, constructing and training a concept bottleneck interpretable deep learning model based on the multi-dimensional data cube as a training sample, and mapping the multi-dimensional data cube input into the concept bottleneck interpretable deep learning model to a semantic concept layer defined by the forest fire risk field knowledge graph. The invention generates a multidimensional data cube by collecting multi-source heterogeneous data, constructs a knowledge graph in the forest fire risk field, trains a concept bottleneck interpretable deep learning model, maps input data to a semantic concept layer, and outputs fire risk level and concept activation results.

title_en: Online monitoring system for migration and collapse rules of roof structure of coal face
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning, and provides an online monitoring system for the roof structure migration collapse rule of a coal face, aiming at the problems of frequent roof accidents, narrow traditional monitoring technical range, poor real-time performance and the like in deep mining, a three-layer architecture design of a data monitoring layer, a transmission layer and a processing layer is adopted, and the real-time capturing of roof three-dimensional space motion data and collapse forms is realized by the cooperation of a high-sensitivity displacement, speed, angular velocity and acceleration sensor of a roof structure migration monitor and a high-definition camera system and the combination of a spiral reservation and rigid-flexible protection in-hole cable transmission technology and 5G/Internet of things communication; and dynamic disasters such as cycle pressure coming and the like are predicted in advance and early warning is carried out by utilizing the mm wave radar, the big data depth processing system and the intelligent image recognition system. The system solves the technical bottleneck of traditional monitoring, and provides an integrated scheme of accurate monitoring and intelligent early warning for the safety of a coal mine roof.

title_en: Real-time mixed test method for bridge cable large-scale substructure fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time mixed test method for a bridge cable large-scale substructure fire disaster, and belongs to the technical field of bridge fire resistance performance tests. Dividing the full bridge into a physical test substructure and an LSTM numerical substructure, wherein the numerical substructure is constructed based on a multi-scale gating residual LSTM, and realizing second-level high-precision prediction of boundary force or displacement of a cable system under fire through parallel multi-branch network, dynamic feature selection gate and residual cross-layer connection. And by combining an LSTM-PID intelligent control system, converting a predicted instruction into a loading signal, synchronously integrating a time-lag compensation mechanism, driving a penetrating jack, a burner and a fan in real time, reproducing a non-uniform wind-fire coupling scene and forming a full-bridge three-dimensional visual fire response. The invention breaks through the bottleneck of the traditional finite element calculation speed, realizes second-level thermodynamic coupling interaction, and provides a test method and a test platform with high precision and high reliability for the fire-resistant design of the large-span bridge.

title_en: Emergency command decision evaluation method based on four-dimensional visual cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency command decision evaluation method based on a four-dimensional visual cloud platform, which is characterized in that historical cases and heterogeneous sensing data are collected by structuring, and extracting multidimensional features such as event types, influence elements, response flows, space-time and causal chains, and mapping the multidimensional features into a dynamic ontology library after normalization processing to realize the structural expression and semantic association of cross-case knowledge. On the basis, by utilizing AI-driven semantic structure migration and graph neural network characteristic migration, the most relevant knowledge segments are quickly matched with new events, a prediction model is adaptively generated, and model dynamic optimization is realized by combining real-time perception data. The technology effectively improves the accuracy and generalization capability of knowledge migration in the emergency response process, realizes continuous self-adaptive situation prediction and high-reliability decision support, and enhances the instantaneity and intelligence of the emergency command system.

title_en: Light intelligent module carried on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lightweight intelligent module mounted on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises five modules, namely a calculation module, an acquisition module, a communication module, a storage module and an interface, wherein the calculation module adopts a high-efficiency low-power-consumption architecture, an integrated special AI acceleration chip, an internal integrated special CPU and a neural network processing unit NPU, and realizes neural network reasoning optimization through a heterogeneous calculation architecture, the acquisition module is provided with a multi-channel data acquisition interface and a built-in data preprocessing unit, and utilizes a multi-thread parallel mode to process the architecture, the communication module integrates various communication protocols and interfaces and dynamically selects an optimal communication path and protocol according to communication requirements and environments, the storage module adopts a multi-level architecture design to realize transactional writing and power-down protection mechanism, the technical bottlenecks of insufficient calculation capacity, difficult heterogeneous system coordination and the like of the existing unmanned aerial vehicle are solved, the intelligent unmanned aerial vehicle is suitable for various scenes such as smart cities, emergency rescue and the like, and the application efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle under multiple scenes is improved.

title_en: Intelligent evaluation method and system for flood priority scheduling for multi-mode flood early warning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood priority scheduling intelligent evaluation method for multi-mode flood early warning, which comprises the following steps of firstly collecting rainfall, water level and flow rate data and preprocessing to generate standardized multi-mode input, secondly constructing a river network graph structure, extracting nodes and edge characteristics to generate graph structure input data, thirdly inputting the graph structure into a EvolveGCN evolution graph convolution network, embedding scheduling path reachability, resource bottlenecks and execution constraint characteristics to output a state propagation characteristic set, fourthly generating node state prediction vectors according to the state propagation characteristics, fifthly, calculating three types of risk scores, applying nonlinear constraint to construct a priority score set, sixthly, generating a scheduling action sequence and collecting feedback data, seventh updating the convolution structure by utilizing feedback update scores and the scheduling sequence, and outputting a final instruction. The intelligent prediction closed loop of flood dispatching is realized, and the response efficiency and the dispatching feasibility are improved.

abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent power grid fault-tolerant communication system and method based on multi-operator channel switching, which are characterized in that heterogeneous network and equipment state data are collected through an intelligent perception layer, an AI decision engine is used for realizing network quality prediction and multi-objective optimization, a resource cooperative control layer integrates spectrum resources and network slices, an edge execution layer is used for executing hardware-level fast switching, an emergency disaster recovery layer is used for providing multi-dimensional fault recovery, and a safe and reliable layer is used for guaranteeing data safety. title_en: Natural disaster engineering rescue data platform construction and intelligent analysis system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data analysis, in particular to a natural disaster engineering rescue data platform construction and intelligent analysis system which comprises an edge intelligent perception module, a cloud depth analysis module, a dynamic decision generation module and a closed loop optimization module, wherein the edge intelligent perception module is used for generating a scene three-dimensional real scene grid through fusion of laser radar point clouds and visible light videos and extracting disaster condition feature vectors, the cloud depth analysis module is used for aggregating multi-source data through a graph neural network and generating a global disaster evolution map composed of disaster grade distribution and an infrastructure vulnerability index, the dynamic decision generation module is used for generating a space-time collaborative rescue instruction set composed of an equipment scheduling path and an engineering treatment sequence by combining a rescue resource library and engineering constraints comprising equipment mechanical arm operation radius and residual shock influence coefficients, and the closed loop optimization module is used for collecting operation feedback logs, correcting the extraction weights of the disaster condition feature vectors through a difference comparison engine and dynamically updating an engineering constraint library. The invention realizes the unified coordination of disaster sensing intellectualization, task allocation optimization and closed cyclization in the response process.

title_en: Truck-unmanned aerial vehicle joint transportation scheduling method and system based on disaster relief scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to a truck-unmanned aerial vehicle joint transportation scheduling method and system based on a disaster relief scene in the technical field of transportation scheduling. The truck-unmanned aerial vehicle joint transportation scheduling method uses H trucks and H unmanned aerial vehicles to cooperatively transport materials, the H trucks and the H unmanned aerial vehicles form a cooperative group, the scheduling method of the H cooperative group comprises the steps of confirming the number of rescue points and the positions of the rescue points, generating an initial truck path based on greedy rules of shortest delivery distance according to the number of the rescue points, the positions of the rescue points and constraint conditions, generating an initial unmanned aerial vehicle path based on the initial truck path, and optimizing the initial truck path and the initial unmanned aerial vehicle path to obtain an optimal material transportation path. The invention innovatively constructs a truck-unmanned aerial vehicle cooperative transportation mechanism, breaks through the traditional efficiency bottleneck through a cooperative three-dimensional transportation system of a transportation tool, and remarkably improves the emergency material delivery efficiency, reliability and timeliness in a complex catastrophe environment.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle data processing system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle data processing system based on edge calculation, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle data processing. The system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle end, an edge computing node and a ground control center, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle end is provided with a multi-mode sensor array, a data synchronization module and a preprocessing module, a pipeline processing engine is used for realizing data slicing parallel processing based on a Kafka+spark framework, a dynamic unloading controller is used for dispatching computing tasks according to the computing power state of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the ground control center is provided with a multi-mode storage system, a metadata management engine and an end-to-end safety channel, the end-to-end data processing delay is reduced to be within 500ms through the edge node localization processing and dynamic task unloading mechanism by combining with the pipeline parallel engine, and millisecond-level synchronization and self-adaptive compression strategies of the multi-mode sensor are used for improving data transmission efficiency, so that the bottleneck of mass data transmission is effectively solved, and the high-timeliness requirements of scenes such as real-time monitoring and emergency response are met.

title_en: Meteorological intelligent question-answering system and method based on domain knowledge graph and dynamic optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a meteorological intelligent question-answering system and method based on field knowledge graph and dynamic optimization, wherein the system comprises a multi-source fusion training module, a meteorological knowledge graph and other modules, and the accuracy of term analysis is improved through multi-source data training, knowledge graph support and dynamic optimization; the method realizes question and answer through multi-mode input analysis, meteorological element analysis and data feedback optimization. Compared with the traditional NLP model, the method improves the accuracy of meteorological term analysis from 68.2% to 92.7%, breaks through the bottleneck of composite query understanding, supports 3-layer nested semantic query, shortens the adaptation period of new model terms to 2 hours, improves the timeliness by 10 times, realizes meteorological element association analysis, and provides powerful support for disaster reduction decision.

title_en: Full-flash active area diagnosis method for lightning detection data missing area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-flash active area diagnosis method for a lightning detection data missing area, which comprises the steps of collecting lightning active data, carrying out space-time consistency matching, carrying out convection cloud area and lightning identification, constructing a lightning tag set in the convection cloud area according to a lightning identification result, carrying out feature calculation to obtain multidimensional infrared bright temperature features, carrying out feature screening to obtain multidimensional infrared bright temperature representative features, carrying out multi-model integrated training and optimization according to the lightning tag set and the corresponding multidimensional infrared bright temperature representative features, carrying out model evaluation to select a comprehensive optimal lightning diagnosis model, and inputting the multidimensional infrared channel bright temperature data to be diagnosed into the comprehensive optimal lightning diagnosis model to obtain a lightning diagnosis result. The lightning activity area kilometer level identification can be realized, the technical bottleneck of efficient monitoring of the lightning activity in the remote area is solved, and a realization means is provided for lightning monitoring and early warning in the remote area, so that lightning protection and disaster reduction work in the corresponding area is effectively supported.

title_en: Disaster recovery control method, equipment and medium based on multi-center converged communication
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of network communication and discloses a disaster recovery control method, equipment and medium based on multi-center converged communication, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-center state data in real time and generating a standard state matrix; the method comprises the steps of carrying out multidimensional anomaly detection by adopting a dynamic baseline model and an improved Z-score algorithm, generating a disaster recovery strategy based on a weighted voting method, supporting lossless conversion of 6 protocols such as HTTP/2, MQTT and the like through a protocol conversion module, dynamically adjusting resource allocation by combining flow characteristic prediction, guaranteeing continuous synchronization of session states by adopting an incremental snapshot and Raft consensus algorithm, supporting breakpoint continuous transmission, and setting a progressive fault back-cut mechanism. The invention overcomes the technical bottlenecks of high detection misjudgment rate, long switching time and poor protocol compatibility of the traditional scheme.

title_en: Wind-solar energy storage-charging collaborative optimization regulation and control system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent energy and automatic control of an electric power system, and particularly relates to a cross-level cooperative regulation and control system integrating weather prediction, electric power market and equipment state, which comprises a central cooperative controller, a data acquisition unit, a communication network and an execution terminal, wherein the central cooperative controller is connected with the communication network; the data acquisition unit is used for acquiring meteorological data, power load data, electric energy consumption cost data and equipment operation state data in real time, the execution terminal at least comprises a photovoltaic inverter, an energy storage converter and a charging pile controller, and the central cooperative controller is configured to execute three cooperative optimization closed loops, namely a data fusion closed loop and a prediction closed loop, a multi-target dynamic optimization closed loop and a multi-time scale control closed loop. The system and the method solve the problems of instantaneity and accuracy of multi-source heterogeneous data fusion, break through the balance optimization bottleneck of multiple targets such as economy, stability and environmental protection in a dynamic process, realize full-time-scale seamless cooperative control from second-level emergency response to hour-level economic dispatch, and improve the self-adaption capability and overall performance of the system in different application scenes.

title_en: Large linear cultural heritage multi-scenario long time sequence flood submerged evolution simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large linear cultural heritage multi-scenario long time sequence flood submerged evolution simulation method and system, belonging to the field of climate change influence evaluation and cultural heritage disaster simulation, comprising the steps of acquiring multi-scenario climate data and correcting deviation; the method comprises the steps of calculating extreme precipitation indexes based on data after deviation correction, matching the hourly rain distribution of precipitation with extreme precipitation days to obtain hourly sequence and spatial weight of the extreme precipitation, obtaining parameter data of each river basin based on digital elevation model data and land utilization data, inputting the hourly sequence and spatial weight of each river basin and the parameter data into a flood inundation hydrodynamic model, and carrying out large-scale linear cultural heritage flood inundation evolution simulation. The method effectively solves the problems of coarse space-time resolution, large systematic deviation and the like of global climate model data in regional application, and simultaneously overcomes the bottleneck of overhigh calculation load in long-time sequence and multi-scenario simulation of the traditional high-resolution hydrodynamic model.

title_en: Local artificial intelligence earthquake sand liquefaction deformation prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a local artificial intelligence earthquake sand liquefaction deformation prediction method and a system, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster prediction and comprise the steps of obtaining multi-source geological data; the method comprises the steps of extracting 3-5Hz soil body frequency domain characteristics through wavelet packet decomposition, fusing DEM and historical liquefaction thermodynamic diagram to divide a deposition phase control unit, adopting a Bayesian constrained improved Kriging algorithm to generate a three-dimensional voxel model, combining real-time vibration main frequency offset to construct four-dimensional space-time tensors, inputting the tensors into a local self-adaptive graph rolling network, dynamically adjusting convolution kernel weights through a space-time attention mechanism, synchronously outputting a prediction result, triggering increment learning based on MEMS acceleration and FBG strain data, correcting unliquefaction area prediction values and feeding back to the voxel model, and finally generating a probability disaster chain scene tree through space pattern matching. The invention solves the technical bottleneck that the traditional model has poor adaptability in complex deposition environment and can not be updated in real time, and provides intelligent early warning support for the engineering safety of the earthquake active region.

title_en: Analysis method for residence public long-term emergency strategy after severe accident of nuclear power plant
abstract_en: The invention provides an analysis method of a residence community long-term emergency strategy after a severe accident of a nuclear power plant, which comprises the steps of S  1 , obtaining ground nuclide concentration according to a smoke plume atmospheric dispersion simulation result after the severe accident, S  2 , calculating the dose received by residence personnel according to the ground nuclide concentration after the severe accident obtained in the step S  1 , S  3 , comparing the dose obtained in the step S  2  with a residence dose threshold value to judge whether the residence can reside or not, S  4 , analyzing an allowable emergency measure combination according to the judgment result in the step S  3 , S  5 , evaluating the economy of measures taken when the residence cannot be performed in the step S  4 , and determining the emergency strategy to be finally adopted. The invention constructs a three-in-one analysis method of dosage safety, emergency measure and economic cost, and breaks through the technical bottleneck. The technical scheme has novel overall conception and strict flow design, and realizes the scientificalness, refinement and intellectualization of public emergency decisions after severe accidents of the nuclear power plant.
assignees: SHANGHAI NUCLEAR ENG RES & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Mountain geological disaster dangerous source identification method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of geological disaster identification, and relates to a mountain geological disaster dangerous source identification method and system based on artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-modal heterogeneous data related to geological disasters and constructing a multi-modal heterogeneous attribute map based on the multi-modal heterogeneous data; the method comprises the steps of dividing an identification area into a plurality of sub-identification areas, determining heterogeneous element paths of the sub-identification areas to obtain a meta-path set and a path instance set of the identification area, respectively processing the heterogeneous element paths in the meta-path set through a self-adaptive path propagation operator to obtain area fusion characteristics of terrain grid nodes of each sub-identification area, carrying out self-adaptive weight optimization and hazard source judgment based on the area fusion characteristics and historical disaster point labels to obtain geological disaster hazard source distribution conditions, and constructing an intelligent identification method adapting to a regional disaster rule to improve accuracy and efficiency of mountain geological disaster hazard source identification by breaking through multi-mode heterogeneous data fusion bottlenecks.
assignees: UNIV ABA TEACHERS;SICHUAN GEOLOGICAL SURVEY RES CENTER

title_en: Mountain geological disaster dangerous source identification method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of geological disaster identification, and relates to a mountain geological disaster dangerous source identification method and system based on artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-modal heterogeneous data related to geological disasters and constructing a multi-modal heterogeneous attribute map based on the multi-modal heterogeneous data; the method comprises the steps of dividing an identification area into a plurality of sub-identification areas, determining heterogeneous element paths of the sub-identification areas to obtain a meta-path set and a path instance set of the identification area, respectively processing the heterogeneous element paths in the meta-path set through a self-adaptive path propagation operator to obtain area fusion characteristics of terrain grid nodes of each sub-identification area, carrying out self-adaptive weight optimization and hazard source judgment based on the area fusion characteristics and historical disaster point labels to obtain geological disaster hazard source distribution conditions, and constructing an intelligent identification method adapting to a regional disaster rule to improve accuracy and efficiency of mountain geological disaster hazard source identification by breaking through multi-mode heterogeneous data fusion bottlenecks.

title_en: Online elasticity assessment and neural network interpretation method and system for power transmission system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for online elasticity assessment and neural network interpretation of a power transmission system, and belongs to the technical field of elasticity assessment of power systems. The method comprises the steps of calculating wind speed change based on a typhoon wind field evolution model, constructing a system vulnerability model, establishing a power transmission system response process under an extreme disaster scene as a Markov decision process, combining the system vulnerability model and the Markov decision process, constructing a time-space diagram attention network to estimate elasticity indexes, identifying key links influencing system elasticity through interpretability analysis, and utilizing the time-space diagram attention network to evaluate the power transmission system elasticity on line and output interpretability information. The method solves the problems of low calculation efficiency and lack of guidance after evaluation in the existing method, improves the efficiency and accuracy of elastic evaluation in extreme disaster scenes, provides visual guidance for elastic lifting of the system, and ensures safe operation of the power transmission system.

title_en: Micro-service application remote active-standby disaster recovery rapid switching method based on private cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a micro-service application remote main and standby disaster recovery rapid switching method based on a private cloud platform, which relates to the technical field of computers and is used for solving the problems of long remote main and standby disaster recovery switching time, cold start storm, insufficient capacity assessment and discharge strategies and complex backcut, and the switching process is decomposed into controllable steps through definite sequential arrangement of a data surface and a control surface and batched reconnection strategy in combination with real-time state feedback, so that the switching time is obviously shortened, the goal of minute-level continuous availability is met, and core hot spot data and indexes are loaded to a standby side in advance through hot set construction and standby side quasi-real-time preheating before switching, so that the standby side has higher cache hit rate and index availability during main rising, and the performance bottleneck caused by a large amount of cold data access is avoided.

title_en: Digital twinning-based emergency operation visual management method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency operation visual management method and device based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of digital twinning. The method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional twin scene corresponding to a physical emergency space, establishing a virtual mapping model, collecting multi-source heterogeneous data in real time, identifying a patient flow thermodynamic diagram and a resource utilization rate based on data driving model updating, identifying a homogeneity index according to the thermodynamic diagram and predicting a patient flow, combining the resource utilization rate and a prediction sequence to simulate and schedule to form a limit scheduling scheme and a reception flow, and visualizing the result and synchronizing manager reminding. The technical problems that the current emergency management depends on static data and manual experience and cannot sense, predict and globally optimize the patient flow and the resource bottleneck which change dynamically in real time are solved, and the technical effects of realizing real-time dynamic visual management of emergency operation, accurately identifying the patient flow thermodynamic diagram and the emergency resource utilization rate and improving the accuracy and timeliness of emergency operation management are achieved through a digital twin technology.

title_en: Training and checking system and method for mining self-rescuer
abstract_en: The application discloses a mining self-rescuer training and checking system and a mining self-rescuer training and checking method, which belong to the technical field of mine safety training and emergency assessment, wherein the mining self-rescuer training and checking system comprises the following steps of collecting operation process data worn by trained personnel in a downhole simulation escape scene, presetting a standard operation flow based on the operation process data, generating a personal operation effectiveness index, determining resource conflict points, channel congestion points and external interference events which occur in the operation process, generating a bottleneck hot zone diagram, combining the personal operation effectiveness index, the bottleneck hot zone diagram and a sequential rationality index, quantitatively scoring the trained personnel, and outputting training and checking assessment results; the method and the device realize simultaneous quantification of individual operation, team cooperation and environmental constraint, not only can position high-risk actions and congestion nodes in one training and take precedence order and rhythm offset into account, but also can support cross-scene and cross-batch transverse and longitudinal comparison by unified coding, and improve evaluation efficiency and accuracy.

title_en: Domestic high-speed data transmission board card design method based on 1394B bus
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for designing a domestic high-speed data transmission board card based on a 1394B bus, which comprises the steps of dividing independent asynchronous transmission logic channels and isochronous transmission logic channels by configuring channel allocation domains of a 1394B link layer control register, monitoring real-time data flow of the isochronous transmission channels, dynamically adjusting token bucket capacity of the asynchronous channels based on a preset bandwidth occupancy rate threshold, analyzing transaction tag fields of data packets, mapping tag values to different priority queues, preempting transmission time slots of a physical layer interface according to priorities, intercepting an isochronous packet time stamp of a bus circulation main controller, generating drift compensation values by a domestic clock calibration algorithm, and injecting compensated clock reference packets into the isochronous channels. The invention solves two technical bottlenecks of sudden flow adaptability and fault disaster recovery cooperation of the 1394B bus system, and realizes systematic innovation of bandwidth resource flexible scheduling and multistage fault immunity.

title_en: Method and device for predicting fire temperature field of wood gallery bridge and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method and a device for predicting a fire temperature field of a wood gallery bridge and electronic equipment, and belongs to the technical field of fire temperature field prediction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining temperature field sequence data of a ceiling of a wood gallery bridge in a scene of the wood gallery bridge at the current moment, inputting the temperature field sequence data into a pre-trained wood gallery bridge fire disaster temperature field space-time prediction model to obtain predicted temperature field sequence data representing a certain time after the current moment, and generating wood gallery bridge fire disaster early warning information based on the predicted temperature field sequence data. The method solves the technical bottleneck that the traditional method is difficult to consider the speed and the precision, and fills the blank of the existing research in the field by targeted modeling of the fire scene of the open space wood gallery bridge.

title_en: Urban storm flood multi-scale dynamic simulation method based on digital elevation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of flood disaster simulation, and provides a digital elevation-based urban storm flood multi-scale dynamic simulation method, which comprises the steps of collecting relevant data of urban storm rainfall; the method comprises the steps of constructing a geometric model of a drainage pipe network, connecting the model with a surface water flow dynamic simulation through a coupling method, adopting a microscopic-scale drainage system modeling and a high-resolution water flow simulation method to evaluate flood ponding and flow distribution of different catchments, describing water flow behaviors in a pipeline based on a one-dimensional pipe network model, reflecting water flow changes of urban environments based on a two-dimensional surface water dynamics model, coupling the one-dimensional pipe network model with the surface water dynamics model, simulating dynamic interaction between surface water flow and the drainage pipe network through calculated water volume exchange, and adjusting model parameters based on actual flood data. The invention breaks through the adaptability bottleneck of the traditional model in complex urban environment and extreme weather, and realizes the full-flow and high-precision dynamic simulation of water flow from macroscopic drainage basin to microscopic facilities.

title_en: All-weather constant-temperature sealed medical back delivery cabin based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an all-weather constant-temperature sealed medical back delivery cabin based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles and comprises a cabin body, a cabin cover is arranged above the cabin body, the left sides of the cabin body and the cabin cover are provided with observation windows, the inner side of the right end of the cabin body is provided with a modularized frame, and the inner side of the modularized frame is provided with an oxygen bottle. The ground rescue transportation mode solves the problems that when a large-scale disaster site such as traffic jam, complex terrain or road damage is faced, the situation is often that the helicopter is long in time and slow in response, although the helicopter rescue solves the problems of speed and accessibility to a certain extent, the application is still limited by high cost, complex take-off and landing conditions, flight safety under severe weather, insufficient night operation capability and other bottlenecks, and meanwhile, when the wounded is carried and placed, the stretcher is directly put into a cabin, and secondary injury is caused due to the problem of an operation mode.

title_en: Subway tunnel explosion-proof toughening and performance evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underground engineering protection and geological disaster prevention and control, and provides an explosion-proof toughening and performance evaluation method and system for a subway tunnel, wherein the method comprises the following steps of step 1, obtaining key parameters and determining equivalent explosion impulse and performance targets; the method comprises the steps of selecting toughening materials, determining a gradient structure, constructing the gradient structure, controlling quality, collecting structural response data, periodically updating surrounding rock parameters, establishing a numerical model, performing simulation analysis and check on a tunnel structure, calculating a toughness index R and a damage grade D, performing grading evaluation, and performing inversion check and adaptability verification optimization, wherein the step 5 comprises the steps of selecting the toughening materials, determining the gradient structure, the step 3 comprises the step of constructing the gradient structure, performing quality control, the step 4 comprises the step of collecting structural response data, and performing simulation analysis and check on the tunnel structure. The scheme solves the key bottlenecks of insufficient rigidity thickening energy consumption, fragile and easy peeling interface, impervious and toughening and disjointing interface, lack of unified index of energy-toughness and closed-loop evaluation in the prior art, and forms a generalizable and standardized explosion-proof toughening engineering solution.

title_en: Lightweight extraction method and system for disaster risk area on satellite
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lightweight extraction method and system for an on-board disaster risk zone, and belongs to the technical field of intersection of satellite remote sensing data processing and emergency disaster response. The invention can realize 'on-board completion of core processing, light-weight data adaptation Beidou and minute-level downloading to the ground', and breaks through the timeliness bottleneck of disaster emergency response.
