title_en: Single-Beidou system-assisted real-time imaging method for airborne laser scanning of three-dimensional live-action map of complex geographic environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a single Beidou system-assisted real-time imaging method for airborne laser scanning of a three-dimensional live-action map of a complex geographic environment, which is used for solving the problems of large positioning deviation, high data redundancy and insufficient real-time performance of the traditional imaging technology in the complex geographic environment (such as mountain canyons, forest coverage areas and urban dense building groups) by combining the advantages of point cloud acquisition of an airborne laser scanning device by means of high-precision positioning and time service capability of the single Beidou system, and constructing the integrated technical flow of Beidou data acquisition and preprocessing, laser point cloud acquisition and denoising, feature point extraction and matching, three-dimensional model construction and precision checking and optimizing, so that the high-efficiency and high-precision real-time imaging of the three-dimensional live-action map in the complex environment is realized. The method is suitable for geological exploration, emergency rescue and urban planning scenes, effectively improves the efficiency and the precision of three-dimensional imaging in a complex geographic environment, and solves the bottleneck problems that the traditional technology depends on a multi-satellite system, is greatly interfered by the environment and cannot output results in real time.

title_en: Urban traffic system toughness enhancement and restoration method based on safe linear interval
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for enhancing and recovering toughness of an urban traffic system based on a safe linear interval, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a time-varying traffic network diagram of an urban road network, identifying bottleneck links of each OD pair, defining limiting links, calculating demand weighting coefficients of the limiting links, providing the safe linear interval for describing the change rule of link quality improvement contribution to network toughness in different intervals, establishing a linear relation between link quality improvement quantity and toughness gain in the safe linear interval, combining the demand weighting coefficients and static connectivity, optimizing weight parameters of a matrix by combining a double-objective optimization method, thereby constructing a traffic network weight matrix, simulating node competition interaction, identifying key nodes, and finally simulating node removal and recovery processes. The invention quantitatively improves the disturbance rejection and recovery capacity of the urban road traffic system, and provides a unified and efficient toughness enhancement and recovery scheme for daily disturbance and post-disaster interruption.

abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for integrating drilling and injection of a tunnel water and mud bursting disaster source, which overcome the technical bottleneck of remote treatment of the tunnel water and mud bursting disaster source. The tunnel water-flooding mud-bursting disaster source drilling and injecting integrated device and method provided by the invention are used for performing disaster source advanced treatment based on directional long drilling, have the obvious advantages of longer detection distance, and are capable of effectively detecting and treating longer distances. According to the integrated device and method for drilling and grouting the water and mud surge disaster source of the tunnel, provided by the invention, directional drilling construction, disaster source while-drilling detection, disaster source while-drilling treatment and grouting effect evaluation are completed in the directional drilling process, and drilling, detection, grouting and evaluation are realized by one pass of drilling, so that the treatment efficiency of the water and mud surge disaster source of the tunnel is obviously improved, and the integrated device and method are suitable for industrial large-scale use and popularization.

title_en: Multi-dimensional sensing early warning disposal terminal of liquefied gas steel cylinder and Internet of things system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multidimensional sensing and early warning disposal terminal of a liquefied gas steel bottle and an Internet of things system, wherein the terminal comprises an explosion-proof shell, an electromagnetic locking mechanism is arranged on the explosion-proof shell and detachably arranged at a handle of the bottleneck of the steel bottle, a battery, a main control module, a positioning module, a communication module and an environment sensing module are arranged in the explosion-proof shell, the electromagnetic locking mechanism, the battery, the positioning module, the communication module and the environment sensing module are respectively connected with the main control module, an AI (analog interface) model of the main control module is used for dynamically constructing a behavior baseline and an elastic geo-fence according to the deployment scene and the use mode of the steel bottle, and the communication module is used for receiving multisource sensing data to complete unsupervised anomaly detection, grading response and disposal strategy generation. The invention has the advantages of active prediction, early warning and disposal capability for the liquefied gas steel cylinder, low false alarm probability, high response speed and high emergency response efficiency.

title_en: Self-organizing task diversion disaster recovery previewing method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of task diversion disaster recovery previewing scheme design, in particular to a self-organizing task diversion disaster recovery previewing method and system. The method comprises the steps of setting a replay area, disaster recovery levels and corresponding temporary storage areas in a robot control system, responding to area alarms, automatically identifying related tasks, automatically determining task processing strategies based on preset rules according to task types and disaster recovery levels, including path diversion or reassignment to the temporary storage areas, executing diversion in a simulation environment, dynamically changing the number of tasks and AGVs to test system limits, and finally generating replay data for evaluating system performance. The corresponding system comprises functional modules for realizing the steps. The invention solves the problem that the prior art lacks automatic disaster recovery replay capability, can expose the system bottleneck in advance, and provides data support for optimizing the scheduling strategy and improving the system toughness.

title_en: Wide remote sensing image semantic segmentation method based on multi-scale image pyramid cutting
abstract_en: The invention provides a semantic segmentation method of a wide remote sensing image based on multi-scale image pyramid cutting, and aims to realize pixel-level refined interpretation of a large-scale remote sensing image. The method comprises a four-step core process, namely a first step of multi-scale pyramid cutting of a wide remote sensing image, a second step of long-distance context dependent representation and modeling, a third step of high-efficiency semantic integration of cross-scale characteristics, and a fourth step of integration of local reasoning results. The invention overcomes the bottleneck that the traditional broad remote sensing image semantic segmentation model is difficult to capture the long-distance context semantic feature association, effectively solves the problems of high computational complexity, large video memory occupation and insufficient precision of the traditional broad remote sensing segmentation method, has the advantages of high segmentation precision and high training reasoning efficiency, and can be widely applied to the fields of homeland space planning, ecological environment monitoring, agricultural resource investigation, natural disaster assessment and the like.

title_en: Geological disaster risk assessment system and method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster risk assessment system and method based on big data, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control and artificial intelligence intersection. The system comprises a multi-source data acquisition module, a data preprocessing and characteristic engineering module, a geological disaster risk assessment model module and a risk assessment and visual output module, wherein the multi-source data acquisition module is used for acquiring multi-source heterogeneous big data related to geological disasters, and the data preprocessing and characteristic engineering module is used for cleaning, normalizing, aligning and extracting characteristics of acquired original data. The ST-GRU-GCN hybrid model organically integrates the spatial information mining capability of GCN and the time sequence modeling capability of GRU, can capture the time-space evolution rule of geological disasters more comprehensively, has prediction accuracy remarkably higher than that of a single model, introduces various different parameters, provides dynamic, indirect and prospective information which cannot be easily obtained by traditional geological investigation for the model, and breaks through the perception bottleneck of the traditional model.

title_en: Satellite-ground collaborative intelligent remote sensing calculation method and system based on generalized dynamic guidance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a satellite-ground collaborative intelligent remote sensing calculation method and system based on generalized dynamic guidance, and relates to the technical fields of space information technology, artificial intelligence and edge calculation intersection. The method comprises the steps of forming generalized dynamic guiding information comprising an intelligent space mask, a task self-adaptive prompt vector and a collaborative reasoning instruction through a ground guiding center, realizing self-adaptive focusing processing by adopting a local focusing calculation and conditional early-back mechanism according to the guiding information and combining a real-time resource state by a satellite-borne processing unit, constructing a space-earth closed-loop optimizing system, and continuously optimizing a guiding strategy through result feedback. The invention realizes the mode transition from the whole image processing to the focusing calculation, obviously improves the processing efficiency on the satellite, reduces the calculated amount by 70-90% while ensuring the precision, reduces the satellite-ground communication data amount by more than 95%, effectively solves the bottleneck problems of satellite resource limitation and data transmission bandwidth, and has important value in remote sensing application scenes such as disaster emergency, environmental monitoring and the like.

title_en: Data dynamic encryption transmission method and system based on quantum key distribution
abstract_en: The application discloses a data dynamic encryption transmission method and system based on quantum key distribution, relates to the technical field of information security, and solves the technical problems that the prior art often adopts a fixed algorithm and a fixed key length, so that the security is insufficient in a high-risk scene and the performance is wasted in a low-risk scene, and the efficiency of the data dynamic encryption transmission method is low; the quantum key pool is constructed through the quantum key distribution link, the encryption strategy is dynamically generated by combining the intelligent decision model of environment perception, and data is encrypted and transmitted according to the encryption strategy, so that the bottleneck that static encryption is difficult to adapt to a complex communication environment is effectively broken through, the self-adaptive optimization of encryption strength, algorithm and key source is realized, the resource utilization efficiency, emergency response capacity and overall transmission efficiency are improved on the premise of ensuring high safety, and key technical support is provided for constructing an intelligent and elastic safety communication system.

title_en: Multi-branch estuary toughness assessment method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering and disaster prevention and reduction, and discloses a toughness assessment method of a multi-branch estuary, which comprises the following steps of establishing an estuary directed graph, collecting real-time water level and flow velocity, and extracting a static working point by utilizing low-pass filtering; the method comprises the steps of calculating the reactance of a differential real part resistor and a wave flow coupling imaginary part to synthesize dynamic differential complex impedance, executing open circuit or short circuit reconstruction according to the impedance and the energy flow state to generate a variation topological graph, further constructing a Laplace matrix to extract algebraic connectivity, calculating a system toughness index by combining residual moisture capacity, and finally comparing the index with a threshold value, identifying a key impedance bottleneck and outputting a water conservancy scheduling suggestion. According to the application, a dynamic differential complex impedance model based on linearization of a fluid working point is constructed, and the hidden risk of physical smoothness but hydrodynamic blocking of a channel special for a estuary area can be sharply captured by introducing wave flow coupling imaginary reactance.
